title: Senior AI / ML Engineer
description:
Delft, Netherlands \| Full\-time \| Hybrid


Salary: €70,000 to €90,000, DOE \+ bonus plan

 *The salary range for this role is broad, as we are able to consider varying levels of experience. Any offer made will carefully take into account level of experience (including relevant industry experience), transferable relevant skills and previous relevant achievements.*

*We will also consider part\-time applications for this role. Please indicate your preferred working schedule in your cover letter.*

  



**About us**


Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.


We recently raised $75 million to accelerate our cutting\-edge R\&D. We partner with many of the world’s leading quantum computing companies and governments to accelerate their path to utility\-scale quantum computers. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast. Join us!

 **About the role**


We have a fantastic opportunity for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to become a founding member of our brand\-new R\&D team in Delft, Netherlands.


This is an incredibly exciting opportunity to play a key role in developing machine learning tools for quantum error correction (QEC) and quantum computing. Our cutting\-edge work is at the intersection of quantum science and classical engineering, and as such, you do not need necessarily a background in quantum computing to be successful in this role.  



**What you will do**


As a Senior AI/ML Engineer at Riverlane, you will apply your proven expertise in machine learning, deep learning and other areas of artificial intelligence to pioneer new approaches that accelerate the development of our world\-leading quantum error correction (QEC) solutions.


Collaborating with leading QEC researchers, quantum scientists, and software engineers, you will identify and develop innovative AI, ML and deep learning techniques that enable intelligent, adaptive, and scalable QEC tools. From early\-stage exploration and prototyping through to model development and deployment, you’ll play a key role in translating AI concepts into impactful technologies that advance quantum computing.


Operating at the forefront of quantum innovation, you will design and deliver proof\-of\-concept AI applications that inform and shape the next generation of Riverlane’s products. This is an opportunity to work on genuinely novel problems — and to help define how AI transforms the future of quantum error correction.

**Requirements**

**What we need**

* A background in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related technical field
* **At least** 2\-3 years’ experience in machine learning, deep learning and other areas of artificial intelligence (can be from industry or an academic (post\-doc) environment)
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages, preferably Python and/or C\+\+
* Knowledge of data structures and algorithms
* Proven experience working with ML frameworks such as JAX, PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.
* Solid understanding of neural network architectures e.g. transformers, CNNs, RNNs, LLMs.
* Solid understanding of training techniques (supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement)
* Experience with ML model design and optimization, including model training, evaluation, fine\-tuning, and model interpretation
* Experience with leveraging GPU or TPU acceleration for training and evaluation
* Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills
* Eligibility to work in the Netherlands without a work permit (regrettably we are unable to provide sponsorship for work permits for this position)

 **Even better if you have**

* Familiarity with quantum information theory and quantum error correction
* Experience with scientific computing and data analysis libraries, such as NumPy, SciPy, and Pandas
* Experience with cloud\-computing platforms and infrastructures (such as Google Cloud Platform, AWS, GPU\-enabled SLURM servers)
* Knowledge of parallel programming (e.g. CUDA) is a plus
* Contributions to open\-source software or publications in areas related to machine learning for quantum computing

**Benefits**

**What can you expect from us**


At Riverlane, people come first. In addition to competitive salaries, we provide a holistic range of benefits to support your wellbeing and financial security, enabling you to do your best work, while feeling supported and rewarded. Please note that benefits vary by location, but will typically include:

* An annual bonus plan
* Paid time off
* A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities
* A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets

 **How to apply**


Please upload a CV and covering letter by clicking 'Apply Now'. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the job and what skills and experience you can bring to the role.


We review CVs as we receive them and interview as soon as we have applications that look like a good match. We do not use closing dates. So, please apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this role.

  

If you have any queries, please contact jobs@riverlane.com.

 *Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity/paternity.*

*Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements. If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply \- you may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. We’d love to hear from you.*

*If you need any adjustments made to the application or selection process so you can do your best, please let us know. We will be happy to help.*

* Improve the performance of our clients'energy assets
* Build and maintain real\-time control logic
* Prototype and design scalable system architectures

* At least 3 years of proven hands\-on experience working with

* Java/Python or scripting languages (MATLAB, etc)
* Version management and proper testing
* Strong troubleshooting skills and system\-level thinking
* High level of curiosity and creative thinking

description:
As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.


**HET CREËREN VAN ESSENTIËLE CHEMIE DIE DE WERELD NODIG HEEFT**

Bij Chemours herdefiniëren onze mensen hoe de wereld naar chemie kijkt door alles wat we doen te benaderen met een toewijding aan het leveren van **Trusted Chemistry** die betere levens creëert en gemeenschappen helpt te bloeien. Dat begint bij hoe we onze wetenschap, data en ongeëvenaarde technische expertise gebruiken om marktleidende producten te ontwikkelen met de hoogste niveaus van prestaties, duurzaamheid en veiligheid in de industrie.


Aangedreven door chemie worden onze producten toegepast in toepassingen die de producten, processen en nieuwe technologieën mogelijk maken waarop we vertrouwen. In belangrijke sectoren zoals schone energie, geavanceerde elektronica, high\-performance computing en AI, koeling van datacenters, klimaatvriendelijke koeling en hoogwaardige verven en coatings voor woningen en industriële infrastructuur. Elke dag vertrouwen mensen op de chemie van Chemours voor een modernere, veiligere en duurzamere manier van leven.


Bij Chemours vind je duurzaamheid in onze visie, ons bedrijf en jouw toekomst. Als je wilt werken in de voorhoede van je vakgebied en het verschil wilt maken, kom dan werken bij Chemours en ontdek wat het betekent als we zeggen “We Are Living Chemistry”.


Van de frontlinie tot de backoffice, elke werknemer van Chemours maakt deel uit van iets dat groter is dan zichzelf. Wij zijn staan voor gelijke kansen en diversiteit en we werken actief aan een veilige werkomgeving zonder discriminatie en intimidatie. We moedigen sollicitaties aan van gekwalificeerde en geschikte kandidaten, ongeacht ras, religie of geloofsovertuiging, huidskleur, nationale of etnische afkomst, leeftijd, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), geslachtsidentiteit en/of \-expressie, seksuele geaardheid, burgerlijke staat, handicap of enige andere status.


Samen werken we aan een betere wereld door de kracht van onze chemie.


**Voor ons EHHS team locatie Dordrecht zijn wij op zoek naar een**

**(Sr / Lead ) Process Safety Engineer (M,V,X)**

Elke site is verantwoordelijk voor het identificeren, begrijpen en beheersen van de gevaren die inherent zijn aan de processen. Dit wordt gedaan om procesgerelateerde incidenten te voorkomen die gevolgen kunnen hebben voor het personeel van de fabriek, externe gemeenschappen of het milieu, of kunnen leiden tot aanzienlijk verlies van eigendommen of verlies van zaken. Het omvat de toepassing van systemen en controles op chemische en productieprocessen en maakt deel uit van ieders werk.


Bij Chemours hechten we ook veel waarde aan hoe we successen bereiken. Je bent dan ook continue bezig om je medewerkers te ontwikkelen. Enerzijds door met elkaar te werken binnen de gedragsnormen van Chemours. Anderzijds door verbetering van de samenwerking en het ontwikkelen van prestaties van de individuele teamleden. title: Senior Backend/ Data Engineer
description:
**Company Description**


NOWATCH is an Amsterdam\-based health innovation company for the curious. By blending cutting\-edge technology with the leading science around mental health, we explore the frontiers of wellbeing. The NOWATCH Awareable is our flagship product, and the first step on our journey towards helping people recover from stress quickly and enjoy more meaningful lives – because Time is NOW.


NOWATCH pioneers in the wearable market with new algorithms and sensors. Our hardware and software solution is part of a large and growing wearable industry. NOWATCH is backed by strong investors with teams in Amsterdam (NL), Oulu (Finland), Santa Barbara (USA), Djapur (INDIA). For more information, visit www.nowatch.com.

**Job Description**


We're searching for a passionate and talented **Senior Backend Developer** to design, develop, and maintain our core infrastructure, ensuring it’s robust, highly available, and capable of processing large volumes of sensitive health data daily while adhering to strict compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA/GDPR). This role operates with a privacy\-by\-design mindset, meaning security and compliance are inherent parts of the architecture, not afterthoughts.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, maintain, and enhance Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines to automate application build, test, and deployment processes.
* Design, build, and optimise high performing and scalable microservices and APIs (REST, gRPC) to ingest, process, and serve data across our applications.
* Lead the development and maintenance of high\-throughput data pipelines (ETL/ELT) using modern streaming and batch processing frameworks (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Flink).
* Architect and implement robust data security measures, including advanced encryption (in transit and at rest), anonymisation techniques, access control lists, and audit logging to ensure strict adherence to all relevant health data privacy regulations.
* Select, configure, and optimise data stores (relational, NoSQL, data warehouses) to meet the diverse needs of real\-time tracking, analytical reporting, and long\-term historical storage.
* Implement comprehensive automated monitoring, alerting, and logging strategies to maintain platform stability, performance, and operational excellence using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools.
* Mentor mid\-level engineers, driving best practices, and participating actively in code reviews and architecture discussions.

 **Qualifications**

* Over 3 years of professional experience in Backend or Full\-Stack Development, with at least 1 year focused specifically on large\-scale data engineering projects.
* Expert proficiency in Python
* Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Deep experience with message queuing and stream processing platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Kinesis) and big data processing frameworks (Apache Spark, Flink, or similar).
* Strong operational knowledge of AWS, including managed services for computing, database, and data warehousing.
* Expertise in performance tuning and schema design for both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (Cassandra, DynamoDB, MongoDB).
* Demonstrated experience in applying data privacy principles (e.g., encryption, tokenization, PII handling) and a solid understanding of regulatory frameworks like HIPAA, and GDPR.

**Good to have**

* Experience within the Health\-Tech, FinTech, or another highly regulated industry.
* Practical experience building features leveraging machine learning/AI models using production data pipelines.
* Contributions to open\-source data engineering projects.

**What we offer**

* Work experience in a global Startup Tech company with room for personal development
* The chance to be part of a young and ambitious team of internationals
* A broad scope of responsibilities through which you can learn and expand your skill set
* Apple MacBook
* NOWATCH of choice
* Flexible working hours
* Location of Amsterdam with ability to work partly from home
* Great team, culture and place to work with quarterly team days


WE AND YOU


We are a small team of very enthusiastic, hard\-working people. We go at the speed of trust and make our own rules to create the best possible environment for our team. You'll definitely fit in if you have a hands\-on and positive approach, think outside your own department, and wanna join our movement in helping people get more from each moment in life.

title: 2026 Software Dev Engineer Intern - Netherlands
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Do you want to solve real customer problems through innovative technology? Do you enjoy working on scalable services in a collaborative team environment? Do you want to see your code directly impact millions of customers worldwide?  

  

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands.  

  

Our Software Development Engineer (SDE) interns use modern technology to solve complex problems while seeing their work's impact first\-hand. The challenges SDE interns solve at Amazon are meaningful and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products globally. We seek individuals passionate about creating new products, features, and services while managing ambiguity in an environment where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years.
  

  

At Amazon, we believe in ownership at every level. As an SDE intern, you'll own the entire lifecycle of your code \- from design through deployment and ongoing operations. This ownership mindset, combined with our commitment to operational excellence, ensures we deliver the highest quality solutions for our customers.  

  

We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. At Amazon, you'll grow into the high impact engineer you know you can be, supported by a culture of learning and mentorship. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth.  

  

Amazon internships across all seasons are full\-time positions, and interns should expect to work in office, Monday\-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am\-5pm. Specific team norms around working hours will be communicated by your manager. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon workday.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Collaborate and communicate effectively with experienced cross\-disciplinary Amazonians to design, build, and operate innovative products and services that delight our customers, while participating in technical discussions to drive solutions forward.
* Design and develop scalable solutions using cloud\-native architectures and microservices in a large distributed computing environment.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical documentation.

A day in the life  

As an intern, you will be matched to a manager and a mentor and will have the opportunity to influence the evolution of Amazon technology and lead critical projects early in your career.
  

  

In addition to working on an impactful project, you will have the opportunity to engage with Amazonians for both personal and professional development, expand your network, and participate in activities with other interns throughout your internship. No matter the location of your internship, we give you the tools to own your project and learn in a real\-world setting.

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a vibrant, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.  

  

Learning Sessions:  

  

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's cutting\-edge learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.  

  

Opportunities:

title: Solution Architect “IT op de Trein”
description:
**Daarom wil je als Solution architect “IT op de Trein” bij NS werken**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* We werken met een hecht team van zo’n 65 mensen aan innovatieve oplossingen die impact hebben voor de reiziger, conducteur of machinist.
* 1,1 miljoen mensen vertrouwen elke dag op onze technologie.
* NS staat in de top 5 favoriete werkgevers van Nederland.


**Dit ga je doen als Solution architect “IT op de Trein”**
----------------------------------------------------------

Als Solution Architect werk je mee aan verschillende features. Denk hierbij aan CCTV, Real Time Monitoring, Energie Meetsystemen, etc. Tevens denk je mee rondom hardware en security vraagstukken. Ons IT\-platform op de trein (OBIS) levert diensten als reisinformatie op schermen, omroep en wifi, diagnose op afstand, telemetrie, cameratoezicht en driver\-advisory systemen.


Momenteel zijn we ver in de transitie van een monolithische aanpak van de software op de trein naar microservices en containerisatie. De informatiediensten zijn gebouwd middels publish/subscribe patronen voor communicatie onderling en met de walsystemen.


NS voorziet steeds meer treintypes met de OBIS\-software (tot aan 800 treinstellen in de nabije toekomst) en er komen steeds meer toepassingen en business logica bij die we meer en meer via een geautomatiseerde DevOps aanpak willen uitrollen. Naast de uitwerking van business vragen in een softwareoplossing zal de verdere automatisering van het voortbrengingsproces mogelijk één van de onderwerpen zijn waar je je mee bezig gaat houden.


De rol van het cluster is aan het verschuiven van software development naar integrator van oplossingen. Dit is naar aanleiding van onze nieuwe digitale strategie. Daarnaast is innovatie voor NS een belangrijk onderwerp. Nieuwe technieken zoals Edge Computing, Machine Learning/Kunstmatige Intelligentie kunnen een groot verschil maken.


Het Cluster voor OBIS “IT op de Trein” welke zich bezighoudt met OBIS Trein (Edge / IIoT) en Wal systemen (Cloud/Azure) bestaat uit meerdere teams. Als Solution Architect werk je binnen één of meer van de feature en/of platform teams en maak je onderdeel uit van het Functioneel Cluster Architectuur. Deze kern architecten geven technische sturing aan de feature en platform teams. Als Solution Architect richt je je op het ontwerpen van de architectuur ten behoeve van de oplossing of componenten daarbinnen om ervoor te zorgen dat deze oplossing/component geschikt is en blijft voor het beoogde doel. Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead Solution Architect, Technische en Feature Team Architect, Technical Leads, Developers, ISO/LISO’s, System Engineers, Product Manager, RTE, Product Owners en teams om tijdig de juiste architectuurkaders en \-richting ten behoeve van de nieuwe capabilities, business epics en enabler epics aan de teams mee te geven.


* Je zorgt samen met de andere architecten voor duidelijke architectuurkaders, passend binnen de NS\-brede IT\- en security\-kaders, en bewaakt deze. Je vertaalt deze naar concreet implementeerbare Solution Outlines, ADR's en enablers, waarbij requirements helder worden vastgelegd in Archimate en JIRA.
* Je coördineert de architectuurwerkzaamheden samen met de technical leads in de ontwikkelteams. Uiteraard borg je dat de ontwikkelteams de oplossing volgens jouw ontwerp en kaders implementeren. Ook fungeer je als vraagbaak voor de ontwikkelaars, testers en informatieanalisten van de teams.
* Je ondersteund bij het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van pentesten.
* Je ondersteund teams bij het opstellen van Controlled Security Exceptions
* Je adviseert over implementatie vraagstukken rondom security en hardware (switches, computer blades/CCU’s, boord\-wal systemen, camera’s) en zorgt dat de referentie architectuur (specificaties) bijgewerkt blijven.
* Je ondersteund bij (nieuw materieel) projecten en epics voor het OBIS\-wifi, comfort en operational support domein rondom architectuur vraagstukken van de OBIS applicaties, hardware, software en security.


We verwachten dat je in al deze werkzaamheden de producten proactief naar een volgend niveau brengt, zodat we toekomst vast en innovatief blijven.


Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie ben je een conceptueel denker, een praktisch uitvoerder en resultaatgericht.


**Hier ga je werken**
---------------------


Je gaat werken binnen het Cluster Software Desk en Platformen, onderdeel van Treindigitalisering:


Het cluster verzorgt:


* De procesbegeleiding van alle IT/OT\-softwarewijzigingen. Dit inclusief ontwikkeling en beheer van alle benodigde producten voor het onderhouden van de software zoals service laptops, wachtwoordmanagement, certificaatbeheer, etc.;
* De NS in\-huis ontwikkeling en beheer van IT\-software producten op de trein t.b.v. rijden en onderhouden van de trein en reizigerscomfort (b.v. reisinformatie trein, real time monitoring, trein positiebepaling, etc.);
* De regie, ontwikkeling en beheer van de benodigde platformen op de trein en aan de wal t.b.v. de IT/OT\-software producten. Dit behelst o.a. het IT\-platform op de trein, hardware en netwerk in de trein, boord\-wal communicatie, remote uitrol straten, testmuren en wal applicaties.


We hechten veel belang aan de Agile waarden en zijn een omgeving waar men met respect met elkaar omgaat en eigen verantwoordelijkheid, initiatief en pragmatisme verwacht en gewaardeerd wordt.


**Dit zijn de functie\-eisen**
------------------------------

* Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met materieel/treinen, hebt kennis van het Nederlandse spoorwegsysteem (rolverdeling NS\-ProRail, infradata, spoorse processen).
* Je hebt ervaring met near\-realtime datatoepassingen incl. diverse data/video en netwerkprotocollen (unicast, multicast e.d.)
* Je borgt dat de architectuurafspraken ook tijdens de implementatie worden nagekomen.
* Je beheerst de ArchiMate taal voor het beschrijven van architecturen.
* Je beheerst de SysML of UML voor het beoordelen en maken van ontwerpen.
* Je hebt ervaring met meerdere ontwerptools (zoals Sparx Enterprise Architect, Archi of ARIS).
* Je hebt kennis van Industrial IoT, AMQP, microservices, container technologie en CICD.
* Je hebt kennis van Cloud omgevingen zoals Azure of AWS.
* Je hebt kennis op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, informatiemanagement of IT\-audit en security architectuur (bv. CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CICSP, Privacywetgeving) en ervaring met risk assessments op basis van ISO 27001 of iets dergelijks is een pre.
* Je hebt idealiter enige kennis rondom trein IT\-hardware (computer blades/CCU’s, switches e.d.)
* Je hebt praktische codeer ervaring en hebt reeds ervaring als solution architect.
* Je hebt ervaring met het opstellen van functionele en technische ontwerpen.
* Je hebt ervaring met werken in een Agile omgeving en hebt de bijbehorende agile mindset.


Je begrijpt de behoeften en belangen van je stakeholders goed en communiceert helder en effectief. Je werkt altijd vanuit de doelen van de softwarefabriek en NS als geheel. Je kunt je goed inleven in de wereld van ontwikkelaars en testers en weet het verschil tussen gelijk krijgen en gelijk hebben snel te herkennen. Je bent communicatief vaardig en empathisch, met een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je werkt pragmatisch en bent gericht op het behalen van resultaten en het oplossen van problemen. Door mensen te verbinden weet je samen resultaten te boeken.


**Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------------------


Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. title: Industry X Internship
description:
**Internship details**

* **Period** \~6\-8 months (minimum of 4 months)
* **Hours a week** 40
* **Location** Accenture main office in Amsterdam, Industrial Design Innovation Center in Eindhoven (and/or The Hague)
* **Start date** 1st of each month

**The work**


At Industry X (IX) we work in the world of Research \& Development, Product Design \& Engineering, Connected Devices, Manufacturing \& Operations or Smart Services. As an intern at Industry X you will become a consultant and will join the IX intern team.

* **Team(s)**


In general, IX is a diverse and dynamic team of innovators, visionaries, and problem solvers in the fields of Engineering and Manufacturing.


You will either join PES \- Product Engineering and Servicing which focuses on the next\-generation R\&D and imagining and reinventing the future of Products and the end\-to\-end Product journey from the initial design, to managing Product Lifecycle Systems, their Sustainable Footprint and the ultimate retiring and replacement.


Or you will join M\&O \- Manufacturing and Operations which focuses on digital Manufacturing, Intelligent Asset Management and any other innovations you can find on the factory floor to provide a digital transformation at the core of Manufacturing.

* **Daily tasks**


As an intern at Industry X, you will work in collaboration with Industry X experts to conduct your thesis research and assignment in one of the relevant research areas listed below. Key is that your thesis will research challenges or opportunities we see at our clients and that new business solutions or opportunities can be defined based on the input of IX experts. During your internship you’ll connect with many Industry X colleagues from Accenture and gain valuable insight into the world of strategy \& consulting. Your work location can be at the main office in Amsterdam or the Eindhoven Industrial Design Center, where you will be required to be present at least 3 days a week.

* **Research**

**1\. Product Lifecycle Management**


Within PES – Product engineering servicing, we are currently looking for research focused on **Product Lifecycle Management (PLM).** PLM is a holistic approach to manage product design, support, and end\-life activities of a product. PLM plays a crucial role in driving efficiency, innovation, and sustainability across industries, and your research could contribute to its future evolution within the R\&D organisations of our clients.


For example, your thesis could explore how advanced AI technologies can enhance PLM processes for faster product development cycles or investigate how the user adoption of PLM could be improved through human centered design.

**2\. AI Developers**


For the PES team, we are looking for **AI developers** willing to work on the latest and greatest technology revolution currently ongoing in the market. We need AI\-savvy student that can know either C\+\+ , Python, Git (Github), Next.js (Vanilla JS, Typescript in React) in combination with embedded platforms (e.g. Arduino/ESP32 and Raspberry Pi) to work on computer vision projects or training custom models based on our client demands to create new interactive prototypes.


Two topics where you can help with are:

**2\.1\. P\&ID diagrams:** detect and identify P\&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) elements using mathematical modelling and simple machine learning models. There is a first code base to start with, you need to complete this solution end\-to\-end and demonstrate results.

**2\.2\. Business Process documentation:** convert business process documentation to a knowledge graph, using GenAI to query specific scenarios and share the outcomes.

**3\. Software Development**


We are also seeking motivated and detail\-oriented interns to join our software development team. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of high\-performance C/C\+\+ applications that drive the cutting\-edge lithography systems at ASML. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers on real\-world challenges involving system control, data processing, and performance tuning. This is an excellent opportunity for students pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are passionate about low\-level programming and advanced technology.

**4\. Infrastructure \& Capital Projects at Utilities**


Within M\&O \- Manufacturing and Operations, we are currently looking for research focused on **capital projects in utilities.** In this role, you support utilities in driving the energy transition by developing new solutions and strategies to build new infrastructure, manage grid congestion, and optimize asset performance. It’s a chance to apply your engineering skills to deliver meaningful, high\-impact solutions. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and gain valuable insights into the current and future challenges the energy sector is facing.


If you're interested in writing a thesis, possible topics range from AI applications in the utility sector to rethinking the construction process for large\-scale infrastructure projects, or topics related to the operation of the grid.

**5\. Intelligent Asset Management**


Also, within M\&O, we are looking for research focused on **Intelligent Asset Management.** You will support transforming the way our clients take care of their physical assets such as machines, buildings and equipment. You will collaborate with us to create data\-driven and intelligent solutions such as Predictive Maintenance and Asset Performance Management to improve efficiency, reduce downtime and increase sustainability while reducing maintenance costs.

**6\. GIS**

**6\.2\. Test automation:** developing a model for test automation that is directly applicable to our clients GIS systems, and that is compatible integrate with AI.

A lot of our Industry X knowledge and capabilities are highly relevant for the Health \& Life Sciences industries. We are looking for research and business development support to define where\-to\-play, map our capabilities, and support the growth of our opportunity pipeline. Within all our internships, we offer you the opportunity to develop, learn, orient, build relationships and gain insights into what it’s like to work as a consultant. At Industry X we like to do it differently. We embrace change. We reimagine. We transform. How companies design, engineer, manufacture, service and maintain their products. We embed sustainability and bring digital into every part of the company’s enterprise. We create value by strategy and design, unraveling complexities with our approach as a powerful instrument of change. Putting people and planet in the center of everything we do to add value to our clients’ businesses.


Industry X is one of five services that make up one Accenture – the others are Strategy \& Consulting, Technology, Song and Operations.


  

**Here’s what you’ll need**

* You are nearing completion of your master's at a Dutch University and are searching for work experience within the field of Industry X.

**What’s in it for you?**


Accenture is a global company with a world\-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:


1\. Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust.


2\. Embrace a sustainable growth mindset.


3\. Live a human\-led culture of Inclusion \& Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.

5\. Connect with our global network of 700\.000 colleagues.


These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:

2\. You will receive internship allowance and a laptop.


3\. The opportunity to work hybrid and access to any office of Accenture in the Netherlands.


4\. Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties.


5\. Unique chance to experience the real\-life job of a consultant Accenture from the inside


6\. Unlimited learning: access to thousands of free courses, classes and workshops.


7\. Membership of our Internship Community which will give you the chance to attend lunch lectures, classroom workshop and build your network within Accenture

**What we believe**


Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long\-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.


Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.


Accenture is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation to enable your participation in the recruitment process by emailing m.teodora@accenture.com. We will be happy to assist you.

title: Embedded Software & Hardware Engineer
description:
**Vind jij het te gek om besturingssystemen te ontwikkelen voor innovatieve machines die bijdragen aan schonere lucht?**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Jouw Rol**  

  

Als **Embedded Software \& Hardware Engineer** bij Plymovent ben jij dé specialist op het gebied van Electrical Engineering binnen ons productontwikkelingsteam. Jij weet vragen van collega’s te vertalen naar slimme en robuuste embedded oplossingen en draagt daarmee direct bij aan onze innovatieve producten.

**Wat ga je doen?**

* Ontwikkelen van robuuste, industriële embedded besturingssystemen – zowel software als hardware.
* Programmeren in o.a. Python en C\+\+, waarbij je jouw passie voor code vertaalt naar concrete toepassingen in eindproducten.
* Ontwikkelen van compleet nieuwe producten én verbeteren van bestaande ontwerpen.
* Testen en valideren van je oplossingen in onze werkplaats en tijdens veldtesten.
* Werken aan projecten binnen het E\-team van R\&D, samen met productontwerpers, ontwikkelaars én externe partners.
* Meedenken en bijdragen in alle fases van productontwikkeling: van eerste idee tot een leverbaar product.


Bij ons is geen dag hetzelfde en geen uitdaging te gek. Je krijgt de vrijheid om te pionieren, maar staat er nooit alleen voor – samen tillen we onze producten naar een hoger niveau.

**Hier herken jij jezelf in**

* Afgeronde hbo\- of wo\-opleiding Electrical Engineering of vergelijkbaar.
* Je bent net afgestudeerd of hebt tot 3 jaar ervaring met embedded elektronica (soft\- én hardware).
* Je beheerst Python en C\+\+ volledig.
* Ervaring met Industrial IoT, cloud ontwikkeling en user interfaces is een mooie pré.
* Je voelt je thuis in een mechanische omgeving en schrikt niet van complexe vraagstukken.
* Je bent zelfstandig, maar werkt ook graag samen en bent communicatief vaardig.
* Je hebt een oplossingsgerichte houding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.

**Wat wij bieden**  

  

Bij Plymovent draait alles om schone lucht op de werkvloer. Maar ook jóuw werkvloer vinden wij belangrijk. Daarom bieden wij naast een aantrekkelijk salaris (tussen **€3\.300 en €4\.400**, afhankelijk van ervaring):

* Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een werkomgeving waarin vitaliteit en plezier centraal staan:
	+ Zo hebben we een eigen gym waar sportlessen worden gegeven
	+ 2x per week vers fruit op het werk.
	+ Gezamenlijk lunchen in onze kantine
	+ Vrijdagmiddagborrels en feestjes in onze eigen bruine kroeg
	+ Opleidings\- en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen een internationale organisatie.


Pak nu je kans en maak impact: jouw werk draagt bij aan veilige, gezonde werkplekken wereldwijd.

title: Director of Product
description:
**About Us:**

**Innatera** is a rapidly growing Dutch semiconductor company that develops ultra\-efficient neuromorphic processors for AI at the edge. These microprocessors mimic the brain’s mechanisms for processing fast data streams from sensors, enabling complex turn\-key sensor analytics functionalities, with 10,000x higher performance per watt than competing solutions. Innatera's technology serves as a critical enabler for next\-generation use cases in the IoT, wearable, embedded, and automotive domains.


With over €37m in funding raised, we're scaling fast towards bringing our neuromorphic technology to billions of sensors by 2030\.  

  

**Our mission?** To make the world smarter, safer, and greener. We're not just about pushing boundaries, we're about making a difference.  

  

At Innatera we are committed to driving innovation and delivering exceptional results while creating an environment where our teams can thrive. We are a group of passionate, creative thinkers who thrive in a fast\-paced environment on challenges and are always ready to take on the next big thing.  

  

As a valued member of our team focused on making a positive impact, your unique contributions play a significant role in creating meaningful change. Working alongside a talented group of colleagues, you will experience a supportive environment that recognizes and values your life beyond the confines of work.


We’re looking for a strategic and execution\-focused **Director of Product** to own and evolve the roadmap for Innatera’s next\-generation neuromorphic AI compute platforms.


You will operate at the intersection of AI innovation, semiconductor design, embedded software, and real\-world applications. Your mission is to turn advanced internal innovation into clear product direction and market\-ready offerings that deliver real developer and customer value.


This is a hands\-on, entrepreneurial role where you will bring structure to complexity, drive alignment across teams, and shape the future of our hardware–software ecosystem.

**We will trust you with:**
---------------------------

* Own and evolve the product roadmap for Innatera’s neuromorphic AI chip platforms.
* Define product vision and translate complex innovation into a focused, executable product scope.
* Align long\-term product direction with research, neuromorphic architecture, silicon development, SDK, and applications.
* Gather and synthesise input from customers, partners, and sales/FAE to validate problems and define priorities.
* Drive strategic product definition based on application needs, developer workflows, and embedded\-AI market signals.
* Define and manage the complete product lifecycle, from early concept validation through engineering development and into GTM.
* Evaluate and prioritise opportunities using business cases, technical trade\-offs, and cross\-functional alignment.
* Build structured feedback loops that inform iteration, competitive positioning, and long\-term roadmap planning.
* Operate across Innatera's tech stack and teams.
* Shape value propositions, launch plans, messaging, and early GTM alignment.
* Support competitive analysis and differentiation strategy.
* Bring clarity and structure to complex product discussions in a fast\-paced, ambiguous environment.

**What will you need to succeed:**
----------------------------------

* 10\+ years of product management experience in semiconductors, AI chips, embedded compute, or complex HW/SW systems.
* Direct experience with embedded AI, edge AI, ML/DSP applications, or sensor\-based AI workloads (e.g., radar, audio, gesture, industrial sensing).
* Strong background in microcontrollers, SoCs, low\-power chip design, or neuromorphic/accelerator architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with software ecosystems (SDKs, APIs, developer tools, toolchains) and how software maps onto constrained hardware.
* Proven track record in hardware–software productisation cycles, ideally in automotive, wearables, IoT, industrial sensing, or other high\-volume embedded markets.
* End\-to\-end lifecycle ownership, including defining requirements, shaping architectures with engineering, enabling developers, and supporting GTM.
* Ability to translate architecture\-level innovation into PRDs, requirements, and market\-ready value propositions.
* Strong understanding of go\-to\-market strategy: customer value framing, prioritisation, segmentation, and feedback integration.
* Confident in interfacing with chip architects, research teams, firmware and SDK engineers, and customer\-facing teams.
* Excellent communication and decision\-making skills; able to synthesise complexity and drive alignment.
* Strong prioritisation instincts and problem\-solving abilities in ambiguous, resource\-constrained environments.
* Ability to extract inputs from multiple stakeholders and convert them into clear product direction.

***Nice\-to\-have:***
---------------------

* Exposure to neuromorphic computing, event\-driven processing, or on\-chip learning.
* Experience in roadmap selling, customer engagements, and early\-stage validation loops.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, system engineering tools, or requirements traceability platforms.

**Why join Innatera?**
----------------------


At Innatera, you’ll be part of a pioneering team building the next generation of brain\-inspired processors for edge AI. Your work will help bring groundbreaking technology to life, powering intelligent devices with real\-world impact, from healthcare to consumer electronics.

* Competitive salary
* Pension plan
* A flexible working environment (work\-from\-home policy, flexible working hours, advantageous holidays scheme) **Note:** We work from the office 3 days per week.
* A generous holiday scheme
* A collaborative, ambitious team with the freedom to innovate
* An inclusive culture that values openness, curiosity, and personal growth
* Office perks like fresh fruit, snacks, and an on\-site gym
* Statutory commuting/home allowance

  

From engineering and machine learning to sales and non\-engineering teams \- whatever your expertise, your contributions will shape our growth.


Whether you’re passionate about microarchitecture, excited by verification or physical design, driven by supporting operations, building strong teams, or mastering the details of accounting, we’d love to hear from you!


If you're ready to shape the future of technology with us, click **Apply** and share your story.

*Innatera is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, or other protected characteristics. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know – we’re happy to support you.*

title: Senior Software Engineer - Rust

title: Solution Architect “IT op de Trein”
description:
**Daarom wil je als Solution architect “IT op de Trein” bij NS werken**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

* We werken met een hecht team van zo’n 65 mensen aan innovatieve oplossingen die impact hebben voor de reiziger, conducteur of machinist.
* 1,1 miljoen mensen vertrouwen elke dag op onze technologie.
* NS staat in de top 5 favoriete werkgevers van Nederland.


**Dit ga je doen als Solution architect “IT op de Trein”**
----------------------------------------------------------

Als Solution Architect werk je mee aan verschillende features. Denk hierbij aan CCTV, Real Time Monitoring, Energie Meetsystemen, etc. Tevens denk je mee rondom hardware en security vraagstukken. Ons IT\-platform op de trein (OBIS) levert diensten als reisinformatie op schermen, omroep en wifi, diagnose op afstand, telemetrie, cameratoezicht en driver\-advisory systemen.


Momenteel zijn we ver in de transitie van een monolithische aanpak van de software op de trein naar microservices en containerisatie. De informatiediensten zijn gebouwd middels publish/subscribe patronen voor communicatie onderling en met de walsystemen.


NS voorziet steeds meer treintypes met de OBIS\-software (tot aan 800 treinstellen in de nabije toekomst) en er komen steeds meer toepassingen en business logica bij die we meer en meer via een geautomatiseerde DevOps aanpak willen uitrollen. Naast de uitwerking van business vragen in een softwareoplossing zal de verdere automatisering van het voortbrengingsproces mogelijk één van de onderwerpen zijn waar je je mee bezig gaat houden.


De rol van het cluster is aan het verschuiven van software development naar integrator van oplossingen. Dit is naar aanleiding van onze nieuwe digitale strategie. Daarnaast is innovatie voor NS een belangrijk onderwerp. Nieuwe technieken zoals Edge Computing, Machine Learning/Kunstmatige Intelligentie kunnen een groot verschil maken.


Het Cluster voor OBIS “IT op de Trein” welke zich bezighoudt met OBIS Trein (Edge / IIoT) en Wal systemen (Cloud/Azure) bestaat uit meerdere teams. Als Solution Architect werk je binnen één of meer van de feature en/of platform teams en maak je onderdeel uit van het Functioneel Cluster Architectuur. Deze kern architecten geven technische sturing aan de feature en platform teams. Als Solution Architect richt je je op het ontwerpen van de architectuur ten behoeve van de oplossing of componenten daarbinnen om ervoor te zorgen dat deze oplossing/component geschikt is en blijft voor het beoogde doel. Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead Solution Architect, Technische en Feature Team Architect, Technical Leads, Developers, ISO/LISO’s, System Engineers, Product Manager, RTE, Product Owners en teams om tijdig de juiste architectuurkaders en \-richting ten behoeve van de nieuwe capabilities, business epics en enabler epics aan de teams mee te geven.


* Je zorgt samen met de andere architecten voor duidelijke architectuurkaders, passend binnen de NS\-brede IT\- en security\-kaders, en bewaakt deze. Je vertaalt deze naar concreet implementeerbare Solution Outlines, ADR's en enablers, waarbij requirements helder worden vastgelegd in Archimate en JIRA.
* Je coördineert de architectuurwerkzaamheden samen met de technical leads in de ontwikkelteams. Uiteraard borg je dat de ontwikkelteams de oplossing volgens jouw ontwerp en kaders implementeren. Ook fungeer je als vraagbaak voor de ontwikkelaars, testers en informatieanalisten van de teams.
* Je ondersteund bij het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van pentesten.
* Je ondersteund teams bij het opstellen van Controlled Security Exceptions
* Je adviseert over implementatie vraagstukken rondom security en hardware (switches, computer blades/CCU’s, boord\-wal systemen, camera’s) en zorgt dat de referentie architectuur (specificaties) bijgewerkt blijven.
* Je ondersteund bij (nieuw materieel) projecten en epics voor het OBIS\-wifi, comfort en operational support domein rondom architectuur vraagstukken van de OBIS applicaties, hardware, software en security.


We verwachten dat je in al deze werkzaamheden de producten proactief naar een volgend niveau brengt, zodat we toekomst vast en innovatief blijven.


Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie ben je een conceptueel denker, een praktisch uitvoerder en resultaatgericht.


**Hier ga je werken**
---------------------


Je gaat werken binnen het Cluster Software Desk en Platformen, onderdeel van Treindigitalisering:


Het cluster verzorgt:


* De procesbegeleiding van alle IT/OT\-softwarewijzigingen. Dit inclusief ontwikkeling en beheer van alle benodigde producten voor het onderhouden van de software zoals service laptops, wachtwoordmanagement, certificaatbeheer, etc.;
* De NS in\-huis ontwikkeling en beheer van IT\-software producten op de trein t.b.v. rijden en onderhouden van de trein en reizigerscomfort (b.v. reisinformatie trein, real time monitoring, trein positiebepaling, etc.);
* De regie, ontwikkeling en beheer van de benodigde platformen op de trein en aan de wal t.b.v. de IT/OT\-software producten. Dit behelst o.a. het IT\-platform op de trein, hardware en netwerk in de trein, boord\-wal communicatie, remote uitrol straten, testmuren en wal applicaties.


We hechten veel belang aan de Agile waarden en zijn een omgeving waar men met respect met elkaar omgaat en eigen verantwoordelijkheid, initiatief en pragmatisme verwacht en gewaardeerd wordt.


**Dit zijn de functie\-eisen**
------------------------------

* Je hebt ervaring of affiniteit met materieel/treinen, hebt kennis van het Nederlandse spoorwegsysteem (rolverdeling NS\-ProRail, infradata, spoorse processen).
* Je hebt ervaring met near\-realtime datatoepassingen incl. diverse data/video en netwerkprotocollen (unicast, multicast e.d.)
* Je borgt dat de architectuurafspraken ook tijdens de implementatie worden nagekomen.
* Je beheerst de ArchiMate taal voor het beschrijven van architecturen.
* Je beheerst de SysML of UML voor het beoordelen en maken van ontwerpen.
* Je hebt ervaring met meerdere ontwerptools (zoals Sparx Enterprise Architect, Archi of ARIS).
* Je hebt kennis van Industrial IoT, AMQP, microservices, container technologie en CICD.
* Je hebt kennis van Cloud omgevingen zoals Azure of AWS.
* Je hebt kennis op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, informatiemanagement of IT\-audit en security architectuur (bv. CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CICSP, Privacywetgeving) en ervaring met risk assessments op basis van ISO 27001 of iets dergelijks is een pre.
* Je hebt idealiter enige kennis rondom trein IT\-hardware (computer blades/CCU’s, switches e.d.)
* Je hebt praktische codeer ervaring en hebt reeds ervaring als solution architect.
* Je hebt ervaring met het opstellen van functionele en technische ontwerpen.
* Je hebt ervaring met werken in een Agile omgeving en hebt de bijbehorende agile mindset.


Je begrijpt de behoeften en belangen van je stakeholders goed en communiceert helder en effectief. Je werkt altijd vanuit de doelen van de softwarefabriek en NS als geheel. Je kunt je goed inleven in de wereld van ontwikkelaars en testers en weet het verschil tussen gelijk krijgen en gelijk hebben snel te herkennen. Je bent communicatief vaardig en empathisch, met een sterk analytisch vermogen. Je werkt pragmatisch en bent gericht op het behalen van resultaten en het oplossen van problemen. Door mensen te verbinden weet je samen resultaten te boeken.


**Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden**
----------------------------------


Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. De mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen zijn groot. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:


* Een salaris tussen € 4\.357,\- en € 7\.296,\- bruto per maand (schaal 61\) (o.b.v. 36 uur \-inschaling o.b.v. werkervaring)
* 144 uur wettelijk verlof (o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband) \+ extra verlof afhankelijk van leeftijd (minimaal een week).
* De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet\-christelijke feestdagen.
* 3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
* Je treinreizen in de 2e klas zijn gratis; in de 1e klas reizen kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
* Je gezin reist gratis in de daluren.
* Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
* Professionele ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden
* Een keuzeplan met o.a. fietsenplan, extra pensioenopbouw of extra vakantiedagen.
* Wil je meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en cao.
* De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden (in overleg).
* Bij goed functioneren, krijg je na een jaar een vast contract.


**Solliciteren naar deze baan**
-------------------------------


Solliciteer directvia de sollicitatiebutton. Binnen enkele minuten ontvang je een automatische sollicitatiebevestiging, binnen 2 weken reageren wij op jouw sollicitatie.

title: Industry X Internship
description:
**Internship details**

* **Period** \~6\-8 months (minimum of 4 months)
* **Hours a week** 40
* **Location** Accenture main office in Amsterdam, Industrial Design Innovation Center in Eindhoven (and/or The Hague)
* **Start date** 1st of each month

**The work**


At Industry X (IX) we work in the world of Research \& Development, Product Design \& Engineering, Connected Devices, Manufacturing \& Operations or Smart Services. As an intern at Industry X you will become a consultant and will join the IX intern team.

* **Team(s)**


In general, IX is a diverse and dynamic team of innovators, visionaries, and problem solvers in the fields of Engineering and Manufacturing.


You will either join PES \- Product Engineering and Servicing which focuses on the next\-generation R\&D and imagining and reinventing the future of Products and the end\-to\-end Product journey from the initial design, to managing Product Lifecycle Systems, their Sustainable Footprint and the ultimate retiring and replacement.


Or you will join M\&O \- Manufacturing and Operations which focuses on digital Manufacturing, Intelligent Asset Management and any other innovations you can find on the factory floor to provide a digital transformation at the core of Manufacturing.

* **Daily tasks**


As an intern at Industry X, you will work in collaboration with Industry X experts to conduct your thesis research and assignment in one of the relevant research areas listed below. Key is that your thesis will research challenges or opportunities we see at our clients and that new business solutions or opportunities can be defined based on the input of IX experts. During your internship you’ll connect with many Industry X colleagues from Accenture and gain valuable insight into the world of strategy \& consulting. Your work location can be at the main office in Amsterdam or the Eindhoven Industrial Design Center, where you will be required to be present at least 3 days a week.

* **Research**

**1\. Product Lifecycle Management**


Within PES – Product engineering servicing, we are currently looking for research focused on **Product Lifecycle Management (PLM).** PLM is a holistic approach to manage product design, support, and end\-life activities of a product. PLM plays a crucial role in driving efficiency, innovation, and sustainability across industries, and your research could contribute to its future evolution within the R\&D organisations of our clients.


For example, your thesis could explore how advanced AI technologies can enhance PLM processes for faster product development cycles or investigate how the user adoption of PLM could be improved through human centered design.

**2\. AI Developers**


For the PES team, we are looking for **AI developers** willing to work on the latest and greatest technology revolution currently ongoing in the market. We need AI\-savvy student that can know either C\+\+ , Python, Git (Github), Next.js (Vanilla JS, Typescript in React) in combination with embedded platforms (e.g. Arduino/ESP32 and Raspberry Pi) to work on computer vision projects or training custom models based on our client demands to create new interactive prototypes.


Two topics where you can help with are:

**2\.1\. P\&ID diagrams:** detect and identify P\&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) elements using mathematical modelling and simple machine learning models. There is a first code base to start with, you need to complete this solution end\-to\-end and demonstrate results.

**2\.2\. Business Process documentation:** convert business process documentation to a knowledge graph, using GenAI to query specific scenarios and share the outcomes.

**3\. Software Development**


We are also seeking motivated and detail\-oriented interns to join our software development team. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of high\-performance C/C\+\+ applications that drive the cutting\-edge lithography systems at ASML. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers on real\-world challenges involving system control, data processing, and performance tuning. This is an excellent opportunity for students pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are passionate about low\-level programming and advanced technology.

**4\. Infrastructure \& Capital Projects at Utilities**


Within M\&O \- Manufacturing and Operations, we are currently looking for research focused on **capital projects in utilities.** In this role, you support utilities in driving the energy transition by developing new solutions and strategies to build new infrastructure, manage grid congestion, and optimize asset performance. It’s a chance to apply your engineering skills to deliver meaningful, high\-impact solutions. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and gain valuable insights into the current and future challenges the energy sector is facing.


If you're interested in writing a thesis, possible topics range from AI applications in the utility sector to rethinking the construction process for large\-scale infrastructure projects, or topics related to the operation of the grid.

**5\. Intelligent Asset Management**


Also, within M\&O, we are looking for research focused on **Intelligent Asset Management.** You will support transforming the way our clients take care of their physical assets such as machines, buildings and equipment. You will collaborate with us to create data\-driven and intelligent solutions such as Predictive Maintenance and Asset Performance Management to improve efficiency, reduce downtime and increase sustainability while reducing maintenance costs.

**6\. GIS**


Also, within M\&O, we are looking for research focused on **GIS**. We currently have an opportunity to work on two topics:

**6\.1\.Vegetation encroachment**: (further) developing a risk\-based model on where vegetation imposes potential risks to companies’ assets.

**6\.2\. Test automation:** developing a model for test automation that is directly applicable to our clients GIS systems, and that is compatible integrate with AI.

**7\. Life Sciences**


A lot of our Industry X knowledge and capabilities are highly relevant for the Health \& Life Sciences industries. We are looking for research and business development support to define where\-to\-play, map our capabilities, and support the growth of our opportunity pipeline. This is an opportunity to be very hands on and experience first hand the business development side of consulting. Collaborating with the wider Accenture Health \& Life Sciences community, this is a chance to create bridges, define new ways of working and still have the space to conduct research into the potential of technology in the Health \& Life Sciences domain. Possible topics range from IoT for hospital future readiness, AI driven pharmaceutical manufacturing, automation in hospital administration etc.


If you have a groundbreaking idea related to the abovementioned topics, whether it addresses challenges in engineering, manufacturing, or beyond, we’d love to hear about it in your motivational letter. While our primary focus is on the abovementioned topics, feel free to suggest a related topic if you believe it aligns with our goals.


For more detailed information about research opportunities, please contact btissame.saouti@accenture.com. We look forward to hearing your ideas and welcoming your contribution!


Interested? Please apply with your CV and cover letter with your preference for a topic. If you have a portfolio, please also include that.


Within all our internships, we offer you the opportunity to develop, learn, orient, build relationships and gain insights into what it’s like to work as a consultant. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your work as well as your academical needs and happy to help you navigate in the beginning of your career. Therefore, within our recruiting process, we are highly interested in your motivation and academical interest.

**Who we are – Accenture Industry X**

**Accenture Industry X**


At Industry X we like to do it differently. We embrace change. We reimagine. We transform. How companies design, engineer, manufacture, service and maintain their products. We embed sustainability and bring digital into every part of the company’s enterprise. We create value by strategy and design, unraveling complexities with our approach as a powerful instrument of change. The way we do so is by designing and engineering products, platforms and services that build bridges between users, technology and business needs. Putting people and planet in the center of everything we do to add value to our clients’ businesses.


Industry X is one of five services that make up one Accenture – the others are Strategy \& Consulting, Technology, Song and Operations.


  

**Here’s what you’ll need**

* You are nearing completion of your master's at a Dutch University and are searching for work experience within the field of Industry X.
* You have a passion for new Technologies in the field of Engineering or Manufacturing and are eager to work on these from either strategic/consulting side or technology/developer side.
* You speak fluent English and/or Dutch (spoken and written).
* You’re interested in starting a career in the field of consulting and digital business transformations.
* You are a team player; you are professional and precise.
* You can work independently and have a hands\-on proactive mentality.
* Please upload a **cover letter** with your preference for a topic (in the attachment field where you upload your CV)

**What’s in it for you?**


Accenture is a global company with a world\-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:


1\. Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust.


2\. Embrace a sustainable growth mindset.


3\. Live a human\-led culture of Inclusion \& Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.


4\. Lead and transform our clients with technology.


5\. Connect with our global network of 700\.000 colleagues.


These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:


1\. Career guidance facilitated by your individual appointed People Lead.


2\. You will receive internship allowance and a laptop.


3\. The opportunity to work hybrid and access to any office of Accenture in the Netherlands.


4\. Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties.


5\. Unique chance to experience the real\-life job of a consultant Accenture from the inside


6\. Unlimited learning: access to thousands of free courses, classes and workshops.


7\. Membership of our Internship Community which will give you the chance to attend lunch lectures, classroom workshop and build your network within Accenture

**What we believe**


Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long\-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.


Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.


Accenture is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation to enable your participation in the recruitment process by emailing m.teodora@accenture.com. We will be happy to assist you.
