title: Industry X Internship
description:
**Internship details**

* **Period** \~6\-8 months (minimum of 4 months)
* **Hours a week** 40
* **Location** Accenture main office in Amsterdam, Industrial Design Innovation Center in Eindhoven (and/or The Hague)
* **Start date** 1st of each month

**The work**


At Industry X (IX) we work in the world of Research \& Development, Product Design \& Engineering, Connected Devices, Manufacturing \& Operations or Smart Services. As an intern at Industry X you will become a consultant and will join the IX intern team.

* **Team(s)**


In general, IX is a diverse and dynamic team of innovators, visionaries, and problem solvers in the fields of Engineering and Manufacturing.


You will either join PES \- Product Engineering and Servicing which focuses on the next\-generation R\&D and imagining and reinventing the future of Products and the end\-to\-end Product journey from the initial design, to managing Product Lifecycle Systems, their Sustainable Footprint and the ultimate retiring and replacement.


Or you will join M\&O \- Manufacturing and Operations which focuses on digital Manufacturing, Intelligent Asset Management and any other innovations you can find on the factory floor to provide a digital transformation at the core of Manufacturing.

* **Daily tasks**


As an intern at Industry X, you will work in collaboration with Industry X experts to conduct your thesis research and assignment in one of the relevant research areas listed below. Key is that your thesis will research challenges or opportunities we see at our clients and that new business solutions or opportunities can be defined based on the input of IX experts. During your internship you’ll connect with many Industry X colleagues from Accenture and gain valuable insight into the world of strategy \& consulting. Your work location can be at the main office in Amsterdam or the Eindhoven Industrial Design Center, where you will be required to be present at least 3 days a week.

* **Research**

**1\. Product Lifecycle Management**


Within PES – Product engineering servicing, we are currently looking for research focused on **Product Lifecycle Management (PLM).** PLM is a holistic approach to manage product design, support, and end\-life activities of a product. PLM plays a crucial role in driving efficiency, innovation, and sustainability across industries, and your research could contribute to its future evolution within the R\&D organisations of our clients.


For example, your thesis could explore how advanced AI technologies can enhance PLM processes for faster product development cycles or investigate how the user adoption of PLM could be improved through human centered design.

**2\. AI Developers**


For the PES team, we are looking for **AI developers** willing to work on the latest and greatest technology revolution currently ongoing in the market. We need AI\-savvy student that can know either C\+\+ , Python, Git (Github), Next.js (Vanilla JS, Typescript in React) in combination with embedded platforms (e.g. Arduino/ESP32 and Raspberry Pi) to work on computer vision projects or training custom models based on our client demands to create new interactive prototypes.


Two topics where you can help with are:

**2\.1\. P\&ID diagrams:** detect and identify P\&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) elements using mathematical modelling and simple machine learning models. There is a first code base to start with, you need to complete this solution end\-to\-end and demonstrate results.

**2\.2\. Business Process documentation:** convert business process documentation to a knowledge graph, using GenAI to query specific scenarios and share the outcomes.

**3\. Software Development**


We are also seeking motivated and detail\-oriented interns to join our software development team. In this role, you will contribute to the design, development, and optimization of high\-performance C/C\+\+ applications that drive the cutting\-edge lithography systems at ASML. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers on real\-world challenges involving system control, data processing, and performance tuning. This is an excellent opportunity for students pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are passionate about low\-level programming and advanced technology.

**4\. Infrastructure \& Capital Projects at Utilities**


Within M\&O \- Manufacturing and Operations, we are currently looking for research focused on **capital projects in utilities.** In this role, you support utilities in driving the energy transition by developing new solutions and strategies to build new infrastructure, manage grid congestion, and optimize asset performance. It’s a chance to apply your engineering skills to deliver meaningful, high\-impact solutions. You'll collaborate with experienced engineers and gain valuable insights into the current and future challenges the energy sector is facing.


If you're interested in writing a thesis, possible topics range from AI applications in the utility sector to rethinking the construction process for large\-scale infrastructure projects, or topics related to the operation of the grid.

**5\. Intelligent Asset Management**


Also, within M\&O, we are looking for research focused on **Intelligent Asset Management.** You will support transforming the way our clients take care of their physical assets such as machines, buildings and equipment. You will collaborate with us to create data\-driven and intelligent solutions such as Predictive Maintenance and Asset Performance Management to improve efficiency, reduce downtime and increase sustainability while reducing maintenance costs.

**6\. GIS**


Also, within M\&O, we are looking for research focused on **GIS**. We currently have an opportunity to work on two topics:

**6\.1\.Vegetation encroachment**: (further) developing a risk\-based model on where vegetation imposes potential risks to companies’ assets.

**6\.2\. Test automation:** developing a model for test automation that is directly applicable to our clients GIS systems, and that is compatible integrate with AI.

**7\. Life Sciences**


A lot of our Industry X knowledge and capabilities are highly relevant for the Health \& Life Sciences industries. We are looking for research and business development support to define where\-to\-play, map our capabilities, and support the growth of our opportunity pipeline. This is an opportunity to be very hands on and experience first hand the business development side of consulting. Collaborating with the wider Accenture Health \& Life Sciences community, this is a chance to create bridges, define new ways of working and still have the space to conduct research into the potential of technology in the Health \& Life Sciences domain. Possible topics range from IoT for hospital future readiness, AI driven pharmaceutical manufacturing, automation in hospital administration etc.


If you have a groundbreaking idea related to the abovementioned topics, whether it addresses challenges in engineering, manufacturing, or beyond, we’d love to hear about it in your motivational letter. While our primary focus is on the abovementioned topics, feel free to suggest a related topic if you believe it aligns with our goals.


For more detailed information about research opportunities, please contact btissame.saouti@accenture.com. We look forward to hearing your ideas and welcoming your contribution!


Interested? Please apply with your CV and cover letter with your preference for a topic. If you have a portfolio, please also include that.


Within all our internships, we offer you the opportunity to develop, learn, orient, build relationships and gain insights into what it’s like to work as a consultant. **Here’s what you’ll need**

* You are nearing completion of your master's at a Dutch University and are searching for work experience within the field of Industry X.
* You have a passion for new Technologies in the field of Engineering or Manufacturing and are eager to work on these from either strategic/consulting side or technology/developer side.
* You speak fluent English and/or Dutch (spoken and written).
* You’re interested in starting a career in the field of consulting and digital business transformations.
* You are a team player; you are professional and precise.
* You can work independently and have a hands\-on proactive mentality.
* Please upload a **cover letter** with your preference for a topic (in the attachment field where you upload your CV)

**What’s in it for you?**


Accenture is a global company with a world\-class brand and reputation. Our people are Change Makers, and to support them as an employer, we make five promises:


1\. Work with flexibility, in a culture based on trust.


2\. Embrace a sustainable growth mindset.


3\. Live a human\-led culture of Inclusion \& Diversity by caring deeply for all our people.


4\. Lead and transform our clients with technology.


5\. Connect with our global network of 700\.000 colleagues.


These promises are reflected through our excellent employee benefits, including:


1\. Career guidance facilitated by your individual appointed People Lead.


2\. You will receive internship allowance and a laptop.


3\. The opportunity to work hybrid and access to any office of Accenture in the Netherlands.


4\. Social activities like Friday Drinks, sport events and parties.


5\. Unique chance to experience the real\-life job of a consultant Accenture from the inside


6\. Unlimited learning: access to thousands of free courses, classes and workshops.


7\. Membership of our Internship Community which will give you the chance to attend lunch lectures, classroom workshop and build your network within Accenture

**What we believe**


Accenture is an equal opportunity employer. Our leaders are committed to building a better, stronger and more equitable company for future generations to create positive, long\-lasting change. Inclusion and diversity are fundamental to our culture and core values. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our rich diversity makes us more innovative and creative, which helps us better serve our clients and our communities.


Our position as partner to many of the world’s leading businesses, organizations and governments affords us both an extraordinary opportunity and a tremendous responsibility to make a difference. Sustainability is one of our greatest responsibilities, which we embed it into everything we do and for everyone we work with.

title: PLC engineer
description:
Als PLC Programmeur ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het zelfstandig ontwikkelen van besturingssoftware voor diverse merken PLC’s, microcontrollers en SCADA\-systemen!

**Functieomschrijving**
-----------------------


Je vertaalt klantwensen en functionele specificaties naar een technisch ontwerp en werkt dit uit tot een solide softwareoplossing. Het werk vindt deels plaats op kantoor en deels bij klanten op locatie, waardoor je zowel conceptueel als praktisch bijdraagt aan het eindresultaat.


In deze rol houd je je bezig met het opstellen van I/O\-lijsten en het uitvoeren van technische analyses op basis van de informatie die je van klanten ontvangt. Je ontwikkelt besturingssoftware (PLC/HMI) volgens de afgesproken specificaties en zorgt ervoor dat deze voorafgaand aan de inbedrijfstelling uitgebreid wordt getest en gesimuleerd. Vervolgens ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inbedrijfstelling bij klanten, waarbij je ongeveer negentig procent van de projecten in Nederland uitvoert en tien procent internationaal. Daarnaast schrijf je duidelijke gebruikershandleidingen, werk je intensief samen met collega’s uit andere technische disciplines en lever je een actieve bijdrage aan innovaties en ontwikkelingen op het gebied van Smart Industry 4\.0\.

**Wat wordt geboden:**
----------------------

* Een vaste baan met uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd.
* Mogelijkheid tot parttime werken (minimaal 32 uur).
* Arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de CAO Metaal \& Techniek.
* 38 vrije dagen (25 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV\-dagen bij fulltime dienstverband).
* Een salaris tussen €3\.900 en €6\.300 bruto per maand (op basis van 38 uur).
* Volledige vergoeding van zakelijke reisuren en overuren.
* Mogelijkheid om één dag per week vanuit huis te werken.

**Jouw profiel:**
-----------------

* Je hebt een afgeronde hbo\-opleiding in Elektrotechniek, Technische Informatica, HBO\-ICT of een vergelijkbare richting.
* Minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als PLC Programmeur; ervaring in de machinebouw is een sterke pré.
* Bekend met ten minste één PLC\-platform (bijv. Siemens, Rockwell, Omron of Beckhoff).
* Pré: kennis van industriële communicatieprotocollen (zoals Profinet, Modbus of CAN\-bus) en databases (SQL).
* Pré: ervaring met programmeertalen zoals C, C\# of Python.
* Goede beheersing van zowel Nederlands als Engels in woord en geschrift.
* Bereid om te reizen voor projecten, zowel nationaal als incidenteel internationaal (met vergoeding).

**Wat kun je verwachten?**
--------------------------


Je start met een contract van zeven maanden (inclusief een proeftijd van één maand) met de intentie om dit te verlengen naar een vast dienstverband. Binnen het bedrijf wordt veel waarde gehecht aan duurzaamheid en innovatie, en er is ruimte om jouw ideeën hierin mee te nemen.


Interesse? Neem dan contact op met Mitchell via de sollicitatiebutton.

title: Field Application Engineer - Industrial Automation
description:
**Company Description** **About Delta**

Delta, founded in 1971, and listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange (code:2308\), is a global leader in switching power supplies and thermal management products with a thriving portfolio of IoT\-based smart energy\-saving systems and solutions in the fields of industrial automation, building automation, telecom power, data center infrastructure, EV charging, renewable energy, energy storage and display, to nurture the development of smart manufacturing and sustainable cities. As a world\-class corporate citizen guided by its mission statement, “To provide innovative, clean and energy\-efficient solutions for a better tomorrow,” Delta leverages its core competence in high\-efficiency power electronics and its ESG\-embedded business model to address key environmental issues, such as climate change. Delta serves customers through its sales offices, R\&D centers and manufacturing facilities spread over close to 200 locations across 5 continents.


Throughout its history, Delta has received various global awards and recognition for its business achievements, innovative technologies and dedication to ESG. Since 2011, Delta has been listed on the Dow Jones Best\-in\-Class World Index (formerly the DJSI World Index of Dow Jones Sustainability™ Indices) for 14 consecutive years. Delta has also won CDP with double A List for 4 times for its substantial contribution to climate change and water security issues and has been named Supplier Engagement Leader for its continuous development of a sustainable value chain for 7 consecutive years.


For detailed information about Delta, please visit: www.delta\-emea.com

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Field Application Engineer (FAE) to support our industrial automation product, including **PLC (Programmable Logic Controllers), HMI (Human\-Machine Interfaces), and Remote I/O solutions**. The FAE will serve as a technical expert, providing pre\-sales support, application consulting, and post\-sales assistance to ensure successful customer adoption and satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide **technical support** for PLC, HMI, and Remote I/O products, including system design, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with the sales team to deliver **pre\-sales technical presentations, product demonstrations, and proof\-of\-concept testing**.
* Offer **application consulting** and recommend solutions tailored to customer requirements.
* Conduct **product training** for customers, partners, and internal teams.
* Support customers during **project implementation**, ensuring proper integration and optimization of automation systems.
* Collect customer feedback and work closely with R\&D and product management to improve products and solutions.
* Participate in **trade shows, seminars, and technical workshops** to promote company solutions.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Master’s degree in **Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering**, or related field.
* Solid knowledge of **industrial control systems, automation architecture, and networking (Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, Modbus, etc.)**.
* Hands\-on experience with **PLC programming, HMI design software, and Remote I/O configuration**.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot hardware/software issues in automation environments.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites as required.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with major PLC/HMI platforms.
* Familiarity with **SCADA, IIoT, and Industry 4\.0 applications**.
* Prior customer\-facing or technical support experience.

title: Senior OT Architect
description:
From smart energy grids to advanced sustainable technologies, our specialists in digital and operational technology continuously push the boundaries of technological innovation.


Discover a career full of challenges and impact, where you will work as OT Architect on groundbreaking energy transition projects, become part of multidisciplinary, international teams, and contribute daily to the sustainability of our energy supply. You'll receive ample opportunities for personal and professional development, immersing yourself in transformative technological challenges. Become part of our mission to fundamentally transform the energy sector and make a real difference with innovative technological solutions! Join a team of forward\-thinking professionals who are reshaping the future of energy, one breakthrough at a time.


At Capgemini Engineering, a leading global technology and engineering partner, we combine the expertise of engineers, scientists, and architects to develop the most cutting\-edge energy solutions.


**YOUR ROLE**
As an OT Architect at Capgemini Engineering with deep expertise in operational technology and a strong focus on the energy sector, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and securing complex OT systems for energy and utility environments supporting the energy industry, especially as more and more investments are made in green energy sources. These investments pose new challenges for smart grid management. Capgemini Engineering is at the forefront of providing expertise in complex systems as part of the future smart grid. The project location is in the region of Arnhem.




In this role, you will:


* Design and develop comprehensive OT architecture strategies for energy infrastructure.
* Develop and implement strategic roadmaps for OT technology integration across multi\-disciplinary environments.
* Conduct detailed technical assessments of existing OT ecosystems, identifying optimization opportunities and potential modernization strategies.
* Develop and maintain reference architectures for domain specific control networks, ensuring compliance with domain specific standards and best practices.
* Support digital transformation initiatives by integrating advanced analytics, machine learning, and predictive maintenance technologies into OT infrastructure.
* Evaluate and recommend industrial automation technologies, control systems, and networking solutions.
* Develop integration strategies between IT and OT systems.
* Provide technical guidance on OT system migrations, upgrades, and legacy system modernization.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on OT transformation projects.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align OT architecture with broader business and operational objectives.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, architectural blueprints, and system design specifications.
**WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE**
At Capgemini Engineering, we offer a dynamic, collaborative environment where innovation is central and everyone feels welcome:

* Permanent contract from day one.
* A salary package which includes a base salary, mobility budget, 8% holiday allowance, non\-contributory pension, home\-office allowance, a connectivity compensation and a variable bonus.
* Training, certifications, and career development programs tailored to your interests.
* 26 vacation days, with the option to purchase additional leave.
* The possibility to work 40, 36, 32 hours per week, for maximum flexibility and a healthy work\-life balance.
* Work on projects with social impact.
* An inclusive culture where your ideas matter.
**YOUR PROFILE**
You are a seasoned OT architect with over a decade of experience, preferably in the energy or utility sectors. Your track record of successful OT transformation projects speaks to your ability to deliver innovation with confidence.


To succeed in this role, you should have:


* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in OT architecture, specifically in renwable energy/utility sectors.
* Deep understanding of ICS/ Energy Management Systems.
* Advanced knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g., Telemetry protocols like IEC\-60870\-5\-104/101 and IEC\-61850, Profinet, Modbus, OPC UA, EtherNet/IP).
* Comprehensive understanding of industrial automation, Energy Management (EMS) platforms (e.g. AspenTech, Siemens, Rockwell, ABB, Schneider Electric, GE Vernova).
* Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity principles and standards, Familiarity with industry standards like NIST, IEC 62443\.
* Familiarity with Industry 4\.0 and digital transformation technologies.
**NOTE**
To safeguard the security and integrity within our organization, an identity check and background screening are part of the onboarding process.

At Capgemini, we believe in a work environment where everyone feels valued for who they are. Inclusion is in our DNA and is essential for our long\-term performance. title: Condition Monitoring Engineer
description:
I\-care is the global leader in predictive and prescriptive maintenance. Our AI\-powered and data driven condition monitoring solutions predict industrial failures before anyone else. With our innovative methods, products and services, we take care of over 500\.000 of assets and processes of clients around the world, helping them reduce risks for safer, more efficient, and more sustainable manufacturing. Founded in 2004 and based in Belgium, I\-care employs over 1000 people and has offices in more than 20 countries (Europe, USA, and Asia). It was named Business of the Year 2020\.


### **Condition Monitoring Engineer**


As a Condition Monitoring Engineer, you’ll play a crucial role in preventing breakdowns, saving energy, and improving efficiency in critical industrial processes. By combining hands\-on inspections with remote monitoring and smart data analysis, you’ll help global companies build more reliable operations. Along the way, you’ll receive dedicated training and grow into a trusted expert in Condition Monitoring.


Your responsibilities include:


* Learn to perform vibration measurements and inspections on rotating equipment: turbines, pumps, fans, motors, gearboxes...
* Working with state\-of\-the\-art technologies such as:
	+ Online vibration monitoring with wireless and continuous systems
	+ Remote condition monitoring through advanced data analysis
* Conducting Root Cause Analyses and proposing corrective actions
* Progressing towards becoming an expert in Condition Monitoring through a personalized training program

### **Who are we looking for?**


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electromechanics, Mechatronics, Process Technology, or a related field
* A strong passion for condition monitoring, Industry 4\.0, and smart data analysis
* Experience and certification in Vibration Analysis is a big plus but not a requirement
* Eager to learn, analytical, and a strong team player
* Excellent knowledge of English is required
* You work from our office in Waalwijk, Emmen or Beek

### **What we offer**


* A tailor\-made training program with both theoretical and hands\-on learning
* Coaching from experienced Condition Monitoring Engineers
* The opportunity to work with the latest Industry 4\.0 and remote asset monitoring technologies
* An innovative, dynamic, and international work environment
* A comprehensive compensation package, including:
	+ Company car
	+ Mobile phone and home internet coverage
	+ Extra vacation days (ADV and seniority leave)
	+ Flexible working hours
	+ Bonus scheme

Ready to make an impact? Apply today and start your career in condition monitoring at I\-care Group!

title: Developer Smart Industry
description:
Heb jij al flink wat ervaring als PLC en SCADA engineer in de industrie en ben je op zoek naar de volgende stap? Zijn begrippen als Docker, Virtualisering en MQTT jou bekend? Of heb je mogenlijk zelfs al ervaring in het Ignition SCADA platform? Dan is deze vacature iets voor jou.


* Jij zorgt dat alles klopt tot achter de komma
* Jij bepaalt jouw eigen groeipad
* Werk in een hecht en vast team

**Lever top kwaliteit**
-----------------------


Als developer bij Smart Industry kun je deze kennis combineren met jouw eigen creativiteit en nieuwschierigheid. De projecten waar je aan werkt zijn divers én je krijgt de vrijheid het volledige traject van ontwerp tot oplevering zelfstandig op te pakken.



De ene dag zit je me een klant om tafel om na te denken over een ontwerp voor een nieuwe planningstool of custom energie management systeem en de volgende dag help je mee aan het inrichten van de benodigde infrastructuur om een klant te helpen met de stap van industrie 3\.0 naar 4\.0\. Dit alles in samenwerking met een hecht team van developers met kennis binnen alle gebieden van de industrie: van PLC engineering tot OT\-Cybesecurity en AI \& Machine Learning. Waar ga jij je mee bezig houden:


* Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt én implementeerd oplossingen in de wereld van PLC/SCADA én bovenliggende systemen.
* Je richt betrouwbare, high\-availability omgevingen in voor het hosten van jouw applicaties.
* Je werkt aan uiteenlopende projecten: van het faciliteren van data\-uitwisseling tussen batterijsystemen en windparken tot het bouwen van custom receptbeheersystemen en planningtools.
* Je combineert jouw technische kennis met klantcontact en commercieel meedenken én, wanneer je hier klaar voor bent, het coachen van junior engineers.
* Je werkt niet per se aan de grootste projecten, maar juist aan projecten die nieuw en innovatief zijn, waarbij jouw creativiteit écht telt.


**Leeft techniek in jou?**
--------------------------


Jij hoeft hierbij zelf ook zeker nog niet alle kennis in huis te hebben. Een goede basis in PLC/SCADA én leergierigheid, enthousiasme en creatieviteit zijn een must, de rest kunnen we jou bij helpen. Verder heb je;


* Een afgeronde opleiding in Engineering, Elektrotechniek of IT.
* Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
* 4\+ jaar ervaring met PLC/SCADA is een must.

description:
### **HYPRSPACE**

#### **POWERING AEROSPACE FUTURE WITH THE NEXTGEN PROPULSION TECHNOLOGY**

  

At HyPrSpace, our mission is clear: to make advanced propulsion technology affordable and accessible for a wide array of applications, from civilian to defense. With our pioneering hybrid rocket engine, we're introducing a new era of aerospace capabilities—more efficient, cost\-effective, safer, and sustainable. This journey goes far beyond the realms of ordinary rocket engineering. We're laying the foundational stones for applications that will protect, enrich or expand human life, both on Earth and beyond.


By stepping into HyPrSpace, you're not just taking on a role; you're embracing a mission where your expertise, creativity, and determination unlock unprecedented realms of possibilities.


Your mission will directly contribute to enhance the versatility and applicability of our systems. Are you ready to take your career to new heights with HyPrSpace? Send your resume and let us know what ignites your passion for space, and why the HyPrSpace mission resonates with you!

  

About your role :
  

As a Trajectory Optimization Intern, you will join our Mission Design \& Flight Dynamics team to help design, simulate, and optimize multi\-phase launch vehicle trajectories for precise orbital insertion. This includes optimizing each mission segment — first stage ascent, second stage ascent, and final orbit, ensuring optimal performance and robustness across all phases. An internal optimization method already exists. Your primary mission will be to significantly reduce its computation time while maintaining accuracy and robustness.


You’ll evolve hand\-in\-hand with mission analysts and guidance engineers to develop efficient, feasible, and high\-performance flight profiles for our launch vehicles Baguette One and OB\-1\. This is an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience in high\-stakes space mission design, applying advanced optimization techniques to real\-world, multi\-phase launch scenarios.


Your key responsibilities :
  

* Develop, implement, and significantly reduce the computation time of the existing in\-house trajectory optimization method for multi\-phase launch trajectories.
* Perform mission analysis to define orbital insertion requirements for each flight phase.

Simulate ascent and orbital phases (first stage, second stage, transfer burns) using in\-house and industry\-standard tools.
  

* Analyze trade\-offs between performance, robustness, and mission constraints across all phases.
* Document and present your work to support mission reviews and decision\-making.
* Collaborate with GNC, propulsion, and systems engineering teams to ensure optimized trajectories are technically feasible.
* Participate in validation campaigns and sensitivity analyses to assess mission robustness.

What and who we are looking for:
  

You are an aspiring aerospace engineer passionate about space mission design, numerical optimization, and the challenges of multi\-phase trajectory planning.


Core qualifications, skills and mindset:
  

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree student in Aerospace Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  

Solid foundation in orbital mechanics and astrodynamics.
  

Proficiency in a scientific programming language (Python, MATLAB or C\+\+).
  

Familiarity with numerical optimization techniques: Direct Shooting Method, Indirect Shooting Method (Pontryagin’s Maximum Principle etc).
  

Understanding of launch vehicle performance metrics and constraints. Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and problem\-solving skills.
  

Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.
  

Bonus points if you have: Experience with parallel computing or GPU acceleration for optimization.


Why joint us ?
  

* Work on real\-world, multi\-phase space mission trajectory optimization problems.
* Gain hands\-on experience with cutting\-edge optimization and simulation tools.
* Collaborate with passionate engineers working towards ambitious spaceflight goals.

Why HyPrSpace could be tailormade for you?
  

* The crew: Join the ranks of \#SpaceBakers, our collaborative, committed and fun team, not just making rockets but baking history...
* The impact: Contribute to our projects, lead the charge in next\-gen technological advancements, starting at an early\-stage of development, leaving a trailblazer’s mark on space or defense applications.
* The innovation: Immerse yourself in an environment where innovation thrives, and your groundbreaking ideas fuel our journey forward.
* The growth: Embark on an unmatched journey of skill and competency development, learning and evolving rapidly through our experimental and iterative approach.
* The lifestyle: Benefit of competitive remuneration, flexible working arrangements, a workplace at the heart of the aerospace and defense cluster, and enjoy the Bordeaux lifestyle—between city center, vineyards and ocean.
  

Chez HyPrSpace, notre mission est claire : rendre la technologie de propulsion avancée abordable et accessible pour un large éventail d'applications, du civil à la défense. En rejoignant HyPrSpace, vous ne vous contentez pas d'assumer un rôle, vous embrassez une mission où votre expertise, votre créativité et votre détermination ouvrent des possibilités sans précédent.


Votre mission contribuera directement à améliorer la polyvalence et l'applicabilité de nos systèmes. Êtes\-vous prêt à donner un nouvel élan à votre carrière avec HyPrSpace ? Envoyez\-nous votre CV et dites\-nous ce qui vous passionne dans l'espace et pourquoi la mission HyPrSpace vous interpelle !


À propos de votre rôle : en tant que stagiaire en optimisation de trajectoire, vous rejoindrez notre équipe Mission Design \& Flight Dynamics afin d'aider à concevoir, simuler et optimiser les trajectoires des lanceurs à plusieurs phases pour une insertion orbitale précise. Il s'agit d'une opportunité :

* Analyser les compromis entre les performances, la robustesse et les contraintes de mission à toutes les phases,

L'entreprise est basée au cœur du pôle aéronautique et défense, a proximité immédiate de Bordeaux, accessible en transport en commun. Vous bénéficierez de la qualité de vie du Sud\-Ouest, entre centre\-ville, vignobles et océan!

title: Additive Manufacturing Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


Es\-tu un(e) ingénieur(e) en Intelligence Artificielle et Apprentissage Automatique (IA/ML) expérimenté(e), passionné(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats, prêt(e) à stimuler l’innovation dans le domaine crucial de la transmission d’énergie ?  

  

Nous recherchons une personne talentueuse pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d’IA/ML de pointe qui optimiseront nos opérations, amélioreront les performances de nos produits et ouvriront de nouvelles opportunités au sein de notre division Power Transmission (PT).  

  

Dans ce rôle essentiel, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la transformation des défis métier en solutions innovantes basées sur l’IA. Tu contribueras à l’ensemble du cycle de vie de l’IA/ML, depuis la génération des concepts initiaux et leur évaluation rigoureuse, jusqu’au développement de preuves de concept (PoC) et de produits minimum viables (MVP), puis à l’intégration à grande échelle des solutions d’IA dans nos infrastructures critiques.  

  

Si tu t’épanouis dans un environnement collaboratif et interdisciplinaire, et que tu possèdes un solide mélange d’expertise en IA/ML et de compétences en gestion de projet, nous t’encourageons à postuler pour contribuer à façonner l’avenir de l’énergie.  

  

Are you an experienced, passionate, and results\-oriented Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineer ready to drive innovation in the critical field of Power Transmission? We are seeking a talented individual to design, develop, and deploy cutting\-edge AI/ML solutions that optimize our operations, enhance product performance, and unlock new opportunities within our Power Transmission business (PT). In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in transforming business challenges into innovative AI\-driven solutions. You'll contribute across the entire AI/ML lifecycle, from initial concept generation and rigorous assessment, through the development of proofs\-of\-concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), to the full\-scale activation and integration of AI solutions into our critical infrastructure. If you thrive in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment and possess a strong blend of AI/ML expertise and project leadership, we encourage you to apply and help shape the future of energy.**Job Description**
===================

* **Strategic Opportunity Identification**: Collaborate closely with Power Transmission business units and stakeholders to proactively identify and evaluate high\-impact opportunities for AI/ML application. Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable, and innovative AI\-driven concepts.
* **End\-to\-End AI/ML Development**: Lead the design, development, validation, and optimization of AI/ML models, proofs of concept (PoCs), and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs). This includes data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, training, and robust evaluation.
* **Solution Deployment \& Integration**: Drive the deployment, integration, and scaling of AI/ML solutions into production environments, both in the cloud and at the edge, ensuring seamless operation and alignment with strategic organizational objectives.
* **Stakeholder Partnership**: Act as a key technical partner to cross\-functional project teams, guiding them through the potentials and limitations of AI/ML to effectively address specific business challenges.
* **Technical Excellence \& Best Practices**: Contribute to the development and maintenance of comprehensive technical documentation, model reporting, and knowledge sharing initiatives. Champion MLOps principles and foster best practices for AI/ML development, deployment, and monitoring.
* **Continuous Learning**: Stay updated of the latest advancements, research, and emerging technologies in AI/ML, bringing innovative approaches and tools to our projects.
* **Required Qualifications**

* **Programming Expertise**: Strong proficiency in Python, including libraries for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) and machine learning (e.g., scikit\-learn).

**ML Frameworks \& MLOps**: Hands\-on experience with major ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras. Solid understanding and practical application of MLOps principles for model lifecycle management, versioning, testing, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).

**Deployment Experience**: Proven ability to deploy and manage AI/ML models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure) and/or on edge devices for real\-time applications.

**Core AI/ML \& Statistics**: Deep understanding of a wide range of AI/ML algorithms and statistical techniques, including supervised learning (regression, classification), unsupervised learning (clustering, dimensionality reduction), time series analysis, and advanced statistical modeling.

**Data Handling**: Experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL) and working with various data sources, including structured and unstructured data.

**Data Visualization**: Proficiency with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib) to effectively communicate model performance, insights, and validation results to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* **Desired Qualifications**
* **Advanced AI/ML Techniques:** Experience with deep learning architectures, Natural Language Processing (NLP), or Reinforcement Learning. **Generative AI Technologies:** Practical experience with the integration of Vision Models, Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in AI solutions. Experience of Agentic frameworks and Model context protocols
* **Domain Knowledge:**
* Previous experience in the Power Transmission business and good understanding of our products **Additional Languages:** Proficiency in other programming languages such as R, C\#, or C\+\+
* **Soft Skills \& Attributes**
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Exceptional ability to work effectively and collaboratively within diverse, cross\-functional teams and with external partners. **Communication \& Presentation:** Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and prepare clear, concise documentation. **Problem\-Solving \& Critical Thinking:** Demonstrated strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving technical challenges. **Project Leadership:** Good understanding of project management principles, including agile methodologies, to drive projects from concept to completion.

 **Education:**


Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related technical field.
* 10\-15% business trips

**Identification stratégique des opportunités :**  

Collaborer étroitement avec les unités commerciales et les parties prenantes de la division **Power Transmission** pour identifier et évaluer de manière proactive les opportunités à fort impact pour l’application de l’IA et du Machine Learning (IA/ML). Traduire des besoins métier complexes en concepts clairs, exploitables et innovants basés sur l’IA.

**Développement IA/ML de bout en bout :**  

Diriger la conception, le développement, la validation et l’optimisation de modèles IA/ML, de **preuves de concept (PoC)** et de **produits minimum viables (MVP)**. Cela comprend l’exploration de données, l’ingénierie des caractéristiques, la sélection de modèles, l’entraînement et l’évaluation rigoureuse des performances.

**Déploiement et intégration des solutions :**  

Piloter le déploiement, l’intégration et la montée en échelle des solutions IA/ML dans les environnements de production — aussi bien dans le **cloud** qu’en **edge computing** — en garantissant un fonctionnement fluide et une parfaite cohérence avec les objectifs stratégiques de l’organisation.

**Partenariat avec les parties prenantes :**  

Agir comme partenaire technique clé au sein d’équipes projet interdisciplinaires, en les guidant sur les potentialités et les limites de l’IA/ML afin de répondre efficacement aux défis métier spécifiques.

**Excellence technique et meilleures pratiques :**  

Contribuer à l’élaboration et à la maintenance d’une documentation technique complète, de rapports de modèles et d’initiatives de partage de connaissances. Promouvoir les principes du **MLOps** et encourager les meilleures pratiques en matière de développement, de déploiement et de suivi des solutions IA/ML.

**Apprentissage continu :**  

Se tenir informé des dernières avancées, recherches et technologies émergentes en IA/ML, et introduire des approches et outils innovants dans nos projets.

### **Qualifications requises**

* **Maîtrise de la programmation :** Solide expérience en **Python**, incluant les bibliothèques de manipulation de données (ex. : *Pandas*, *NumPy*) et d’apprentissage automatique (ex. : *scikit\-learn*).
* **Frameworks ML et MLOps :** Expérience pratique avec les principaux frameworks ML tels que *TensorFlow*, *PyTorch* ou *Keras*. Bonne compréhension et application concrète des principes de **MLOps** pour la gestion du cycle de vie des modèles, le versioning, les tests et l’intégration/déploiement continus (CI/CD).
* **Expérience en déploiement :** Capacité démontrée à déployer et gérer des modèles IA/ML dans des environnements **cloud** (ex. : AWS, Azure) et/ou sur des **appareils en périphérie (edge)** pour des applications en temps réel.
* **IA/ML et statistiques fondamentales :** Compréhension approfondie d’un large éventail d’algorithmes IA/ML et de techniques statistiques, incluant l’apprentissage supervisé (régression, classification), non supervisé (clustering, réduction de dimension), l’analyse de séries temporelles et la modélisation statistique avancée.
* **Gestion des données :** Expérience avec les langages de requête de données (ex. : **SQL**) et la manipulation de différentes sources de données, structurées ou non structurées.
* **Visualisation de données :** Maîtrise des outils de visualisation (ex. : **Tableau**, **Power BI**, **Matplotlib**) pour communiquer efficacement les performances des modèles, les insights et les résultats de validation à des publics techniques et non techniques.

**Qualifications souhaitées**
-----------------------------

* **Techniques avancées en IA/ML :** Expérience avec les architectures d’apprentissage profond, le **traitement du langage naturel (NLP)** ou **l’apprentissage par renforcement**.
* **Technologies d’IA générative :** Expérience pratique dans l’intégration de **modèles de vision**, de **grands modèles de langage (LLM)**, de **petits modèles de langage (SLM)**, de systèmes **RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation)**, ainsi que des **cadres agentiques** et des **protocoles de contexte de modèle**.
* **Connaissances métier :** Expérience préalable dans le domaine de la **transmission d’énergie** et bonne compréhension des produits de ce secteur.
* **Langages supplémentaires :** Maîtrise d’autres langages de programmation tels que **R**, **C\#** ou **C\+\+**.

**Compétences comportementales et qualités personnelles**
---------------------------------------------------------

* **Esprit d’équipe collaboratif :** Excellente capacité à travailler efficacement et de manière collaborative au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires et avec des partenaires externes.
* **Communication et présentation :** Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale en anglais, avec la capacité d’expliquer des concepts techniques complexes à des interlocuteurs non techniques et de préparer une documentation claire et concise.
* **Résolution de problèmes et pensée critique :** Solides aptitudes analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche proactive pour identifier et surmonter les défis techniques.
* **Leadership de projet :** Bonne compréhension des principes de **gestion de projet**, y compris les **méthodologies agiles**, pour piloter les projets de la conception à la réalisation.

**Formation**
-------------


Diplôme de **licence ou de master** en **informatique**, **génie électrique ou mécanique**, **science des données**, **intelligence artificielle** ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.


10\-15% de déplacements professionnels

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: STAGE 2026 -Traitement d image - super-résolution sur caméra embarquée d un drone (H/F)
description:
**Rejoignez l'aventure Parrot !**

  

En 2026, Parrot est à la recherche de **talents passionné.es** pour relever des défis technologiques de pointe.


Ensemble, nous créerons des **projets innovants, ambitieux, et à la hauteur des enjeux de demain**.


Vous aimez l'innovation, vous n'avez pas peur des défis ? Venez faire la différence aux côtés des femmes et des hommes de nos équipes !

  

Fondée en 1994 par Henri Seydoux, Parrot est aujourd'hui **le leader européen des drones professionnels. Située au cœur de Paris,** notre R\&D réunit une **équipe multiculturelle d'ingénieur.es,** où chaque voix compte pour réinventer l'avenir des drones.

  

Parrot s'intéresse à des **solutions de super\-résolution image pour ses micro\-drones d'observation**. Le but est d'augmenter la **qualité des détails des prises de vues de ses caméras embarquées sans passer par l'ajout de caméras supplémentaires** avec une plus longue focale et ce pour des raisons de coût, encombrement et poids.  



  

  

**VOS MISSIONS :**

  

Les drones Parrot embarquent actuellement 3 caméras “principales” à destination de l’utilisateur :

* Deux caméras électro\-optiques grand angle et télé 50Mpix opérant dans le domaine visible.
* Une caméra thermique micro\-bolomètre opérant en LWIR de résolution VGA.
  

  

Les deux caméras électro\-optiques permettent de simuler un zoom continu.

  

Il serait intéressant de pouvoir **augmenter ce zoom continu sans passer par l’ajout d’une caméra supplémentaire** de plus longue focale, à la fois pour les caméras **électro\-optiques mais aussi pour la caméra thermique** qui a une résolution limitée du fait de la technologie des micro\-bolomètres et des longueurs d’onde captées qui imposent des pixels de grandes tailles.

 **Une solution de super résolution image pourrait permettre de réaliser ce zoom plus important sans passer par l’ajout de matériel de captation supplémentaire**.

  

Au sein de l’équipe Vision et de l’équipe Média, vous aurez la charge :

  

* D’évaluer l’état de l’art sur le **domaine de la super résolution image**, notamment **par l’utilisation de réseaux de neurones**.
* De comparer les **solutions basées sur du multiframe vs. single frame et d’images bayer vs. images RGB**.
* Constituer une base de données.
* Aboutir à la **proposition d’une solution technique** cohérente avec la puissance de calcul disponible dans un drone.
  

  

  

**VOTRE PROFIL :**

  

* Vous êtes issu.e d'une **formation d'ingénieur en traitement d'images**, vous êtes en recherche d’un stage de fin d'études (Bac\+5\).
* Vous avez des compétences en **traitement d’images ainsi qu’en réseaux de neurones** : deep learning (CNN, Transformers…) sont indispensables.
* Vous maîtrisez également la **programmation en Python**.
* Vous avez des compétences en **C et C\+\+ sont appréciées**, ainsi que des connaissances dans le **domaine des caméras et de la robotique**.
* Vous êtes **autonome et curieu.x.se**.
* Une **maîtrise de l'anglais** est requise.
  

  

**CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS :**

  

* Une intégration au cœur d**’une équipe de passionné(e)s.**
* **Des projets techniques** à la hauteur de vos ambitions.
* Des **responsabilités pour chacun(e)**, l’opportunité pour toutes et tous d’avoir un **impact dans votre travail**, jeunes diplômés ou profils expérimentés.
* Une **ambiance technophile et multiculturelle**.
* Une culture d’entreprise sincèrement guidée par **les principes d’inclusion, d’équité et de diversité.**
* **Un cadre de travail unique au coeur de Paris.**
* **Un cadre social performant et adapté**.
  

  

  

  

**Join the Parrot adventure !**

  

In 2026, Parrot is looking for **passionate talent** to take on cutting\-edge technological challenges.


Together, we will create **innovative, ambitious projects that are equal to the challenges of tomorrow**.


Do you thrive on innovation and embrace challenges? Come and make a difference alongside the men and women in our teams!  



  

Founded in 1994 by Henri Seydoux, Parrot is now the **European leader in professional drones**. **Located in the heart of Paris**, our R\&D department brings together a **multicultural team of engineers**, where every voice counts in reinventing the future of drones.  



  

Parrot is interested in **super\-resolution image solutions for its micro observation drones**. The aim is to increase the **detail quality of the images captured by its on\-board cameras without adding additional cameras** with longer focal lengths, for reasons of cost, size and weight.  



  

**YOUR MISSIONS**:


Parrot drones currently carry three ‘main’ cameras for the user:


* Two 50\-megapixel wide\-angle and telephoto electro\-optical cameras operating in the visible spectrum.
* A microbolometer thermal camera operating in LWIR with VGA resolution.

The two electro\-optical cameras allow for continuous zoom simulation.  



  

It would be useful to be able to **increase this continuous zoom** **without adding an additional camera** with a longer focal length, both for the **electro\-optical cameras and for the thermal camera**, which has limited resolution due to microbolometer technology and the wavelengths captured, which require large pixels.  



  

**An image super\-resolution solution could enable this greater zoom without adding additional capture equipment**.  



  

As part of the Vision and Media teams, you will be responsible for:  



  

* Assessing the state of the art in the field of **image super\-resolution**, particularly **through the use of neural networks**.
* Comparing **solutions based on multi\-frame vs. single\-frame and bayer images vs. RGB images**.
* Building a database.
* **Proposing a technical solution** consistent with the computing power available in a drone.

  

**YOUR PROFILE**:  



  

* You are currently pursuing a **degree in image processing engineering** and are looking for an end\-of\-study internship (Bac\+5\).
* Skills in **image processing and neural networks**: deep learning (CNN, Transformers, etc.) are essential.
* You are also proficient in **Python programming**.
* Skills in **C and C\+\+ are appreciated**, as well as knowledge in the **field of cameras and robotics**.
* You are **independent and curious**.
* **Fluency in English** is required.

  

**WHAT WE OFFER :**

  

* Integration into a team of **passionate professionals**.
* **Technical projects** that match your ambitions.
* **Responsibilities for everyone**, with the opportunity for all to make an **impact in their work**, whether you are a recent graduate or an experienced professional.
* A **tech\-savvy and multicultural atmosphere**.
* A corporate culture sincerely guided by the **principles of inclusion**, **equity and diversity**.
* **A unique working environment in the heart of Paris**.
* **An effective and supportive social environment**.

title: Research Engineer : Software Packaging and Continuous Integration for Supercomputers (Grenoble/Bordeaux)
description:
*Le descriptif de l’offre ci\-dessous est en Anglais*
**Type de contrat :** CDD


**Contrat renouvelable :** Oui


**Niveau de diplôme exigé :** Bac \+ 5 ou équivalent


**Autre diplôme apprécié :** Master's degree, Engineer's degree or PhD in computer science


**Fonction :** Ingénieur scientifique contractuel


**Niveau d'expérience souhaité :** Jeune diplômé


**A propos du centre ou de la direction fonctionnelle**
-------------------------------------------------------


The Centre Inria de l’Université de Grenoble groups together almost 600 people in 22 research teams and 7 research support departments.



Staff is present on three campuses in Grenoble, in close collaboration with other research and higher education institutions (Université Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, CEA, INRAE, …), but also with key economic players in the area.



The Centre Inria de l’Université Grenoble Alpe is active in the fields of high\-performance computing, verification and embedded systems, modeling of the environment at multiple levels, and data science and artificial intelligence. The center is a top\-level scientific institute with an extensive network of international collaborations in Europe and the rest of the world.


**Contexte et atouts du poste**
-------------------------------


We are looking for candidates with a **Master's degree, Engineer's degree or PhD in computer science, junior or senior,** to join a team responsible for the packaging, deployment and testing of software libraries for supercomputers.



Our team is distributed and so we have the fexibility to offer candidates **2 different possible localisations**:


* Datamove team (https://team.inria.fr/datamove/) located near **Grenoble, in the French Alps,**
* SED team (https://sed\-bso.gitlabpages.inria.fr/), located near **Bordeaux, close to the Atlantic Ocean,**

  



Duration: initial contratc of **3 years with possible extension.**

  

Hiring dates are flexible with a possible start from November 2025 (modulo mandatory administrative deadlines). We will process applications as they arise.

  


This work is part of the NumPEx project (http://www.numpex.fr) endowed with more than 40 million euros over 6 years from 2023, to build a software stack for Exascale supercomputers related to the arrival in Europe of the first Exascale machines, with one planned in France for 2025\. These machines will be among the most powerful in the world (https://top500\.org/), used for traditional scientific applications and increasingly also for artificial intelligence.  

  

Our role in NumPEx is to design and implement an inovative packaging, deployment and testing strategy. Commonly used solutions show their limits in front of the complexity of supercomputers and applications, as well as the need for reproducibility for open science. Our goal is to build a solution based on a new generation of software packagin tools: Guix, Spack.  

  

You can have a look at the team activity at https://numpex\-pc5\.gitlabpages.inria.fr/tutorials or https://hpc.guix.info. We also regularly contribute to the discussions on software production at the International INPEX worekshops (https://inpex.science/\#workshops\-events).

  

**Mission confiée**
-------------------


You will contribute to the design and implementation of the packaging and continuous integration strategy. You will participate in the deployment and testing of the infrastructure. You will also participate to user support and to training activity around all these aspects.  

  

Our packaging strategy is centered on the open source tools **Guix** (https://hpc.guix.info/), and **Spack** (https://spack.io/). In direct contact with the development teams of these tools, with the supercomputer administration teams, and software developers, you will participate in:



* the design of the packaging strategy of the NumPEx project,


* the effort of packaging libraries for supercomputers, from standards (MPI, PETSC, Pytorch,....) to application s.


* the design of a package test and validation solution taking into account the specificities of supercomputers (High performance network, ARM and X86 arch, GPUs)


* the development of a solution allowing non\-administrator users to deploy software stacks on supercomputers.


* training around all of these aspects for researchers and engineers, whether they are library designers or users.


**Compétences**
---------------


Master's degree, Engineer's degree or PhD, beginner or confirmed (salary adjusted according to experience) in computer science.



The essential expected skills are:



* Good practice of Unix/Linux and system administration


* Good programming experience (C/C\+\+, Python)


* Experience with software compilation and installation chains, version management tools, testing and continuous integration (CMake, Git, GitHub, GitLab, etc...).


* The work being performed in an international context, a good practice of technical English (written and oral) is expected (proficiency in French is not compulsory), as is a taste for team work.


* Any additional skill related to package managers (Guix, Nix, Spack, apt, rpm,…), containers (Singularity/Apptainer, Docker,…) or open source development are a plus.


An initial training time will be provided to complement the missing skills.  

  

You will integrate an academic research environment which will give you, throughout your contract, the opportunity to complete your training on cutting\-edge technologies.  

  

To apply, please send, in addition to the classic elements, any information that could help us assess your skills, such as a recent internship or thesis report, your github account or links to software developments in which you participate, as well as some references from people we can contact to certify your qualities.

  


**Avantages**
-------------


* Subsidized meals
* Partial reimbursement of public transport costs
* Leave: 7 weeks of annual leave \+ 10 extra days off due to RTT (statutory reduction in working hours) \+ possibility of exceptional leave (sick children, moving home, etc.)
* Possibility of teleworking (90 days / year) and flexible organization of working hours (except for intership)
* Social, cultural and sports events and activities
* Access to vocational training
* Social security coverage under conditions
**Rémunération**
----------------


From 2,692 € (depending on experience and qualifications).



Base of 2692€ gross / month. Wage according to the profile.


  
**Informations générales**
--------------------------


* **Thème/Domaine :** Calcul distribué et à haute performance
  

Ingénierie logicielle (BAP E)
* **Ville :** Saint Martin d'Heres
* **Centre Inria :** Centre Inria de l'Université Grenoble Alpes
* **Date de prise de fonction souhaitée :** 2026\-02\-01
* **Durée de contrat :** 3 ans
* **Date limite pour postuler :** 2025\-12\-31
**Attention**: Les candidatures doivent être déposées en ligne sur le site Inria. Le traitement des candidatures adressées par d'autres canaux n'est pas garanti.


**Consignes pour postuler**
---------------------------


**Sécurité défense :**  

Ce poste est susceptible d’être affecté dans une zone à régime restrictif (ZRR), telle que définie dans le décret n°2011\-1425 relatif à la protection du potentiel scientifique et technique de la nation (PPST). L’autorisation d’accès à une zone est délivrée par le chef d’établissement, après avis ministériel favorable, tel que défini dans l’arrêté du 03 juillet 2012, relatif à la PPST. Un avis ministériel défavorable pour un poste affecté dans une ZRR aurait pour conséquence l’annulation du recrutement.


**Politique de recrutement :**
  

Dans le cadre de sa politique diversité, tous les postes Inria sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.


**Contacts**
------------


* **Équipe Inria :** DATAMOVE
* **Recruteur :**
  

Raffin Bruno / bruno.raffin@inria.fr
**A propos d'Inria**
--------------------


Inria est l’institut national de recherche dédié aux sciences et technologies du numérique. Il emploie 2600 personnes. Ses 215 équipes\-projets agiles, en général communes avec des partenaires académiques, impliquent plus de 3900 scientifiques pour relever les défis du numérique, souvent à l’interface d’autres disciplines. L’institut fait appel à de nombreux talents dans plus d’une quarantaine de métiers différents. 900 personnels d’appui à la recherche et à l’innovation contribuent à faire émerger et grandir des projets scientifiques ou entrepreneuriaux qui impactent le monde. Inria travaille avec de nombreuses entreprises et a accompagné la création de plus de 200 start\-up. description:

Groupe de Luxe mondial, Kering regroupe et fait grandir un ensemble de Maisons emblématiques dans la Mode, la Maroquinerie et la Joaillerie : Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin, Ginori 1735, ainsi que Kering Eyewear et Kering Beauté. Job Description
Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) Entreprise Cloud Architect pour intégrer notre équipe Entreprise Architecture Technology.
Votre opportunité
En tant que membre de l’équipe d’Architecture d’Entreprise, vous accompagnerez les marques et entités du Groupe Kering dans la mise en place de stratégies Cloud en phase avec le cadre d’architecture global de l’entreprise
Kering technologies délivre aux équipes projet un Framework Cloud complet incluant des guidelines d’architecture, de développement, de sécurité et de finops.
Sur la base de ce framework, nous proposons aux équipes des environnements Cloud industrialisés, flexibles et performants, permettant de déployer rapidement leurs applications, quel que soit le fournisseur.
Vous participerez activement à élaborer et mettre à jour ce Framework en relations avec les différentes équipes de Kering Technologies.
Rejoindre notre équipe, c’est intégrer une dynamique innovante, au croisement de la performance technologique, de l’optimisation opérationnelle et de l’agilité métier.

En tant qu'expert(e) Cloud, vous serez au cœur de la stratégie et de la mise en œuvre des solutions Cloud au sein de notre organisation et vous assurerez les missions suivantes :
Appliquer la stratégie Cloud au sein de l’Architecture d’Entreprise en lien avec les enjeux métiers, techniques et réglementaires.
Maintenir le cadre d’architecture Cloud : principes directeurs, standards, bonnes pratiques, référentiels de services cloud (catalogue).

Accompagner les projets dans la conception d’architectures Cloud robustes, scalables et sécurisées.
Évaluer et valider les architectures Cloud proposées par les équipes projets ou fournisseurs.
Participer aux comités d’architecture, aux revues de conception tout en se positionnant en acteur fort de la veille technologique.
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les architectes solutions, les équipes sécurité, réseau, data, DevSecOps ainsi que nos métiers.
Être l’ambassadeur des bonnes pratiques Cloud dans l’entreprise (sensibilisation, formation, coaching technique).
Qui êtes\-vous
De niveau ingénieur dans les technologies de l’information ou équivalent, vous avez au moins 7 ans d’expérience sur des projets d’architecture Cloud, dont au moins une en tant que référent ou lead.
Solide culture d’Architecture d’Entreprise, et compréhension des enjeux Cloud à l’échelle du SI.
Maîtrise des modèles de services Cloud : IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, et des patterns cloud\-native (microservices, serverless, conteneurisation).
Connaissance des enjeux de sécurité Cloud, Zero Trust, conformité, gouvernance et coûts.
Aisance dans la rédaction de livrables d’architecture et dans l’animation de réunions techniques et stratégiques.
Connaissance des frameworks d’architecture (TOGAF, SAFe, AWS Well\-Architected Framework etc…).
Excellente connaissance du CI/CD (ArgoCD \& Atlantis) ainsi que de l’automatisation : IaC (Terraform, Terragrunt), déploiement (GitOps avec Helm \& Kustomize).
Bonne compréhension des outils et méthodes DevOps, des organisations autour de plateforms ainsi que des process opérationnels inhérents à une grande entreprise (ITSM notamment).
Aisance à vulgariser les problèmes et présenter ses idées pour fournir des solutions innovantes.
Aptitude à diriger des discussions techniques complexes et à orienter les équipes techniques vers un environnement moderne (infra as code, Kubernetes, GitOps …)
Capacité à travailler en autonomie comme en équipe, avec différents profils (développeurs, experts techniques ou business)
Capacité à fédérer les équipes et à favoriser le consensus sur la base d’une forte expertise technique
Savoir à convaincre et à défendre ses idées avec clarté
Anglais et Français courant.  

Certifications souhaitées : AWS/Azure/GCP Architect, TOGAF, FinOps, Kubernetes, (Une certification AWS Professional et une expérience sur GCP ou Alibaba seraient un plus)  

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est l'opportunité d'évoluer au cœur d’un environnement dynamique, innovant et à la pointe des technologies. Vous aurez l'occasion de contribuer activement à des projets de transformation numérique passionnants, tout en explorant les dernières avancées du cloud computing et des architectures multi\-clouds. Nous accompagnons nos Maisons dans
leur révolution numérique en concevant des solutions cloud à la fois performantes, sécurisées et durables.
A travers ses collaborateurs, Kering s'engage en faveur de la diversité. Nous croyons que la diversité sous toutes ses formes \- genre, âge, nationalité, culture, handicap, croyances religieuses et orientation sexuelle \- enrichit le lieu de travail. Nos collaborateurs ont ainsi des opportunités pour exprimer leurs talents, à la fois individuellement et collectivement, et cela contribue à renforcer notre capacité d'adaptation à un monde en mutation. En tant qu'employeur de l'égalité des chances, nous accueillons et considérons les candidatures de tous les candidats qualifiés, indépendamment de leurs antécédents.
We are currently seeking an Enterprise Cloud Architect to join our team.

Initiated 7 years ago with AWS \- our primary provider to date \- our Cloud journey has expanded with Google Cloud to meet BI/Data challenges and with Alibaba Cloud to ensure regulatory compliance for our operations in mainland China. Expertise in Cloud service models: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and cloud\-native patterns (microservices, serverless, containerization).

Comfort with writing architectural deliverables and leading technical and strategic meetings.

Solid understanding of DevOps tools and methodologies, as well as operational processes in large enterprises (ITSM in particular).

Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team, with diverse profiles (developers, technical or business experts).
Ability to unite teams and foster consensus based on strong technical expertise.

Proficiency in both English and French.  

Desired Certifications: AWS/Azure/GCP Architect, TOGAF, FinOps, Kubernetes (AWS Professional certification and experience with GCP or Alibaba would be a plus).
Why join us?
Joining our team is an opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, innovative, and cutting\-edge technological environment. You will have the chance to contribute actively to exciting digital transformation projects while exploring the latest advancements in cloud computing and multi\-cloud architectures. We support our Houses in their digital revolution by designing cloud solutions that are both high\-performing, secure, and sustainable.

title: CNT Growth Intern
description:
Founded in 2020 and based in the heart of Paris, C12’s mission is to be at the center of one of the biggest technological breakthroughs of the century, and change the course of history by building a universal quantum computer.  

  

At C12, we believe that achieving a true breakthrough in quantum computing requires rethinking the fundamentals. That’s why our founders—deeply rooted in academic and engineering excellence—have chosen carbon nanotubes as the building blocks of our quantum processors. This ultra\-pure material dramatically reduces error rates, boosts performance, and minimises hardware overhead—key ingredients for scalable, fault\-tolerant quantum computing. By crafting a unique approach that scales, we aim to revolutionise quantum computing just as silicon transformed classical computing.  

Since our founding, we’ve raised over €25 million in funding, published 11 scientific papers, and secured 8 patents. Today, our fast\-growing team of 60, including 20 PhDs, has over 20 nationalities represented. We have our own cutting\-edge lab space in Paris' historic Panthéon district; where scientists, engineers, and innovators work side\-by\-side to tackle some of the most exciting technical challenges of our time.
### **Your role at C12 Quantum Electronics**

* As a CNT Growth intern, you will work closely with Jean\-Loïs and Louis, our CNT Research Engineers. Your main responsibilities include:
* Designing an experimental protocol to assess the influence of the Chemical Vapour Deposition (CVD) parameters on the growth of carbon nanotubes \- e.g. geometry, density of catalyst nanoparticles, position in the furnace \- and on the overall performances of the CVD
* Collaborating with the Characterization and Nanofabrication teams to characterize the catalyst nanoparticles and to determine the properties of the grown carbon nanotubes
* Analysing experimental data to draw conclusions on the phenomena involved
* Getting familiar with the CVD setup, C12 processes and characterization equipments \- e.g. SEM, EDX, AFM, possibly setting up a mass spectrometer

### **About you:**

* You are pursuing a Master’s degree in engineering, physics, chemistry or any related field and are looking for an **end\-of\-studies internship**
* You love experimental lab work, have a problem\-solving attitude \- a previous experience in a lab is a plus
* You are used to collecting, organising and analysing experimental data \- programming skills are a plus (e.g. python)
* You are result\-oriented, organised, and rigorous in your documentation
* You can fluently communicate in English (verbal and written)


You should join us if...  

You like hands\-on work and technology
You want to contribute to achieving landmark results in quantum computing, making a difference in the emerging quantum technologies
You want to work within a 60\-people team with various backgrounds in nanofabrication, quantum electronics, and carbon nanotube science to create a revolutionary quantum computing processor
You want to thrive in an exceptional scientific environment with several industrial and academic partners
You share our values (excellence, scientific integrity, diversity, curiosity, and care) and want to help us define our product\-focused culture and ambition to accelerate.  

C12 encourages all who feel qualified to apply. Recruitment decisions are based solely on qualifications, skills, knowledge and experience. *Applications from women are particularly welcomed*.

title: Ingénieur intelligence artificielle - AI/ML Engineer

===========================


Are you an experienced, passionate, and results\-oriented Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) Engineer ready to drive innovation in the critical field of Power Transmission? We are seeking a talented individual to design, develop, and deploy cutting\-edge AI/ML solutions that optimize our operations, enhance product performance, and unlock new opportunities within our Power Transmission business (PT). In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in transforming business challenges into innovative AI\-driven solutions. You'll contribute across the entire AI/ML lifecycle, from initial concept generation and rigorous assessment, through the development of proofs\-of\-concept (PoCs) and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), to the full\-scale activation and integration of AI solutions into our critical infrastructure. If you thrive in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment and possess a strong blend of AI/ML expertise and project leadership, we encourage you to apply and help shape the future of energy.  

  

Version française  

  

Es\-tu un(e) ingénieur(e) en Intelligence Artificielle et Apprentissage Automatique (IA/ML) expérimenté(e), passionné(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats, prêt(e) à stimuler l’innovation dans le domaine crucial de la transmission d’énergie ?  

  

Nous recherchons une personne talentueuse pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d’IA/ML de pointe qui optimiseront nos opérations, amélioreront les performances de nos produits et ouvriront de nouvelles opportunités au sein de notre division Power Transmission (PT).  

  

Dans ce rôle essentiel, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la transformation des défis métier en solutions innovantes basées sur l’IA. Tu contribueras à l’ensemble du cycle de vie de l’IA/ML, depuis la génération des concepts initiaux et leur évaluation rigoureuse, jusqu’au développement de preuves de concept (PoC) et de produits minimum viables (MVP), puis à l’intégration à grande échelle des solutions d’IA dans nos infrastructures critiques.  

  

Si tu t’épanouis dans un environnement collaboratif et interdisciplinaire, et que tu possèdes un solide mélange d’expertise en IA/ML et de compétences en gestion de projet, nous t’encourageons à postuler pour contribuer à façonner l’avenir de l’énergie.**Job Description**
===================

* **Strategic Opportunity Identification**: Collaborate closely with Power Transmission business units and stakeholders to proactively identify and evaluate high\-impact opportunities for AI/ML application. Translate complex business needs into clear, actionable, and innovative AI\-driven concepts.
* **End\-to\-End AI/ML Development**: Lead the design, development, validation, and optimization of AI/ML models, proofs of concept (PoCs), and Minimum Viable Products (MVPs). This includes data exploration, feature engineering, model selection, training, and robust evaluation.
* **Solution Deployment \& Integration**: Drive the deployment, integration, and scaling of AI/ML solutions into production environments, both in the cloud and at the edge, ensuring seamless operation and alignment with strategic organizational objectives.
* **Stakeholder Partnership**: Act as a key technical partner to cross\-functional project teams, guiding them through the potentials and limitations of AI/ML to effectively address specific business challenges.
* **Technical Excellence \& Best Practices**: Contribute to the development and maintenance of comprehensive technical documentation, model reporting, and knowledge sharing initiatives. Champion MLOps principles and foster best practices for AI/ML development, deployment, and monitoring.

title: Intern (M/F) Chemoinformatics developer
description:
Qubit Pharmaceuticals is a French\-American deeptech startup, focusing on discovering novel molecules for complex targets in healthcare and materials science. We leverage proprietary molecular simulation and quantum\-physics based modeling technology to develop our own discovery programs that we either co\-develop with or license out to pharmaceutical and industrial partners. This enables us to design more effective and safer drug candidates, aiming to significantly reduce the time and investment needed for discovery. In just 18 months, Qubit Pharmaceuticals grew its portfolio to 7 programs in oncology, immunology \& antivirals.


Our cutting\-edge technology is based on over 30 years of research by our academic founders, and relies on three main components: in\-depth expertise in computational science and high\-performance computing (HPC), quantum chemistry and artificial intelligence algorithms, and a powerful, automated cloud platform for molecular simulation with chemical accuracy. We recently announced the launch of the world's most powerful AI foundation model for molecular simulation.

  

Qubit Pharmaceuticals is looking for an **Intern (M/F) in its product and engineering team**. He or she will participate in the construction of our molecular simulation platform (Atlas) by developing and improving our chemoinformatics tools used by our internal modelers.




### **The per****fect fit for this job**


We are looking for a detail\-oriented engineer with strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. This role requires a unique blend of scientific understanding, strong communication skills to collaborate with a cross\-functional expert team, and proven expertise in software development. A background, or at least a strong interest in chemistry and statistical mechanics is a real plus.

  



### **Your role**


Our Atlas platform functions as an orchestrator to build and launch complex digital experiments on molecular systems. It leverages the best academic tools (thinker HP, FeNNix\-Bio, VTX, amoeba) and the best existing computing technologies (GPU, CPU, QPU).


Your role will be to participate in enhancing and robustifying our chemoinformatic library, available on Atlas. This library is a critical and powerful suite of tools used to prepare, validate, analyse and edit our chemical data at each stage of our simulations. It is a strategic asset, as these tools are used in almost every scientific calculation. The library is mainly built in python and is served to users with an infrastructure as code approach (CI/CD, docker, kubernetes…). The backend is in Ruby on Rails and uses robust server\-side logic and APIs to support user interfaces.


The goal of this internship is to explore state\-of\-the\-art methods to manipulate chemical data, and to implement concrete tools to support our modelers and molecule researchers.

* Master 1 or Master 2
* Programming experience in Python and object\-oriented language, or a strong willingness to learn
