title: Full stack Software Engineer
description:
At Westinghouse Electric Company, we are pioneers in nuclear technology and our technology is the basis for nearly half of the world's commercial nuclear power plants in operation. Today, we are also building several new reactors that contribute to more fossil\-free energy. Globally, we have over 10,000 employees in 19 countries, of which 1,000 are at our Swedish workplaces in Västerås and Täby. Our Swedish operations were founded in 1969 and supply nuclear fuel as well as products and services in automation, maintenance, testing and decommissioning for customers around the world. Read more about us*www.westinghousenuclear.com**.*

  

Welcome to our team, we are part of the Global Nuclear Fuel Engineering division. We are responsible for the codes used for core design, thermal hydraulics, criticality analysis, mechanical design, safety analysis, method\- and software development!

  


### **About the role:**



As Full Stack Software developer your main responsibility is to design high\-quality software solutions for the nuclear power industry. Among other things, this means that you will:


* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code using industry\-standard languages and using modern frameworks such as SvelteKit, TypeScript, Rust and Python.
* Contribute to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including analysis, development, testing, and deployment.
* Maintain our products for internal use and for our worldwide customer projects.
* Build and integrate APIs for data\-driven applications, including those involving image and video processing.
* Collaborate with AI engineers to implement and improve machine learning models for tasks such as pattern recognition, optimisation, and predictive analytics.
* Contribute to the development of tools that support high\-performance computing and GPU\-accelerated inference workflows.
* Participate in sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous integration efforts within a cross\-functional team.
* Ensure secure and scalable deployment of software solutions, including on\-premise environments with strict data governance.

  



You will be placed in Västerås with a hybrid work schedule. We believe that you live within commuting distance from Västerås, however, we are open to considering more distant locations in Sweden as well.

  


**Qualifications:**


* Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering Physics or a related field.
* 5\+ years experience with full stack development, including frontend and backend technologies.
* Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, and containerisation tools like Docker.
* Experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Familiarity with computer vision techniques and model training pipelines.
* Knowledge of software architecture, version control, and agile development practices.


**Meritorious:**


* Experience with optimisation algorithms and surrogate modelling.
* Knowledge of secure software development in regulated environments.
* Exposure to real\-time inference systems and edge deployment.
* Knowledge of scientific computing and engineering applications.

  


**Welcome with your application** including CV, cover letter and degree certificate. We interview candidates on a continuous basis, so please send in your application as soon as possible!

  


**Security clearance is carried out as part of the recruitment process.**



You will report to the Manager Software \& Methods. For more information about the role, please contact the hiring manager Silvio Orsi, Silvio.Orsi@westinghouse.com. Phone \+46 732 36 77 39

At Westinghouse, we offer an inspiring work environment in a high\-tech industry. title: IT Business Consultant på det medarbetarägda konsultbolaget!
description:

Vi ser ett stort behov i vårt samhälle att kombinera affärsförståelse, digitalt ledarskap samt innovativa arbetssätt och lösningar med framtidens tekniker i uppkopplade ekosystem. Vi tror på en hållbar framtid med säkra lösningar genom exempelvis IoT\-lösningar, digitala tvillingar, AI och cybersäkerhet. Det här är vårt WHY och det fyller oss med energi varje dag. Det här är vår arena.*


TechSeed är ett medarbetarägt konsultbolag på en kraftig tillväxtresa och söker nu **IT Business Consultants** som även kommer få en stor grad av inflytande och insyn i hur vi växer framåt. Vi bygger med ambitionen att ta ett helhetsgrepp om uppkopplade ekosystem och lösningar. Vi söker dig som trivs i konsultrollen och samtidigt vill bidra till att skapa vägen framåt för TechSeed – Tillsammans.


I den här rollen kommer du tillhöra enheten **Edge \& IoT**, vars fokus är att vara en central partner under våra kunders IoT\-resa. Vi antar en omfattande strategi, som börjar med affärsrådgivning och IoT\-arkitektur för att skapa en robust grund och en tydlig färdplan. Vår sömlösa leveransprocess aktiverar IoT\-lösningar, medan våra applikationstjänster skräddarsyr dessa lösningar för att passa våra kunder.


**Vem söker vi?**


I vår strävan att vara ledande inom IoT och Edge Computing, söker vi nu Business Consultants till vår gruppering TechSeed IoT \& Edge i Göteborg. Vi letar efter kollegor som kan föra samman affärsstrategi med teknologisk innovation och som trivs i en roll där självständighet och ansvarstagande är nyckelkomponenter. För rollen krävs det även en professionell nivå av både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.

* **Utbildning:** Vi ser gärna att du har en akademisk (3 år eller mer) bakgrund inom ingenjör, teknik, företagsekonomi eller management
* **Självständighet och initiativtagande**: Eftersom vi är ett nytt bolag med höga ambitioner, är det viktigt att du är självgående och kan driva dina egna projekt och initiativ. Du bör kunna arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du bidrar till teamets gemensamma mål.
* **Teknisk förståelse:** En grundläggande förståelse för IoT eller relaterade teknologier är önskvärd. Vi värderar din förmåga att översätta tekniska lösningar till affärsvärde.
* **Arbetslivserfarenhet:** Vi söker dig som har minst fem år av relevant erfarenhet inom områden som Management Consulting, affärsutveckling, Business Analysis eller motsvarande roller.
* **Projekttyper:** Du bör ha erfarenhet av att utföra olika typer av förstudier och PMOs och vara bekväm att utföra/leda analyser i Excel, skapa beslutsunderlag i PowerPoint för beslutsfattare, samt tidigare ha deltagit i tvärfunktionella projekt som omfattar IT, verksamhet och management. Vidare är det viktigt att du har förmågan att samarbeta och integrera med personer på alla nivåer, leda workshops och effektivt ta fram beslutsunderlag baserat på dessa.

description:

Volvo Group Digital \& IT has the ambition to enable value creation at scale for the Volvo Group. With a product\-centric operation model and digital technologies, we produce digital offerings that are profitable, scalable, and differentiated.

  

In Digital Technologies \- IoT \& Edge Computing, you will contribute to the transformation and digitalization of the Volvo Group. You will play a key role in integrating security into our DevOps processes, leveraging Cloud \& Edge technologies to deliver robust solutions.

* Help to accelerate development by automating deployment processes, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices
* Deploy \& monitor containerized applications using, for example Kubernetes

* Previous knowledge of Azure IoT services and experience in IT/OT architecture
* Knowledge of Azure IoT Operations

* Background as a full stack Software Engineer

  

We are looking for someone that has passion for new technologies, like innovation and adaptable for the situation. Moreover, if you are self\-going and communicate easily, then we can be a good match.

title: Senior IoT Engineer- Flextools team
description:

We are hiring a Senior IoT Engineer for Sympower’s Flextools BRP Offering domain. This person will be responsible for developing our core domain and controllers together with the team, linking our platform to control our customer’s assets (e.g. renewable energy sources, batteries) in real\-time. Our ideal candidate will have experience developing high\-performance systems that interface with industrial IoT devices and are deployed at enterprise scale. We are reshaping the foundations of this domain to scale, consolidating complexity in our system, and we are looking for someone who is excited to influence that. Our team is currently distributed across Norway and Sweden.


Our current tech stack:

* Embedded (software\-close\-to\-hardware) stack is running on IoT devices (Python), acting as a gateway between Sympower Flextool cloud services and customer automation systems accessible via local connections.
* Local steered system with focus on Edge Computing, including the implementation of all Flexibility Markets logic to steer our customer assets.
* Cloud connections stack is running in the cloud (C\# and .NEt), acting as a gateway between other Sympower Flextools cloud services and customer automation systems accessible via the internet
* Cloud components stack is running in the cloud (C\# and .NET), providing APIs via REST
* The front\-end stack is powering the user interfaces we have (AngularJS, TypeScript)

We are committed to creating an inclusive, values\-based culture where everyone feels that they belong and has the opportunity to do meaningful work.


We offer a market competitive compensation package, including but not limited to:

* 1 Day Paid Wellness Leave

* Paid Maternity and Partner Leave
* Pawternity Leave
* Mental Health and Wellbeing Support
* Remote Office Budget

* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers and collaborate effectively with other teams and product management to build our roadmap

* Comfortable navigating ambiguity and change; proactive in making decisions.
* Effective in collaboration and communication across a distributed team.
* Fluent in English.

**Beneficial experience:**

* Understanding of the energy market, with the ability to translate market needs into effective technological solutions.
* Rust or C/C\+\+.
* Knowledge of IoT security protocols, data encryption, authentication, and secure data access in cloud environments.
* Experience architecting and implementing high\-performance, low\-latency services suitable for real\-time control.

**Location:** Within Europe, preferably NL/EE/NO (Remote)


At Sympower, we believe in fair and transparent pay.


Base pay within the range is ultimately determined by a candidate's skills, expertise, and competence. We have four geographic pay zones. For this role, most employees have the following base pay ranges as new hires in each zone:

* Zone A: €39,000 \- €59,840
* Zone B: €49,000 \- €72,160

Please visit https://careers.sympower.net/sympower\-pay\-transparency for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones.

Sympower is accelerating the global transition towards ‘net\-zero’ by helping to build smarter, cleaner renewable energy systems. Using our proprietary software platform, we help balance the supply and demand of electricity across international energy networks.


We help businesses, grid operators, asset owners and other energy stakeholders around the world reduce their carbon emissions, integrate more distributed renewable energy resources, and generate new revenue streams by participating in demand\-side response services.

### **Help Shape the Future of Technology**


Do you want to develop the next generation of embedded systems alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry? At **Sigma Connectivity WSI**, we combine deep technical expertise, global customers, and real innovation in projects that make a difference.

### **About Sigma**


Sigma Connectivity WSI is a specialized unit within Sigma Connectivity – a global design and development house with over 700 experts. We create future\-ready solutions together with some of the world’s most recognized brands. Our Kista office is home to a close\-knit and highly skilled team of about 45 people.

### **About the Role**


As an **Embedded Software Developer**, you will:

* Develop and optimize software for embedded systems using **C/C\+\+**
* Set up and manage build environments in Linux (e.g., **Yocto, kernel, Buildroot**)
* Work close to hardware on platforms such as **NXP** and **Qualcomm**
* Design software architectures based on system requirements
* Participate in both **in\-house** and **on\-site** assignments across different industries


You'll be involved in everything from greenfield development to adapting and improving existing systems – always in close collaboration with customers and internal engineering teams.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* Several years of experience in **C/C\+\+ development** for embedded systems
* Proficiency in **Linux\-based development** (kernel, bootloaders, Yocto)
* Solid understanding of **agile methodologies** and **system\-level architecture**
* Familiarity with **version control**, preferably **Git**
* Proficient in **English**, both written and spoken

**Bonus points for experience with:**

* **RTOS** (Zephyr, FreeRTOS), **OTA solutions**, communication protocols (MQTT, LwM2M)
* **Cloud integration** (Azure IoT, AWS Greengrass), CI/CD pipelines, RF, and test automation
* **Schematic analysis** and working closely with hardware design teams

### **Why Join Sigma Connectivity WSI?**

**Cutting\-edge technology:** Work on assignments for international clients in automotive, telecom, industrial tech, and more

**Hands\-on development:** Access to fully equipped labs to test, build, and validate solutions on\-site

**Stability \& variety:** Permanent position with a wide range of projects – in\-house and customer\-based

**Global reach, local feel:** A tight\-knit team in Kista with the backing of a global tech organization

**Personal growth:** Constant exposure to new technical environments with support from experienced colleagues


### **Location \& Terms**

**Location:** Kista, Stockholm  

**Scope:** Full\-time, permanent employment  

**Start date:** As soon as possible – we’re interviewing continuously  

**Work setup:** Hybrid – the nature of the project determines on\-site presence (typically 3 days/week in the office)


Ready to be part of a company where **technology, teamwork, and customer impact go hand in hand**?

**Apply today – we look forward to hearing from you!**

title: Field Service Engineer – Robotic Waterjet Systems
description:
*Shape Process Automation EMEA is seeking a skilled and motivated Field Service Engineer to join our European team. For this position you need to be located in Midlands, Staffordshire; UK. If you have a passion for robotics, precision engineering, and global travel, this is your opportunity to work with cutting\-edge UHP waterjet cutting systems in a dynamic, international environment.*

**ABOUT US**

*For more than 50 years, Shape Process Automation (SPA) has been continuously developing the areas of robotics, automation, and system integration. With facilities located at various international locations, we handle large\-scale advanced manufacturing needs globally. SPA is an industry leader in the manufacturing of robotized 3D trimming. We are at the forefront of robotics and the overall efficiency of equipment when it comes to automation.*

*Our European headquarters are in Karlshamn, Sweden, where approximately 130 employees work with customized automation solutions. Within our aftermarket department, we have two dedicated service teams—one focused on UHP waterjet cutting systems and the other supporting various automation systems across Sweden and internationally.*

**JOB DESCRIPTION**


As a Field Service Engineer at SPA, you’ll play a key role in delivering and supporting high\-performance robotic UHP waterjet systems to customers located across the UK and globally.


The role includes turn\-key system installation and commissioning, implementing service contracts, upgrades, retrofits, on\-site and remote troubleshooting, and supporting our project managers, sales, and AM team with technical assistance and customer inquiries.


Robot programming and software/path changes using both offline and online methods, providing training to customers, and identifying sales opportunities for additional systems or services are also among your responsibilities.


Regular travel to customer sites in the UK and abroad is required.


This role demands strong technical expertise, adaptability, and a customer\-focused mindset. You’ll be the face of SPA’s aftermarket service—ensuring our systems are running smoothly and efficiently for our customers.


**Location**


Midlands, Staffordshire area.


Home\-based with travel.

**What We Offer**


In addition to a rewarding role in a global automation company, we offer a fully expensed company car, generous holiday allowance, and all tools you need to succeed— phone, laptop, and specialist equipment are also provided.


Our comprehensive benefits package includes pension and healthcare coverage, plus access to an incentive plan that rewards your contributions.


You’ll benefit from ongoing training and development opportunities, and work in a truly international environment where independence, accountability, and collaboration are valued every day.

**What You’ll Need to Succeed**


We’re looking for someone with a solid technical foundation and hands\-on experience in automation. You should hold an HNC/HND or equivalent in an electrical discipline, ideally complemented by a degree in a relevant technical field. Your background may include mechanical, electrical, robotics, controls, field service, or programming experience.


You’ll need strong mechanical aptitude, with the ability to repair or replace components confidently. A good understanding of PLC communications and robotic peripheral equipment is essential. Clear and professional communication in English—both written and verbal—is a must, along with proficiency in MS Office. As this role involves regular travel, a full UK driving license is required.


**Competence and experience**


We’re especially interested in candidates with hands\-on experience in Robotics, PLC’s and hydraulic systems. A strong foundation in electronics and mechanics is highly valued—particularly when it comes to troubleshooting, repairing and servicing across these systems.


Familiarity with Siemens PLC (TIA/Step7\) and ABB industrial robots will give you a strong advantage in this role.


If you have a background in customer service and thrive working independently without supervision, you’ll fit right in.


**Who You Are**


You’re someone who takes pride in delivering exceptional service—proactively meeting the needs of both customers and colleagues. You bring your skills and experience to every task with confidence and a commitment to high\-quality results. You must be a strong team member and thrive in a team environment where cooperation and mutual support are key, but also you can take the initiative and find smart, effective ways to solve problems. You’re open to new ideas and creative approaches, always looking for better ways to get things done.

**How to Apply**  

We welcome your application and encourage you to submit it as soon as possible. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis, so early applications are appreciated. Please apply via our website before November 28, 2025\.

**Questions**


Please contact Mr. Peter Norris, Aftermarket Manager, Phone number: \+44 7917171325, email: peter.norris@shapetechnologies.com

 **Please VISIT OUR WEBSITEs TO DISOVER MORE**

 **Shape Process Automation Europe**

  

Regular travel to customer sites in the UK and abroad is required. Good physical condition is required.

title: Automation Engineer at Oatly
description:
**WHY OATLY?**
--------------


Across the world people’s consumption habits and diets are evolving to be more plant\-based. Enter Oatly, the \#1 oat based dairy alternative producer in the world with products spanning multiple categories.


We’re determined on being part of the discussion on the long\-term future of the food and beverage industry. To keep this movement going, we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the Oatly flowing.


Our sole purpose as a company is to make it easy for people to turn what they eat and drink into personal moments of healthy joy without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process.


Sustainability, nutritional health, and trust are at the heart of what we do. We are building a culture that constantly upgrades each other so we can upgrade the planet. This is a company that shows great respect and a fearless approach to make positive change. Does this feel exciting? Well, this is where you come in.

#### **WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO**


The purpose of the role as Automation Engineer, you will be driving the development and performance of the Automation portfolio.


###### **Here’s the main elements of the role:**

* Act as a Process Owner and secure the long\-term development of the automation process
* Own and develop (short and long term) of Oatly process control system and Manufacturing
* Produce design specifications for software and hardware
* Manage change control within the automation system and MES, coordinating this with a global perspective in coordination with IT
* Drive the development of efficient solutions, meeting our quality standards, from design to commissioning and startup
* Arrange for design reviews, FAT, integration tests, and other audits connected to capex projects and improvement projects
* Participate in risk assessment and management within the automation area
* The role also includes troubleshooting and providing support
* Connect to and support the “Oatly Class” manufacturing system


But, you know. These are just the things we can think of right now! This might be the job today, but tomorrow brings more change, so being light on your feet and willing to embrace the unknown is a verrrrrry big help.


In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager, and the position is based at the heart of Oatly, our factory in Landskrona.


This next section is for all the bullet point lovers out there...

#### **WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE**


We are looking for you who have prior experience in leading automation projects within the food and beverage industry, acting within a central function in a global company.

###### **Other key competencies \& experiences:**

* Experience acting as a product owner internally, collaborating with IT/BizTech and other departments within the SCO, as well as managing external suppliers
* Experience managing both long\- and short\-term automation projects in an international setting, including budget responsibility
* Experience in process development and strong programming skills in automation systems
* Solid experience with network and field bus systems
* Senior expertise in PLC/SCADA/MES systems from different vendors
* Systems knowledge of Siemens TIA Portal
* A relevant education in Automation, Electrical Engineering or a related field
* Experience in troubleshooting and providing technical support as part of daily operations


#### **WHO WE NEED YOU TO BE**

###### **We think your oatsomeness is built upon the following qualities:**

* You are a passionate advocate for sustainability who strives to create societal shifts and drive the plant\-based revolution
* You have problem\-solving skills essential for identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions
* You are a self\-starter who enjoys building from scratch and implementing sustainable processes, structures, and tools
* You are highly collaborative and understand that our success as a company depends on our ability to work together to find innovative solutions
* You are an entrepreneur at heart, with the know\-how to create forward momentum and the stamina to relentlessly drive the process


To be the perfect fit for Oatly, we believe you have a thirst for knowledge and are a result\-driven person with high integrity. You thrive with a hands\-on approach, even in times of rapid change. Your social competence allows you to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.


Finally, we hope that you share our values and have a great interest to carry out our mission in order to make the world a little bit better.

#### **YOUR APPLICATION**

 **Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.**

  

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm\-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, let’s do this together! It will be fun!

*Last day of application: 3rd of December.*

*We treat all candidates equally: If you are interested, please apply through our application system \- any correspondence should come from there. This will ensure that the candidate experience is smooth and fair to everyone!*

 *Love Oatly XOXO*

description:

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join Kambi's Data Platform stream, where they will play a key role in building and scaling a decentralized, self\-serviced data platform as part of our Data Mesh journey. At Kambi, we believe in the power of data to inform, improve, and transform — and our goal is to enable teams across the organization through high\-quality, accessible data products.
  
The Role \& Responsibilities
  
As a Data Engineer, you will help shape our modern data platform by aligning data mesh principles with the practical implementation of reliable, scalable data products. You'll contribute both to the technical foundation of our platform and to cross\-functional initiatives that drive adoption and support business stakeholders. You will design and implement analytical data models that enable data insights for stakeholders.
  
You'll initially join the Data Warehouse team, collaborating closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers and stakeholders to build and maintain data products that serve real business needs. Over time, you may work in smaller cross\-functional teams focused on specific domains within our unified data platform.
  
  

**Key aspects of the role:**  

Build and maintain data models using dbt.
  
Support the creation and lifecycle management of domain\-oriented data products,
  
Contribute to the platform's evolution from a traditional data warehouse to a Lakehouse architecture (powered by Iceberg, Trino, and AWS),
  
Collaborate with business users to understand data needs and translate them into robust, reusable data transformations,
  
Help define and advocate for best practices in data modeling, CI/CD, and orchestration
  
  

Your Profile
  
We believe you may recognize yourself in several of the following:
  
Previous experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a similar field,
  
Solid experience with SQL for complex analytical queries and performance optimization for reporting workloads, and working knowledge of Python,
  
Hands\-on experience with dbt or similar transformation tools,
  
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and cloud\-based infrastructure (especially AWS),
  
Experience in close collaboration with analytics engineers and business users to develop data solutions optimized for reporting and business intelligence,
  
Bonus if you have experience with orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow) or containerization (e.g. k8s).
  
  

Above all, you are curious, collaborative, and motivated to help teams use data more effectively. You enjoy engaging in technical discussions, learning new tools, and helping others find simple solutions to complex problems.

title: Software Engineer
description:
At Cellink, we Create the Future of Health by leveraging the power of 3D cell culture through award\-winning 3D bioprinters and carefully sourced biomaterials and bioinks.
  
  

About the role
  
A Software Engineer develops and optimizes the communication layers that enable secure, real\-time data exchange between embedded systems, high\-level applications, and bio fabrication hardware. The role includes integrating embedded Linux, C\+\+, Python, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and high\-performance system behavior. They collaborate closely with firmware, hardware, and other teams to achieve seamless system interoperability and support the advancement of next\-generation 3D Bio printing technology.
  
  

Responsibilities and Duties
  
Develop and debug software across the entire product range, from low\-level drivers and firmware interfaces to high\-level application and service layers. Ensure smooth integration and functionality between embedded systems, middleware, and user\-facing applications.
  
Design, build, and maintain middleware layers that enable robust, real\-time communication between hardware components and cloud or desktop applications, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity, data integrity, and regulatory requirements.
  
Build and maintain automated test systems and simulation environments to validate middleware behavior, detect regressions, and ensure consistent code quality across software versions.
  
Maintain clear and accurate documentation for both new and existing middleware components, including architecture diagrams, communication protocols and integration guides.
  
Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to data synchronization, performance bottlenecks, memory usage, and system\-level bugs, working closely with cross\-functional teams.
  
Collaborate with hardware engineers, firmware developers, and application developers to ensure seamless system interoperability.
  
Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture planning to continuously enhance the scalability and maintainability of the codebase.
  
Advocate for best practices in software development, including version control, code reuse, modularity, and testability.
  
  

Qualifications
  
Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  
Certifications in relevant technologies (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Microsoft Azure Developer) are a plus.
  
Approximately 3 years of industry experience in software or systems engineering, with at least 2 years focused on systems integration.
  
Experience working in high\-performance environments involving hardware\-software interactions, such as robotics or medical devices.
  
  

Candidates should have strong embedded software development experience for resource\-constrained and real\-time systems. Proficiency in C\+\+ is required, with knowledge of at least one additional language, preferably Python. Experience with Marlin or other 3D\-printing firmware, as well as slicer software, is a strong advantage.
  
  

The role spans the full software stack, including low\-level drivers, communication protocols, service layers, and desktop or embedded UIs. Familiarity with Qt is beneficial.
  
  

Experience with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins is expected, along with developing test systems and writing unit, integration, and regression tests for both simulated and hardware environments. Knowledge of secure boot, certificate\-based authentication, and secure key storage is valuable. Expertise with over\-the\-air update solutions such as Mender and custom Linux builds using Yocto is highly beneficial.
  
  

As we also believe, having a strong attention to detail and a quality\-driven mindset is essential for achieving high standards and effectively overcoming challenges. Equally important are excellent communication skills, creative thinking, and the ability to solve problems analytically with a structured approach to tasks.
  
  

Practical conditions
  
This role primarily requires onsite presence, with remote work allowed only as needed and with manager approval.
  
Flexibility to adjust work hours for collaboration across multiple time zones, including periods that may exceed the standard work week.
  
  

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
  
BICO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  

Cellink a part of BICO GROUP

With 46,000\+ instruments installed in over 65 countries, BICO products, software, and solutions are found in more than 3,500 laboratories, including the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical companies, and have been cited in over 12,000 publications.
  
Operating through two business areas – Lab Automation and Life Science Solutions – BICO strive towards the vision to enable and automate the life science lab of the future.

title: Entry level Software Engineer to Coretura – AI Specialist Program
description:

As a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, Coretura combines the speed and creativity of a startup with the strength of global industry leaders. If you’re passionate about coding, eager to learn, and ready to apply AI in real\-world projects, this is your chance to make an impact from day one.*

**ABOUT THE TALENT PROGRAM**


The AI Specialist Program is a 12\-month journey run by Hubbau in collaboration with TokenTek and Coretura. During the program, you’ll be employed by Hubbau and work as a consultant at Coretura. After the program, the ambition is that you continue your journey as a Coretura employee.


During the year, you will go through a training program together with TokenTek that will take you from n00b to expert in building and using AI tools. Our goal is to give you a fun, challenging and rewarding first year in tech, one that builds both your technical depth and professional confidence. The program combines deep technical knowledge with hands\-on experience, taking you from AI fundamentals to advanced real\-world projects.


**Start:** February 3rd, 2026


**Location:** Lindholmen, Gothenburg  

  

**THIS IS CORETURA**

**Coretura** is redefining the future of commercial vehicles—and you can be part of it. The company is building an open, standardized digital platform and operating system that will power next\-generation of commercial vehicles and connected mobility solutions.


At Coretura, AI is more than a buzzword, it’s embedded in the company’s DNA. Developers collaborate with advanced AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate processes from test creation to full implementation. Engineers concentrate on strategy, innovation, and problem\-solving, while AI manages repetitive and time\-consuming tasks. This approach represents the future of software development—and it’s a reality at Coretura every single day.

**DESCRIPTION OT THE ROLES**


At Coretura you will belong to one of their software development teams but also regularly collaborate on projects with people across the organisation. As Coretura is a young, fast\-growing and dynamic company, roles and responsibilities aren’t set in stone but will change and develop over time. Their tech stack is based on C\+\+ for real\-time systems, Rust for safety\-critical apps and Python for automation.


For this talent program we are looking for people with an interest in applying their skills in one or several of the areas below:


* Automating test frameworks, predictive failure analysis, and intelligent validation.
* Build data pipelines, prepare AI\-ready datasets, and learn cloud\-native architectures for scalable AI solutions.
* Apply AI for threat detection, compliance monitoring, and optimize code for better performance and user experience.
* Enhancing user experience and system integration through AI\-powered interfaces and code optimization.

We’re looking for curious, driven and humble engineers who want to take the first real step into the world of AI. You’re passionate about technology, problem\- solving and eager to learn how AI can be applied in practice, from generative models to agent\-based systems and multimodal architectures.


You enjoy working together with others and want to grow in an environment where learning and innovation go hand in hand.

title: Solution Architect ESW
description:

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**About the role**
------------------


Our world is a world of change.


Our organization is based on people and great teamwork. We are a truly global company; we rely on diversity and together we create a workplace that brings the best out of everyone.


Here at Volvo CE, we are driven by the idea that through imagination, hard work and technological innovation we will lead the way towards developing a world that is cleaner, smarter and more connected.


We believe in a sustainable future and with the global construction industry as our arena, we work together with our customers to turn this belief into reality for people everywhere. That is our purpose,

Do you want to be a part of building the world we want to live in?


Right now, we are looking for an experienced Solution Architect to lead the architecture and strategic direction for our embedded software flows, including software entering and exiting our machines. This role is pivotal in managing complexity and accelerating our development capabilities within a rapidly evolving technology landscape. Reporting directly to the Head of Architecture, you'll collaborate closely with the Architecture team, Head of Software Solutions, Digital Product Managers (DPMs), and stakeholders within Product Lifecycle Management to define and deliver robust, scalable, and future\-proof solutions.

  

Your key responsibilities would be:

* Define and own the architectural vision and strategy for embedded software flows and related toolchains.
* Document current and target state architectures, clearly identifying and addressing gaps to facilitate strategic growth.
* Establish architectural guidelines, best practices, and ensure alignment with our North Star architecture.
* Work hands\-on with teams to translate business and product lifecycle needs into effective architectural requirements and solutions.
* Lead efforts to simplify complex processes and systems, enabling greater agility and speed in our development activities.
* Continuously monitor industry trends to proactively drive improvements and innovations in our software flows.
**Who are you?**
----------------


In this role, we think you will bring:

* Extensive experience in software development or architecture, specifically related to embedded software and complex integration flows.
* Exceptional communication skills, able to engage effectively across all levels of the organization, from technical teams to senior management.
* Proven ability to navigate and simplify complexity in environments with mixed technology stacks.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and strategic\-thinking capabilities
* Deep familiarity with modern architectural practices (e.g., cloud\-native development, microservices, event\-driven architecture, APIs, DevOps practices).


You might also bring:

* Experience in documenting architectures clearly and effectively (ArchiMate, UML, or similar).
**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------

* A collaborative and dynamic environment where teamwork across organizational boundaries is deeply valued.
* High autonomy and opportunities for personal and professional growth within a supportive culture.
* The chance to significantly impact the strategic direction and success of our software architecture in a highly innovative and growing area.


If you are motivated by tackling complex architectural challenges and thrive in collaborative, high\-autonomy environments, we'd love to hear from you!


Last application day is 11th of January. If you have question, contact Fredrik Hjort at fredrik.hjort@volvo.com

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

Our focus on Inclusion, Diversity, and Equity allows each of us the opportunity to bring our full authentic self to work and thrive by providing a safe and supportive environment, free of harassment and discrimination. We are committed to removing the barriers to entry, which is why we ask that even if you feel you may not meet every qualification on the job description, please apply and let us decide.

  

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group.** Every day, across the globe, our trucks, buses, engines, construction equipment, financial services, and solutions make modern life possible. We are almost 100,000 people empowered to shape the future landscape of efficient, safe and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents with sharp minds and passion across the group’s leading brands and entities.

  

Part of Volvo Group, **Volvo Construction Equipment** is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone’s full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

title: IT-Infrastructure & Cybersecurity Engineer
description:

Det här är en tjänst för dig som vill kombinera praktiskt infrastrukturarbete med strukturerat säkerhetsarbete och utvecklas i en miljö där ordning, stabilitet och trygghet är centralal
  
Arbetsuppgifter
  
I den här rollen arbetar du nära både det lokala IT\-teamet och den globala säkerhetsorganisationen. Ditt fokus är att stärka säkerheten i infrastrukturen, driva förbättringar och säkerställa att miljön är robust, stabil och följer etablerade säkerhetsstandarder.

Implementera och förbättra säkerhetskonfigurationer enligt CIS, NIST och ISO 27001
  
Stötta lokala team i frågor som rör cybersäkerhet och efterlevnad av policyer
  
Delta i revisioner, sårbarhetsskanningar och penetrationstester
  
Hantera incidenter i samarbete med SOC, till exempel malware, misstänka inloggningar och privilegieeskaleringar
  
Administrera Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS och DHCP
  
Arbeta i VMware\-miljöer med provisionering, resurshantering och underhåll
  
Bidra i drift, incidenter, förändringshantering och projekt som rör säkerhetshärdning
  
  

Det är en roll med både praktiskt teknikarbete och ansvar för säkerhetsrelaterade förbättringar.
  
**Kvalifikationer:** 2 till 4 års erfarenhet av IT\-infrastruktur eller cybersäkerhet
  
Kunskaper inom Windows Server, Active Directory och Group Policy
  
Grundläggande förståelse för säkerhetsprinciper som least privilege, nätverkssegmentering, autentisering och kryptering
  
Erfarenhet av patchhantering och arbete med sårbarheter
  
Erfarenhet av VMware och PowerShell
  
Svenska och engelska flytande, både tal och skrift
  
**Meriterande:** Erfarenhet från industri eller produktionsmiljö
  
Kännedom om OT\-system
  
Certifieringar som CompTIA Security Plus, Microsoft eller ISO 27001
  
Erfarenhet av SIEM\-verktyg och incidenthantering
  
  

**Personliga egenskaper:**  

Vi söker dig som är nyfiken, noggrann och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs i en miljö där teknik och säkerhet går hand i hand och du tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och en vilja att utvecklas i en global organisation med höga krav på efterlevnad och kvalitet.
  
  

**Om CONSULTING it:**  

När du börjar hos oss som konsult på CONSULTING it blir du en del av vår gemenskap. Du får dessutom kollegor runt om i Sverige! Du har en dedikerad konsultchef som stöttar dig och din utveckling. Vi hjälper dig hitta nya vägar genom att prova på nya roller och nya branscher, för oss är det viktigt att du trivs på din arbetsplats. Vi ser till att du hamnar på ett bra bolag under ditt uppdrag och att uppdragen ligger i linje med hur du vill utvecklas framöver. Oavsett vad det blir, står vi bakom dig hela vägen – i ditt nästa, nästa och nästa steg. Gå med i vårt team och ta del av en spännande och utvecklande arbetsmiljö!

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**
--------------------


Volvo Group Digital \& IT has the ambition to enable value creation at scale for the Volvo Group. With a product\-centric operation model and digital technologies, we produce digital offerings that are profitable, scalable, and differentiated.

  

In Digital Technologies \- IoT \& Edge Computing, you will contribute to the transformation and digitalization of the Volvo Group. Our team and technology are evolving, and we are now looking for a skilled DevSecOps Engineer to join us, focusing on secure, scalable, and automated cloud infrastructure. You will play a key role in integrating security into our DevOps processes, leveraging Cloud \& Edge technologies to deliver robust solutions.

 **You will:**

* Be part of a global agile team working with IoT, deployment of the IoT platform and development of the IoT Foundational product
* Help to accelerate development by automating deployment processes, implementing CI/CD pipelines, and managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices
* Deploy \& monitor containerized applications using, for example Kubernetes
* Design, implement, and manage secure cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, as well as deploying and managing infrastructure on the edge \& on\-prem
* Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to ensure value creation
* Monitor vulnerabilities through appointed tooling and proactively implement effective remediation strategies to address and resolve security issues.
* Explore new technologies (Proof of Concept / Proof of Value) to test and understand if a proposed technology has some potential to bring value to the Volvo Group.

 **Your future team**


Digital Technologies has 130\+ talents worldwide. We develop foundational products based on cutting edge technologies supporting and creating business apps efficiently. We are an incubator to industrialize new digital technologies throughout Volvo Group.

  

The IoT \& Edge Computing area in Digital Technologies is composed of 3 global teams (approximately 7 members per team) with the objective to facilitate adoption and industrialization of IoT \& Edge Computing technologies in Volvo Group. Your team are responsible for the IoT Foundational product; we enable others to develop IoT applications, faster, scalable and more secure.

**Who are you?**
----------------


Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together.

  

In this role, mandatory skills and experiences are:

* Proven experience in DevSecOps, DevOps, or related roles
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Azure) including security best practices
* Strong background in CI/CD, and modern infrastructure tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
* Experienced in Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) for automated provisioning
* Automation using scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell)

  

Recommended experience:

* Previous knowledge of Azure IoT services and experience in IT/OT architecture
* Knowledge of Azure IoT Operations
* Past experiences in IT within the manufacturing domain
* Background as a full stack Software Engineer

  

We are looking for someone that has passion for new technologies, like innovation and adaptable for the situation. Moreover, if you are self\-going and communicate easily, then we can be a good match.

**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------


We offer a solid package of compensation and benefits.


And you’ll be part of a skilled and friendly team working on innovative solutions that support the Volvo Group’s digital transformation. Our recently renovated offices provide a modern and inspiring workspace.


We believe you would like to take your career to the next level and work within a fantastic \& highly skilled global team that is working cross functional throughout the Volvo Group.


You will enjoy working in close collaboration with various stakeholders motivated by the digitalization of Volvo factories and will deliver cutting edge services in line with the Volvo Group Strategy.

**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------


Are you excited to bring your skills and disruptive ideas to the table? We can’t wait to hear from you. Apply today!

  

“In some countries and for specific positions within Volvo Group Digital \& IT, background checks may be required, in accordance with local laws \& regulations. If this is applicable to the role you have applied for, you will be informed.”

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**  

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

  

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

 **Group Digital \& IT** is the hub for digital development within Volvo Group. Imagine yourself working with cutting\-edge technologies in a global team, represented in more than 30 countries. We are dedicated to leading the way of tomorrow’s transport solutions, guided by a strong customer mindset and high level of curiosity, both as individuals and as a team. Here, you will thrive in your career in an environment where your voice is heard and your ideas matter.

description:
*Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At* Stegra, we’re building an impact\-driven, sustainable company \- and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.


Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big \- while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

**What you’ll do**


Right now, we are looking for a Lead Infrastructure Engineer for our Digital Site Services. In this role you will report to our Digital Domain Manager and sit within our Digital function. The team is responsible for deliver secure, resilient, and innovative infrastructure solutions, including fully redundant datacenters. As our Lead Infrastructure Engineer, you’ll play a vital role in designing and maintaining the systems that power our Digital Factory. Based in Boden and part of Strega’s dynamic digital team, you’ll ensure our platforms drive productivity, safety, and sustainability.


Specific to this role, the day\-to\-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

  

* Oversee the deployment, commissioning, and configuration of digital infrastructure, including both hardware and software.
* Configure and operate physical servers, storage, backup systems, datacenter support functions, as well as virtualization environments (both on\-premises and in the cloud).
* Work closely with team members and vendors to design digital infrastructure and implement best practices.
* Define operational processes for monitoring and maintaining infrastructure, ensuring secure, efficient, and reliable operations.
* Develop plans for maintenance and support to minimize downtime and ensure smooth operations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, prioritize infrastructure requirements, and ensure the safe and robust platform while improving productivity, safety, and sustainability in the factory.
* Create and document best practices, and mentor team members to foster growth and improve infrastructure operations.
* Participate in an on\-call rotation together with other team members to support the 24/7 operation of critical infrastructure.

  

**What you’ll bring**


We’re seeking someone with a proactive and collaborative mindset who thrives in a dynamic environment. You excel at problem\-solving, organization, and clear communication, especially when explaining technical solutions to non\-technical stakeholders. Empathy for end\-users and a passion for creating technology that improves their daily work are key traits we value.


Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

* A University degree or equivalent experience, Bachelor or Master’s in Engineering or Computer Science.
* Expertise with administration of Linux and Windows based systems.
* Relevant experience in datacenter operations.
* Hands\-on experience with configuring and managing virtualization environments such as VMware / Nutanix.
* Hands\-on experience in Infrastructure provisioning and configuration management via infrastructure as code (IaC) – Ansible / Terraform.
* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes for Containers management, deployment and scaling.
* Knowledge of Cybersecurity best practices, and experience in analyzing possible threats and vulnerabilities, embedding security standards, monitoring adherence to them, and implementing disaster recovery plans.
* Experience with Active Directory and Users management systems.
* Very good experience with AWS services configuration and management.
* Experience with performance monitoring and troubleshooting for hosts, servers, databases, virtual machines, containers.
* Good knowledge of networks and network protocols.
* Experience with Data Backup solutions.
* Experience in writing scripts with at least one scripting language — such as Python, Java, JavaScript, etc.
* Experience with OT infrastructure such as Historians, HMI, Scada, Edge gateways.
* Experience with Agile and DevOps methodologies, and with Continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) platforms.

**Location:** Boden, Sweden

 **Benefits at Stegra**  

  

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.


You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.


Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

**This is Stegra**


Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel \- with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil\-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.


By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden \- currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.




**Our Boden Site**


Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10\-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting\-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Since 2006, we’ve done things differently.


At Ridestore, growth has never been about chasing numbers. It’s about building a company where curiosity and a passion for learning drive everything. Our most important product isn’t just our gear, it’s our culture. That’s why from day one, we’ve avoided rigid corporate structures and instead focused on creating the company we’d love to work for.


...we value flexibility and calmness, and aim for asynchronous communication, and with that, avoiding unnecessary meetings and focusing on deep, meaningful work.


...we’re an idea\-driven crew, powered by creativity, bold thinking, and collaboration.


...we believe that if we become a little bit better every day, it leads to long\-term success.


..we love working with smart, humble people; it just makes everything more fun.


...and we co\-create with our customers, obsessing over quality and experience. That’s why you’ll spot our brands on slopes all over the world.

### **The role**

At Ridestore, quality is more than just specs and inspections; it’s how we **deliver WOW** to our customers through every detail. We’re now looking for a QA Engineer who’s ready to take ownership of our quality assurance work from the inside out, building trust, structure, and smarter ways of working with our suppliers and teams.

### **The first six months**


You’ll focus on learning to swim in our context:

* Getting to know **Ridestore**: our culture, our ways, and what quality means here
* Understanding our **products, materials, and quality standards**: from idea to final delivery
* Taking ownership of **your projects**: leading quality initiatives with confidence and curiosity
* You’ll grow into being one of the **key drivers of how we assure quality** across our production and supplier ecosystem

### **What we see you driving in the long term**

* **Drive and structure** the QA function alongside your teammates and turn experience into scalable systems
* **Own and maintain** our quality documentation, making sure it reflects our current processes and ways of working
* **Lead inspections** (PPS, 1st three inspections, IPC) and ensure standards are followed through
* **Manage our Qarma system**; Using it to collaborate and communicate with suppliers on inspection results, feedback loops, and improvement actions
* **Plan and perform factory inspections, audits, and visits**, staying close to the reality on the ground
* **Represent QA internally**, analyzing data and sharing insights that drive change in both products and processes
* **Build strong relationships with suppliers** by staying connected through strategic discussions, daily collaboration, and detailed troubleshooting
* **Handle and follow up** on any quality issues in bulk production, identifying the root cause rather than just the symptom

### **Who you are**


You bring a solid background in **Quality Assurance within manufacturing**, and you’re no stranger to the production floor. You understand the methods, but you also challenge them. You use systems like **PLM, Excel, and QMS tools** naturally and can turn complexity into clarity.


You’re a **problem\-solver at heart**; curious, analytical, and detail\-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture. You care about collaboration and thrive when working closely with others to create lasting impact. Most importantly, you stay humble, calm, and open even when things get tough.

### **This is for you if you**

* Love improving systems and spotting smarter ways of working
* Believe in **quality as a team sport**, not a solo function
* Get energy from combining **hands\-on work** (inspections, audits) with **strategic improvements** (process design, supplier collaboration)
* Feel at home in a culture built on **trust, autonomy, and grit**
* **Can travel** 3\-4 times a year, to our factories and partners


It's a full\-time role with a base in Gothenburg, Sweden, where we have our only office. We’re all for flexibility, but in this role, we expect you to spend approximately four days a week at the office. (Note: To process your application, it’s essential to at least have a work permit in Sweden.)

### **What’s in it for you**


At Ridestore, you’ll get the space to **build, not just maintain**. You’ll join a team that’s constantly learning, experimenting, and sharing ideas, where infinite learning and co\-creation are not buzzwords but daily habits.


So join us if you want to be part of a fun\-loving and humble crew that goes its own way. Our journey is our goal. We’ll offer you freedom in a passionate and snowy environment where you can impact the future of Ridestore with your work. ‍

**How we do it**


In the application flow, we’ll ask you a few written questions to understand you better. Therefore, there's no need to spend time writing a cover letter! We’re working with our favorite external recruiter, Lisa, in this role, so she will handle the initial phase of this process.

Implementera realtidslösningar för att hantera strömmande data och möjliggöra aktuella och relevanta insikter.

People who enjoy working in cross\-functional expert teams to solve challenging technical problems in many different areas.

**Your Role**


As Senior Functional Safety Engineer, you will be involved in product development activities where your main responsibility will be to both drive the overall safety activities and knowledge sharing in the Qamcom system safety journey, as well as providing hands on support to development organizations. This support will be ranging from planning of development to secure safety, down to leading and performing functional safety activities in accordance with set ways of working and instructions.


You will maintain a high level of integrity, credibility and competence when providing a common direction to secure development of safe products.


Occasional travels can be required.

**Your Qualifications**

* M.Sc. Degree or PhD in Software, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation or equivalent.
* You have in\-depth knowledge and experience of ISO 26262 and its application.
* Experience of performing assessment \& audits.
* Senior experience in developing electronic or software systems, preferable with a combination of functional\-, system\-, hardware and software development for embedded systems.
* Experience from agile product development in a large organization is a strong merit.
* Practical experience from other related standards e.g. SOTIF and IEC 61508 is a merit.
* Leadership and hands on coaching experience is a merit
* Since you will be reviewing complex work products written in English, it is important that your English skill is at a level of C1 minimum.
* **Your personality**
* You have a high level of drive, integrity, independence and perseverance.
* You have excellent communication skills with a natural ability and desire to train and coach others.
* You have a keen eye for understanding the business needs and balancing the pragmatic and theoretical application and approach.
* You will be part of a team that treats consultants as a full team member \- with a lot of fun, nice colleagues, good office environment and a smart work\-life\-balance.

**About Qamcom**


Qamcom has the ambition to make an impact and create value through technology.


We have a highly diverse assortment of high\-profile in\-house product development projects and external assignments across different industries and with many different goals and purposes. The common denominator is the technical edge of our projects and that we join our customers early in the problem solving or product development cycle and often take a project the whole way from a blank paper to a complete product or solution ready for commercial deployment.


Being an expert at Qamcom typically means that you enjoy solving challenging technical problems and strive to evolve both personally and professionally. All Qamcom experts have a background including at least 6 years of relevant industrial experience or a technical PhD education.

title: Senior Process Engineer - Advanced Packaging
description:
**Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture.**


For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what's next, at the forefront of innovation and what's technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving. But we're more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

  



As a Senior Process Engineer in our Corporate Research \& Development team, you'll shape the future of atomic layer deposition (ALD) innovation. By combining your technical know\-how with a collaborative mindset, you'll drive new process development from concept through integration, working on technologies that power tomorrow's logic, memory, and advanced packaging solutions. Your creativity, hands\-on experimentation, and clear communication will bring ideas to life—delivering value across teams and customers.


### **What you will be working on**


* Develop new deposition processes and integration flows for logic, memory, packaging, analog, and power applications.
* Design and execute experiments; analyze complex data to draw actionable conclusions.
* Work hands\-on with advanced semiconductor tools, optimizing processes and equipment synergy.
* Collaborate with internal and customer R\&D teams to define requirements and successfully deliver project outcomes.
* Support product transfers and demonstrations across sites, including knowledge sharing and occasional travel.

### **What we are looking for**


* PhD in physics, chemistry, chemical engineering, or materials science, ideally with a thesis linked to semiconductors or thin film technologies. Alternatively, a Master's degree with several years of relevant industry experience is welcome.
* Solid foundation in semiconductor device physics, process integration, and cleanroom practices.
* Proven expertise in thin film deposition techniques such as Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) and Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD).
* Skilled in material and process characterization tools including XPS, AFM, XRD, TEM, ellipsometry, and electrical testing methods.
* Experience in designing, conducting, and interpreting complex experiments using scientific and statistical methods.
* Ability to work hands\-on with advanced semiconductor R\&D tools and equipment.
* Strong project management skills: capable of taking projects from concept to completion while engaging with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* A proactive communicator who thrives in multidisciplinary, collaborative environments.

### **What sets you apart**


* Specialized knowledge of 3D integration and advanced packaging concepts such as wafer\-to\-wafer (W2W) and die\-to\-wafer (D2W) hybrid bonding, memory\-on\-memory, logic\-on\-memory, imager stacking, and low\-temperature device architectures.
* Familiarity with advanced packaging characterization methods such as CSAM, WCA, Maszara test, and 3\-point bending.
* Practical cleanroom experience using lithography, solvent\-based wet etch, dry etch, and PVD deposition techniques.
* Exposure to process development projects that required close interaction between hardware and chemistry optimization.
* A systems\-level thinker with the ability to understand how process innovations impact full integration flows and device performance.
* Curious and driven by impact: someone who stays on top of scientific trends, explores new ideas with an open mind, and balances creativity with practical execution.
* Adaptable and growth\-oriented, with the motivation to develop both technically and personally in a fast\-paced environment.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. title: Kokenut ohjelmistokehittäjä/arkkitehti teollisuuden toimialan projekteihin
description:
**Onko mielenkiintonasi päästä vaikuttamaan teollisen digitalisaation tulevaisuuteen? Haemme nyt teollisuuden digitaalisiin ratkaisuihin erikoistuneita kokeneita ohjelmistokehittäjiä ja ohjelmistoarkkitehteja osaksi Intelligent Devices \-tiimiämme. Pääset työskentelemään merkityksellisessä roolissa, jossa yhdistyvät vahvasti sekä teknologia että liiketoiminta.**

Teollisuuden alat elävät murroksessa, jossa muutokset tapahtuvat kiihtyvällä tahdilla ja uudistumisen tarve on suuri. Teollinen digitalisaatio, vihreä siirtymä ja talouden epävarmuudet muokkaavat tapaa, jolla organisaatiot luovat arvoa ja toimivat keskenään. Monen perinteisen laitevalmistajan tulevaisuus rakentuu yhä enemmän ohjelmistojen ympärille.

Solitan tavoitteena on auttaa valmistavan teollisuuden yrityksiä kääntämään nämä muutokset kilpailueduksi tarjoamalla laaja\-alaista digitaalista osaamista, joka yhdistää teknologian, datan ja ihmisnäkemyksen. Asiakasportfoliomme on monipuolinen, ja teemme yhteistyötä monen suuren teollisuuden toimialan yrityksen kanssa. Lisätietoa Solita Industrial \-liiketoiminnasta ja asiakasreferensseistämme löydät täältä: **Solita Industrial**.

Liiketoimintamme jatkaessa kasvuaan, etsimme nyt uusia kokeneita ohjelmistokehittäjiä ja ohjelmistoarkkitehteja osaksi Intelligent Devices \-tiimiämme, joka keskittyy teollisuuden toimialan **IoT\- ja Edge Computing \-projekteihin**. Tiimimme toteuttaa asiakkaillemme räätälöityjä ohjelmistoratkaisuja teollisuuden älykkäisiin laitteisiin, kuten droneihin, metsäkoneisiin ja erilaisiin valmistavan teollisuuden järjestelmiin. Voit työskennellä tässä roolissa toimistokaupungeissamme Helsingissä, Tampereella, Turussa, Oulussa, Jyväskylässä, Lahdessa, Porissa, Kuopiossa ja Joensuussa tai etänä mistä tahansa päin Suomea.
### **Roolisi kokeneena ohjelmistokehittäjänä:**



Tässä roolissa työskentelet erilaisissa Edge Computing ja teollisen IoT:n ratkaisuihin keskittyvissä asiakasprojekteissa – pääset yhdistämään fyysisen ja digitaalisen maailman hyödyntäen työssäsi modernimpia teknologioita. Rooliisi kokeneena ohjelmistokehittäjänä kuuluu turvallisten, skaalautuvien ja asiakkaan tarpeisiin sopivien ohjelmistoratkaisujen suunnittelu, toteutus ja ylläpito. Rooli edellyttää vahvaa teknistä osaamista, ongelmanratkaisutaitoja ja kykyä työskennellä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja tiimin kanssa koko projektin elinkaaren ajan. Näemme tärkeänä hyvät ohjelmistokehityksen käytännöt sekä sen, että asiantuntijamme jakavat halun oppia uutta sekä kehittyä kehittäjänä.

Odotamme sinulta:
* Muutaman vuoden relevanttia kokemusta middleware\-ohjelmistokehityksestä joillakin seuraavista teknologioista: Java/Kotlin, C\#, TypeScript, Python tai Go.
* Vahvaa kokemusta julkipilvialustoista: Azure tai AWS.
* Aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuusautomaatioon, IoT:n tai Edge Computing \-ohjelmistokehitysprojektien tiimoilta.
* Isona etuna näemme, jos olet työskennellyt Azure IoT Hubin, AWS IoT Coren tai AWS IoT Greengrassin kanssa.
* Eduksi luetaan myös tuntemus keskeisistä teollisuuden teknologioista ja alustoista, kuten Kubernetes, KubeEdge, OPC UA, MQTT ja Crosser.
* Myös ymmärrys IT/OT\-dataputkien rakentamista Azureen tai AWS:ään nähdään etuna.
* Odotamme, että olet kiinnostunut tekoälyn tuomista mahdollisuuksista ja että sinulla on jo kokemusta tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä joko henkilökohtaisessa elämässä tai työkontekstissa.
* Kommunikoit sujuvasti sekä suomen että englannin kielellä.

### **Roolisi ohjelmistoarkkitehtina:**



Roolisi ohjelmistoarkkitehtina kattaa ohjelmistoratkaisujen suunnittelun ja kehittämisen sekä projektitiimin teknisen ohjauksen. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä sekä asiakkaan että projektitiimin kanssa kehittääksesi yhdessä sellaisia ratkaisuja, jotka vastaavat asiakkaan tarpeisiin – autat, mutta myös haastat ja opastat asiakasta keskittymään oikeisiin ongelmiin, tavoitteenasi luoda maksimaalista arvoa asiakkaalle. Projektityön lisäksi pääset vaikuttamaan myös mahdollisiin tuleviin projekteihin, kun osallistut teknisenä asiantuntijana myyntityöhön Edge ja IIoT\-ratkaisuissa: avustat tarjousten laatimisessa, osallistut asiakastapaamisiin, sekä teet määrittelytyötä ja arkkitehtuurisuunnittelua.

Ohjelmistokehittäjän kyvykkyysien lisäksi odotamme sinulta näitä asioita:
* Olet työskennellyt teknisen ohjelmistoarkkitehtin roolissa, ja kokemuksesi myötä osaat sekä määritellä että suunnitella projektien teknisen perustan ja arkkitehtuurin.
* Osaat toimia linkkiä liiketoiminnan ja teknologian välillä: pystyt kääntämään asiakkaan liiketoiminnalliset vaatimukset toimiviksi ja kestäviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuksi.
* Omaat aikaisempaa työkokemusta IT\-konsultoinnin parista. Sinulla on myös kokemusta pre\-sales \-keskusteluihin osallistumisesta potentiaalisten ja nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa teknisen asiantuntijan roolissa, ja halua työskennellä osana tiimiä tarjouspyyntöprosesseissa.

### **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**


* **Välittävän kulttuurin:** Sinä ja yli 2000 kollegaasi olette aina prioriteetti – sekä yksilöinä että yhteisönä. Meillä viihdytään töissä: Q1/2025 eNPS oli \+68\. **Dev\-yhteisössämme** on jo yli 400 solitalaista.
* **Auttamisen kulttuurin:** Meillä työskennellään tiimeissä, ja apua on aina saatavilla yli projekti\-, tiimi\- ja yksikkörajojen.
* **Kasvumahdollisuudet:** Tarjoamme laajan valikoiman erilaisia oppimispolkuja ja panostamme **osaamisen kehittämiseen**.
* **Rotaatiot:** Et jää jumiin yhteen rooliin – meillä on toimiva rotaatiomalli, ja monet solitalaiset ovat työskennelleet useissa eri rooleissa Solita\-uransa aikana.
* **Teknologioihin vaikuttaminen:** Pääset vaikuttamaan projektiemme teknologioihin ja toimintatapoihin. Katso esimerkiksi **Developer Survey 2024** \-tuloksemme saadaksesi tarkempaa tietoa teknologioista, joita hyödynnämme projekteissamme.
* **Erinomaisen tasapainon työn ja vapaa\-ajan välillä****:** Solitalaiset kokevat tämän yhdeksi yhteisömme parhaista puolista.
* **Laajat työsuhde\-edut:** Valitse työvälineesi, nauti laajasta työterveydestä, hieronnoista, pyöräedusta, valmennuksista ja harrastekerhoista – ja paljon muusta!
* **Kasvavan yrityksen:** Monipuolinen osaamisemme ja asiakkuudet eri toimialoilta luovat vahvan perustan Solitan kestävälle kasvulle. Palkkamallimme perustuu kiinteään kuukausipalkkaan, joka tukee yhteistyötä ja osaamisen jakamista yhteisömme sisällä.

### **Jutellaan lisää!**



Jos sinua innostaa yhdistää syvä tekninen osaamisesi asiakaslähtöiseen ajatteluun ja haluat vaikuttaa sekä projektien toteutukseen että liiketoimintamme strategiseen kasvattamiseen, kuulemme mielellämme sinusta!

Rekrytointiprosessimme sisältää kaksi haastattelukierrosta, joiden aikana tapaat tiimimme jäseniä ja opit lisää Solitalla työskentelystä. Saat myös mahdollisuuden näyttää osaamistasi ja kysyä meiltä kysymyksiä – tavoitteenamme on tutustua molemmin puolin.

Kysymyksiä? Ota yhteyttä rekrytoijaamme Juliaan: julia.oksa@solita.fi

Tästä syystä valitun hakijan luottotiedot voidaan tarkistaa ja hänet voidaan ohjata huumetestiin. Nämä tarkastukset suoritetaan työelämän yksityisyyden suojasta annetun lain mukaisesti ja sen rajoissa. * Willingness to learn and adapt

You’ll be part of a collaborative, agile team with a great spirit and a shared mission: driving a transformation that will reshape the material handling industry through the power of software. This is your chance to work on Industrial Internet and digitalisation initiatives at a global industry leader. The platforms you design and develop will serve a wide range of customers, from manufacturing and process industries to shipyards, ports, and terminals around the world.
