title: UX Designer
description:
**About Remion**
----------------

Remion is based in Tampere, and we’re a community of around 50 people where technical skills, an engineering mindset, a helping attitude, and flexibility meet. We work in the field of Industrial IoT, building both continuous development projects and new solutions for our customers.


We value long\-term customer partnerships. Some of our clients have dedicated teams that collaborate with them for years, developing and improving their solutions together.


Our team brings together a wide range of experience, from seasoned professionals to recent graduates. What connects us is a shared passion for solving technical challenges, a genuine interest in technology, strong professional pride, and the drive to deliver high\-quality results.


We’ve been growing steadily over the past two years, nearly doubling our team size. Now, we’re looking for our very first **UX Designer** to join us and take the lead in shaping the user experience and interface design for Remion’s software products.

**The Role**
------------


We’re looking for a UX Expert to lead the user experience and interface design for Remion’s software products, primarily Regatta Insights (a data\-driven analytics platform) and Normet HMI \& web UIs (industrial and equipment control systems).


You’ll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and end users to transform complex functional requirements into intuitive, efficient, and visually compelling digital interfaces. Your work will help bring clarity, consistency, and usability across products, making technical systems both effective and enjoyable to use.

**Success in this role means**  

delivering consistent, high\-quality design assets and prototypes. You’ll receive positive feedback from both users and internal teams about usability and design clarity. Developer handoff and implementation will become smoother and more efficient thanks to a unified design system. Over time, you’ll improve the usability and visual consistency and overall experience across Regatta and Normet products.

**You will be responsible for**  

designing, improving, and maintaining user experiences and interfaces that meet our customer needs.  

You will:  

* Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing with end users.
* Map user journeys and personas to understand workflows in industrial and data\-driven contexts.
* Define information architecture and navigation models for dashboards, HMIs, and web tools.
* Translate complex telemetry and analytics data into usable and insightful visual layouts.
* Develop wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes using Figma, Sketch, or similar tools.
* Design responsive and accessible web interfaces and HMI layouts for both desktop and industrial touchscreen displays.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate and consistent UI implementation.
* Maintain and evolve a design system shared across Regatta and Normet solutions.
* Work with software engineers to define feasible UI components and integrations with back\-end APIs.
* Support product managers with UX input during feature prioritization.
* Partner with customers and field engineers to gather feedback and validate usability in real environments.

**Required skills and experience**  

* At least 5 years of experience in UX design for web or industrial applications.
* Excellent skills in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch, and familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
* Proven experience with data visualization, dashboards, or industrial HMIs.
* Understanding of HTML and CSS basics, and ability to collaborate effectively with developers.
* Excellent visual design sense, including layout, color theory, and typography, with a practical, user\-centered mindset.
* Strong communication skills in English (Finnish is a plus).
**Nice to have experience**  

Experience in industrial or IoT domains, knowledge of React\-based component libraries such as MUI or ShadCN/UI, familiarity with SCADA/HMI design principles or embedded UIs, experience with usability testing, UX metrics, and accessibility standards (WCAG), or exposure to data visualization libraries like D3\.js, Recharts, or Plotly.

**You’ll fit right in if you**  

are an analytical yet creative problem solver who enjoys finding clarity in complex systems. You’re comfortable working in agile, iterative development environments and have a good eye for detail and visual harmony. You care about users and communicate proactively, bridging the gap between design and engineering with ease.

**What we offer**
-----------------


We provide comprehensive employee benefits, which you can explore on our careers page.


The salary range for this position is approximately €3,800–€4,800\. We’re also happy to hear your own expectations and believe in having an open conversation about compensation.

**Interested?**
---------------


Click the Apply now button and tell us a little about yourself. We review applications as they come in, so you might hear from us soon. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person.

You have a natural precision and eye for software design. We hope you are proactive, ask when you get stuck, and are ready to help colleagues.

* Java 17 \+ Maven

* Time series databases (e.g., Timescale)

* Docker

* TypeScript


With your expertise and skills, you are a part in creating good customer experience. Your work contributes to how the customer can utilize the data in their devices and derive benefits for their business.

Comprehensive employment benefits. Read more from our career pages.

Click the apply button and tell us a bit about yourself. We will start processing applications as they come but interviews will take place in January 2026\.

Our **Machine Data Platform team** is now looking for an **Embedded Systems** **Engineer** to join our group of IoT specialists. * Develop technical specifications and plans, for both software and hardware
* Make good architectural decisions that provide solutions to business challenges and can be utilized as reusable components in Konecranes digital platform

* Communicate effectively and professionally in all forms of communication with peers, stakeholders and product owners
* Translate business requirements into development requirements
* Participate in Portfolio/Backlog Management and backlog grooming
* Sprint planning and demos
* Coordinate with feature team resources for the smooth execution of development sprints.

* Experience with embedded systems and industrial control systems
* Strong background in software development on systems\-on\-chip, embedded Linux systems, especially Yocto Linux, as well as with AWS IoT
* Expertise with some of the programming technologies listed: C/C\+\+, Node.js, Java, Python, Shell scripting

* Willingness to learn and deep dive into problem solving

title: Service Owner, Test Automation & AI Testing
description:
*Gofore is an international digital transformation consultancy with Finnish roots. We employ nearly 1,800 experts across 23 cities in Finland, Germany, Austria, Czech Republic, Spain, and Estonia. For over 23 years, we have helped organisations modernise, secure, and scale their digital capabilities. Our mission is clear: **to deliver digital transformation the right way** – responsibly, intelligently, and with a deep understanding of the people, processes, and systems we serve.





As we strengthen our combined capabilities across the full digital lifecycle – from design to development, cloud engineering, embedded systems, and advanced automation – modern testing becomes a strategic enabler for everything we build. This is where you come in.

Gofore is one of Finland’s leading QA service providers, with over 200 quality professionals and a strong market reputation. With the recent launch of **Gofore Testing Genius**, our AI\-driven cloud service for scalable automated testing, we are accelerating our move into intelligent and autonomous testing.





As our Test Automation \& AI Testing Service Owner, you will be responsible for developing the offering, supporting sales, guiding delivery excellence, and shaping the evolution of our test automation and AI\-enabled testing capabilities across Gofore x Huld.





If you want to influence how modern testing is sold, delivered, and innovated at scale, this is the role for you.





**Key Responsibilities**





* **Service Development – Evolve and productise the offering**


**Modern testing evolves rapidly, and our customers expect scalable, future\-proof solutions. As Service Owner, you will:**


* Drive the development of new test automation, generative AI, and machine\-learning\-based testing solutions.

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Business Areas, and Account Leads to identify customer needs and shape solutions.
* Support presales with solution proposals, scoping, risk identification, and commercial modelling.
* Help position Gofore’s Testing Genius and other AI\-driven testing concepts in customer discussions and tenders.
* Provide insight for marketing, account\-based campaigns, and content creation.

**3\. Customer Consulting – Hands\-on leadership in key engagements**


**Service Owners stay close to delivery to ensure our offering works in real customer environments. In this role, you will:**


* Act as Lead Consultant for selected strategic customer cases, but no more than 50% of working time.
* Conduct test automation and AI testing assessments, maturity reviews, and development roadmaps.
* Support the ramp\-up of new test automation engagements or lead strategic automation initiatives.
* Guide customers in adopting next\-generation AI\-driven testing practices.

**4\. Capability Development – Strengthen the talent pool**


**Our competitive strength comes from our people and their evolving skills. As Service Owner, you will:**


* Drive competency development in test automation, AI testing, agentic testing, and emerging toolchains.
* Share best practices, frameworks, patterns, and recommended tooling across teams.
* Play a key role in recruiting automation and AI testing specialists.
* Support continuous learning and professional growth within the QA capability.

**5\. Community \& People Leadership – Foster growth and collaboration**


**A modern testing community thrives on learning, coaching, and shared practices. In this role, you will:**


* Depending on your profile, act as People Lead for selected senior test automation and AI testing Lead experts.
* Support lead experts and communities of practice to strengthen modern testing capabilities.
* Foster a culture of learning, experimentation, and innovation within the test automation \& AI testing community.
* Promote collaboration, psychological safety, and knowledge sharing.

**6\. Collaboration \& Strategic Alignment – Integrate testing across Gofore’s services**


**Testing is essential to Gofore’s end\-to\-end digital delivery. In this role, you will:**


* Work with Business Areas and Account Leads to align test automation and AI testing solutions with customer needs in Intelligent Industry, Defence \& Space, and Digital Society.
* Collaborate closely with other Service Areas – including Software Development, Cloud, DevOps, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Data \& AI, and Embedded – to ensure testing is seamlessly integrated into delivery models and combined offerings.
* Strengthen consistency and scalability of testing practices across Gofore’s cross\-functional teams, ensuring that approaches support modern engineering, cloud\-native development, and AI\-enabled workflows.

**What you bring**





**Test Automation \& AI testing Service Owner will benefit from having the following competencies:**





* Strong understanding of test automation and AI\-driven testing market, including key tools, emerging technologies and industry trends
* 5\+ years experience designing and implementing test automation concepts and frameworks across multiple customer environments, preferably for agile Digital services, enterprise IT systems and embedded solutions
* Practical experience or strong interests in AI\-enhanced and agentic testing frameworks
* Preferably experience of performance testing.
* Proven ability to work in a solution\-oriented and consultative role, including participation in service offering development, solution proposals, and customer presales
* Customer\-oriented mindset and readiness to adapt to the needs of customer projects, including where and how you work
* Passion for enabling high\-quality customer experience
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and people leadership skills
* Interest and understanding in business development in general
* Fluency in Finnish and English

**What we offer**





Comprehensive well\-being and smooth everyday life are at the core of Gofore. Our goal is to be a work community where working is inspiring, rewarding, and enhances your professional skills. Our customer satisfaction is high, our NPS being 62 (2025\), and our reputation for providing high\-quality services to our customers is solely thanks to our top experts. Gofore employees receive particularly good feedback for their customer\-oriented attitude. Our employee satisfaction is based on a skilled community and collaboration.





We are proud of our transparent culture, pioneering spirit, and the fact that we have a greater purpose than just generating profit – striving for a more humane, sustainable, and ethical digital world and working life. With us, you will become part of a community where you are close to other experts in your field and at the same time work closely with other top experts on customer projects. We are organized in a customer\-oriented manner, which allows visibility towards individual and team successes and professional development, for example, within a specific industry.



The community spirit of Gofore employees also extends outside of work through various activities such as small event workshops, board games, and family days. To ensure optimal balance, we offer flexible working conditions and tools that you can choose from according to your needs. In addition, we have comprehensive benefits. Gofore has its own collective agreement that reflects our employees. You can familiarize yourself with it here.

  


**Salary development**

  


For us it is important that Goforeans receive reasonable total compensation for their work. The compensation is the outcome of, not only experience and skills, but also active work for our two values: being a good workplace for everyone and considering customer perspective in everything we do. We have different salary models, and in addition to the monthly salary, we have separate bonuses linked with the company’s success. Bonuses can be related to, for example, recruitment, sales or actions advancing Gofore’s employer brand. In this position, your basic monthly salary is approximately 6000–7000€.

Read here what happens when you send your application and how recruitment progresses here at Gofore.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
### **About ONEiO**


ONEiO is a next\-generation Managed Integration Service Provider, delivering a cloud\-based Integration Ops solution for IT and technology service providers. Unlike traditional system integrators which rely on project\-based custom integrations, ONEiO delivers and operates integrations as a service—eliminating bottlenecks, reducing costs, and accelerating time\-to\-value.

### **What this means for Legal:**


ONEiO delivers integrations as a subscription: a cloud platform (powered by ONEAI) plus an always\-on managed service. We don’t run one\-off projects—we design, build, and operate integrations continuously under the subscription.

#### **Implications for Legal:**

* Platform / SaaS: subscription terms, SLAs/SLOs, DPAs \& GDPR, security and compliance frameworks, data residency, audit rights
* Managed service under subscription (not projects): service descriptions and onboarding readiness (vs. project milestones), change management within the subscription, delivery acceptance tied to “service live/ready,” IP \& reuse of connectors/patterns, multi\-party data sharing and flow\-down obligations, uptime/support commitments, exit \& data return


Legal’s role is to turn contracting and compliance into a business advantage for IT service providers—delivering on our promise as The Integration Success Company.

### **Role Overview**


ONEiO is seeking a Legal Counsel to provide comprehensive legal and regulatory support across our global operations. This role bridges legal expertise and business practicality—ensuring our contractual frameworks and compliance processes enable us to operate safely and efficiently while supporting our continued growth.


You’ll take ownership of our well\-established legal function and evolve it to meet the demands of our expanding business. As our dedicated legal expert, you’ll work closely with cross\-functional teams and external advisors to structure deals, manage risk, and build trust with enterprise customers across multiple jurisdictions.

### **The unique legal landscape of Integration Ops:**


Our Integration Ops as a Service model means you’ll navigate:

* Subscription agreements where platform access and managed services are bundled—not sold as separate projects
* Service delivery frameworks that focus on “service live/ready” acceptance rather than traditional project milestones
* Multi\-party scenarios involving our customers, their customers, vendors, and various ITSM/technology platforms
* Complex liability and IP frameworks where we operate mission\-critical integrations on behalf of IT service providers, with connector/pattern reuse across customers
* Data processing obligations across multiple jurisdictions and customer environments, including multi\-party data sharing and flow\-down requirements
* Change management within subscriptions—how scope changes, onboarding readiness, uptime commitments, and exit/data return are handled


This is an opportunity to shape how a fast\-growing managed services company navigates the evolving regulatory landscape while maintaining business agility and supporting sustainable growth.### **Key Responsibilities:**


**Commercial Contracts \& Legal Advisory (60%)**

* Draft, review, and negotiate ONEiO subscription agreements—covering both platform access and always\-on managed services delivery (not project\-based)
* Maintain and evolve our standard contract templates: SaaS Master Terms, Data Processing Addendum, VAR/Agency Agreements, Professional Services Terms, subscription service descriptions
* Navigate complex multi\-party integration scenarios where our managed services involve customer systems, end\-customer environments, third\-party platforms, and ONEiO’s technology
* Draft and maintain subscription service frameworks that balance delivery flexibility with legal protection—addressing service live/ready acceptance, change management, IP reuse, and exit/data return
* Support business teams in contractual risk assessment and negotiations—with emphasis on liability allocation, data processing, information security, uptime/support commitments, and flow\-down obligations
* Enable faster deal cycles through efficient contracting practices
* Provide legal input on supplier, financial, and employment agreements where needed

**Regulatory Compliance (20%)**

* Monitor, interpret, and operationalize EU digital regulations (GDPR, NIS2, DORA, EU Data Act, EU AI Act)
* Collaborate with security and delivery teams to ensure compliance in processes and documentation—particularly relevant as we operate integrations for customers in regulated industries
* Advise on privacy and data protection matters and maintain company records of processing activities (GDPR Art. 30\)—including multi\-party data sharing scenarios
* Ensure proactive readiness for evolving regulatory frameworks affecting both our platform technology and managed services delivery
* Address data residency and audit rights requirements in subscription frameworks

**Risk Management \& Governance (10%)**

  

* Act as Compliance Officer (legal and governance, coordinated with security compliance)
* Contribute to due diligence processes, supplier evaluations, and policy drafting
* Manage business insurances and support security team initiatives (ISO 27001 compliance)
* Conduct trademark management and Freedom\-to\-Operate (FTO) reviews
* Provide input to leadership on regulatory impact and mitigation strategies—particularly as Integration Ops bridges technology and professional services

**Corporate Administration (10%)**

* Assist in corporate filings, shareholder and board documentation, and option plan management
* Maintain the company’s contract database (ContractSafe) and support internal audits
* Support cross\-entity operations (Oy, GmbH, Ltd, Inc.) and liaise with authorities as needed

### **What We’re Looking For**

**Must\-Have Qualifications**

* Law degree obtained in Europe and relevant legal qualification
* 3–7 years of legal experience in technology services, managed services, SaaS, or IT/ITSM context
* Solid knowledge of EU digital regulations (NIS2, DORA, GDPR, and emerging frameworks)
* Proven experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial contracts—understanding both technology subscriptions and managed services delivery frameworks
* Understanding of subscription\-based managed services business models: How continuous service delivery differs from project\-based work (service live/ready vs. milestones, change management within subscriptions, IP reuse, exit/data return, uptime commitments)
* Familiarity with cybersecurity, data protection, and risk management principles—including data residency and audit rights
* Strong understanding of cloud\-based service delivery, IT service management (ITSM), and integration ecosystems
* Pragmatic business mindset—capable of balancing compliance rigor with commercial goals and service delivery realities
* Excellent communication skills—able to translate complex legal topics into clear business language
* Fluent in English and Finnish (working languages); German is a plus
* High integrity, independence, and proactive approach in a fast\-moving scale\-up environment
* Embodies ONEiO’s iONEER mindset—applies critical thinking, takes ownership, and delivers results

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with IT service providers, MSPs, or technology service delivery companies
* Background in fast\-growing scale\-ups or venture\-backed B2B companies
* Understanding of ITSM tools landscape (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, etc.)
* Understanding of procurement processes and public sector contracting (particularly in Nordics)
* Hands\-on experience with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC2\)
* Prior collaboration with regulators and external legal counsel across multiple jurisdictions
* Experience with multi\-party data processing agreements and flow\-down obligations

### **Why ONEiO**

* Lead with confidence: Take ownership of a well\-structured legal function and evolve it to support our next phase of growth
* Drive real impact: Your decisions directly influence how we structure deals, manage risk, and build trust with IT service providers who rely on us for mission\-critical integrations
* Navigate unique legal territory: Work at the intersection of subscription platform and always\-on managed services—where Integration Ops creates novel legal considerations distinct from traditional project or pure SaaS models
* Navigate emerging regulations: Work with cutting\-edge EU tech regulations and turn compliance into competitive advantage
* Join a scaling company: Be part of a growing team in an exciting expansion phase, with real influence on strategic direction
* International collaboration: Work with talented teams across Helsinki, Berlin, and London offices

**Location: Helsinki Office**


This is an on\-site position based in our Helsinki office.


The nature of this role requires regular physical presence to collaborate closely with the management team, participate in deal reviews, and be embedded in our day\-to\-day operations. We’re building a tight\-knit team where proximity matters—legal needs to be integrated into daily operations, accessible to teams, and working face\-to\-face with leadership.


While we offer flexibility for occasional remote work, your primary workplace will be our Helsinki office.

**Who is Flock?**
Flock Safety is the leading safety technology platform, helping communities thrive by taking a proactive approach to crime prevention and security. Our hardware and software suite connects cities, law enforcement, businesses, schools, and neighborhoods in a nationwide public\-private safety network. Trusted by over 5,000 communities, 4,500 law enforcement agencies, and 1,000 businesses, Flock delivers real\-time intelligence while prioritizing privacy and responsible innovation.


We’re a high\-performance, low\-ego team driven by urgency, collaboration, and bold thinking. Working at Flock means tackling big challenges, moving fast, and continuously improving. It’s intense but deeply rewarding for those who want to make an impact.


With nearly $700M in venture funding and a $7\.5B valuation, we’re scaling intentionally and seeking top talent to help build the impossible. If you value teamwork, ownership, and solving tough problems, Flock could be the place for you.

**The Opportunity**


Flock Safety is continuously building more and more complex camera systems that utilize advanced camera features provided by the chipset or developed in\-house. The efficient development of such features requires the team to have the capability to build proof of concept designs and prototypes throughout the stack, ranging from Android / Linux application layer to the middleware and down to the driver layer. The purpose for this role is to strengthen our team's kernel, and HAL capabilities in order to enable faster productization of Flock devices with linking our hardware features to our software capabilities.

**This position is on\-site in Tampere, Finland.**

**Qualifications**

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in a related technical field.
* 5\+ years of experience in camera systems development, ISP tuning, or camera pipeline optimization
* Strong understanding of **Qualcomm camera architectures**, ISP blocks, and image processing pipelines
* Hands\-on experience with **camera bring\-up** on Android or Linux platforms, including driver and HAL layer development
* Solid understanding of **camera sensors, optics, image signal processing (ISP)**, and color pipelines
* Proficiency in **C/C\+\+ and Python** for embedded development and automation
* Experience using **Qualcomm development tools** for tuning and performance optimization
* Familiarity with **kernel\-level debugging, middleware integration**, and performance profiling
* Proven ability to analyze and optimize image quality across varying lighting and environmental conditions
* Excellent communication and documentation skills; ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional hardware and software teams

*Feeling uneasy that you haven’t ticked every box? That’s okay, we’ve felt that way too. Studies have shown women and minorities are less likely to apply unless they meet all qualifications. We encourage you to break the status quo and apply to roles that would make you excited to come to work every day.*

**90 Days at Flock**


We prescribe to 90 day plans and believe that good days, lead to good weeks, which lead to good months. This serves as a preview of the 90 day plan you will receive if you were to be hired in this role atFlock Safety.


**The First 30 Days**

* Learn Flock products and how to use them in the lab
* Get familiar with Flock Safety Products and configurations
* Learn how to install Flock Cameras and how to use the camera manager
* Understand the end\-to\-end Flock capture pipeline from the camera driver to the admin in the cloud
* Setup Qualcomm environments and start contributing the tunings

**The First 60 Days**

* Improve pipeline and tunings for a product
* Report the improvements of the new pipeline

**90 Days \& Beyond**


* Propose more automated tuning solutions
* Present a plan to automate the tuning process at least for some parts ,so that it is easier and faster in the future

**The Interview Process**

We want our interview process to be a true reflection of our culture: transparent and collaborative. Throughout the interview process, your recruiter will guide you through the next steps and ensure you feel prepared every step of the way.


* Our First Chat: During this first conversation, you’ll meet with a recruiter to chat through your background, what you could bring to Flock, what you are looking for in your next role, and who we are.
* The Hiring Manager Interview: You will meet with your potential future boss to really dive into the role, the team, expectations, and what success means at Flock. This is your chance to really nerd out with someone in your field.
* The Technical Assessment: Our technical assessments seek to test the hard skills required to do the job. Engineers may find themselves in coding interviews or architecture discussions, sales roles may present mock discovery calls, and leadership roles may craft 90 day plans. Your recruiter will inform you of which assessment you will be assigned and ensure you are fully prepared for your big day.
* The Panel: Learn more about the team, responsibilities, and workflows. You should be prepared to speak about past projects, how you collaborate and communicate with others, and how you live our values. **Role Highlights**


Title: **Senior Satellite Systems Production Specialist**


Location: Espoo (On\-site hybrid)


Type of Contract: Permanent


Team: Production Engineering Team

 **Who are we?**


ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions; owning and operating the world's largest SAR constellation. ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates from five international locations with more than 600 employees from nearly 60 countries, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.


Our satellites acquire images of Earth at any time – even when it’s cloudy or dark – providing commercial and government partners with unmatched persistent monitoring capabilities. Information derived from our SAR images helps customers make data\-driven decisions to address time\-critical challenges in various sectors, such as maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance.


Our team is a tight\-knit group of experts across many disciplines (e.g., engineering, software development, radar technology, etc.). We’re innovative, driven people who strive for excellence in everything we do. Teamwork, curiosity, and having fun are core values at ICEYE, and contribute to Making the Impossible possible!!

**Why should you work for us?**


ICEYE is at the cutting edge of new technology and we are continuing to build and operate our commercial constellation of SAR satellites. Working with ICEYE, you will be part of making the impossible possible, whilst shaping the Earth Observation industry. You will work with varied, diverse and engaged colleagues to further the ICEYE mission. At ICEYE we realise that without great people we can not succeed; therefore you will be an integral, valued and appreciated colleague, with the ability to directly shape the vision and direction of the business.


We actively support Continuous Professional Development, and will provide access to a range of avenues to allow you to succeed, including courses, training and attendance at conferences. ICEYE is a place where your development, your growth and your success is a priority.

**Why you will love this role:**


As a Senior Satellite Production Systems Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring that ICEYE satellite tests deliver the expected results. You will coordinate and analyze functional, payload, and Bus\-level tests to validate subsystem and system\-level performance. You will also act as a technical expert for tests assigned at the subsystem level, identifying risks, handling anomalies and leading cross\-functional troubleshooting across multiple procedures for subsystem testing on the satellite. This position combines specialised technical skills with leadership qualities in the field of production. It involves ensuring that subsystems are correctly built, tested and integrated, while supervising teams and guaranteeing the overall success of the satellite missi**on.**

**What you will do in this role:**

* Plan and carry out functional testing of built hardware, including setup, instrumentation, test execution to validate satellite operations.
* Analyse test results and make any necessary adjustments in the event of malfunction or non\-compliance. Write detailed test reports and escalate it to AIT engineers and system design engineers when necessary.
* Take responsibility for assigned processes, acting as the primary troubleshooter and technical expert.
* Take ownership of testing procedures, ensuring they are up\-to\-date and accurate.
* Provide technical training and mentoring to team members, share your knowledge and expertise, and contribute to the development of training programmes and best practices.
* Assisting in the management of activities related to satellite launch campaigns.
* Work closely and ensure clear communication with other production teams to ensure satellite\-build\-phase deadlines and technical specifications are met.
* Reviews test software automations and sets new requirements for the development and improvement of satellite testing procedures.
* Monitor schedules and manage unforeseen technical events.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation during subsystem testing, including progress reports and issue tracking.
* Interface with AIT engineers, designers, and system engineers to ensure satellite system\-level tests are reliable.
* Participate in design reviews, failure investigations, and lessons\-learned meetings.
* Maintain documentation, traceability, and quality records in compliance with internal and external standards.

**Requirements**

**What you need to be successful in this role:**

* Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Space studies, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field is required. Advanced degrees or certifications in these areas are a plus.
* 5 years of hands\-on experience managing testing processes at scale, with a proven track record of promoting continuous improvement and maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency.
* Excellent organization and communication skills, with particular attention to detail regarding procedures, preparation and execution.
* Understanding of satellite subsystems (including examples like power, propulsion, AOCS, and communication) and key operational concepts (such as anomaly management, telemetry monitoring).
* Proficient in using the Linux command\-line interface for system testing and monitoring, log analysis, and basic file management in a satellite operations environment.
* Ability to develop and maintain tests for satellite systems using Python or Shell to automate routine tasks.
* Skills in electronics and embedded systems.
* Proficient in English, both written and spoken, to ensure clear communication in a cross\-functional environment.
* Demonstrated ability to read, interpret and work from drawings, controlled documentation and processes such as: mechanical drawings, assembly procedures/work instructions; schematics, engineering drawings, and parts list.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.

**Additionally, it would be beneficial if you had these attributes and skills:**

* Experience using Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence).
* Background in NewSpace, satellite production, or high\-volume aerospace integration.
* Experience in writing and optimizing assembly and test procedures.
* Understanding of Lean and Six Sigma methodologies for improving production efficiency and reducing waste.
* Proficient in identifying system improvement opportunities and translating end\-user requirements into technical design specifications.
* Experience working with cleanroom procedures and satellite integration flows.

**Benefits**

**What’s In It for You?**

* A job that matters in a dynamic Earth Observation environment with a scale\-up approach
* An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment
* Occupational healthcare, occupational and accident insurance
* A yearly benefit budget to spend as you wish (i.e. on sport, transport, bike benefit, wellness, lunch, etc.)
* Phone subscription with iPhone of choice
* Relocation support (i.e. flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support)
* Time for self\-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes
* Inspiring and collaborating offices and silent workspaces enable you to focus
* A wide variety of the best coffee, tea, snacks, and sweets to accompany your daily space mission
* Competitive salary contingent on your experience level, and will be negotiated individually

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**


At ICEYE, diversity is more than just a value \- it's our greatest strength. We’re dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. Diverse perspectives drive innovation and creativity, so we actively seek individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.


No matter your background, we encourage you to bring your authentic self to the team. Join us and be part of a workplace where differences are embraced and valued, because together, we’re stronger.


Apply now to begin your ICEYE journey and help us make the impossible possible.


Learn more about ICEYE and life at our company at iceye.com.


Ready to launch your career? Apply now and help us build the future of Space Tech!

No Isolation is an award\-winning scale\-up in EdTech with offices in **Oslo, London, and Munich** building human\-centered technology that turns absence into real\-time participation, connection, and belonging.


Our flagship solution, the **AV1 robot**, is deployed in 19 countries with 4,800\+ units, supporting schools to sustain attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Families consistently describe AV1 as life\-changing \- it rebuilds connection and continuity, bringing back everyday happiness and helping students stay on track to pass their grades.

#### **The Opportunity — Platform Engineering**


As adoption grows, we must scale to support larger device fleets, increasingly complex feature sets as well as new data\-driven capabilities.


As our very first **Senior** **Platform Engineer**, you will own the pillars that our product team and our robots build upon: cloud infrastructure, IoT device services, CI/CD, observability, security, and developer experience.


You are a technologist who thrives with people. Your craft is reliability and enablement. You facilitate the right choices, reduce toil, and turn operational excellence into a repeatable habit across.

#### **What You’ll Do — Scope \& Responsibilities**

**Infrastructure management**

* Automate cloud (and some on‑prem) resources and policies using IaC/CaC (e.g., **Terraform, Ansible**) for consistent, repeatable, container‑centric deployments
* Engineer redundancy, routing, networking, and **load balancing** to integrate backend services with robots, mobile, and web clients; operate and evolve **Kubernetes** (incl. **Traefik** ingress)
* Monitor and right‑size infrastructure against defined metrics; run regular audits and upgrades to stay current and secure

**Site reliability engineering**

* Own and mature observability, monitoring, and alerting with e.g. **Grafana Stack, Prometheus**; implement high‑signal dashboards and noise\-free, actionable alerts
* Define SLIs/SLOs to clarify “done” and “good enough”; run backup DR dry‑runs; participate in incident response and drive durable fixes

**DevSecOps integration**

* Build modern golden paths and secure CI/CD that make the most out of **GitLab**
* Shift security to the left: scanning, guardrails, secrets/encryption, access \& identity controls

**Team collaboration \& enablement**

* Provide hands‑on guidance to backend, frontend/mobile, and embedded teams; document things, lead workshops, and improve processes so the team can self‑serve
* Align platform work with product delivery cadence; mentor on productivity enablers and change adoption; make platform engineering a shared effort

**Selective opportunities (as bandwidth allows)**

* **AI enablement:** make our engineering team AI‑native (e.g., **MCP/ACP, AIOps**) in a safe, deliberate, and targeted way
* **Test automation:** evolve regression/e2e frameworks, hardware abstractions, and data/process mocking
* **Data platform:** improve pipelines for warehousing/analytics and potential production ML management in the future
* **Security stack:** iterate on CNAPP, SIEM, ISMS, Compliance \& Trust, dependency management, network and cloud security
* 

#### **What You Bring — Experience \& Capabilities**

* **Senior infrastructure leadership:** 5\+ years owning AWS\-based platforms in production, including Kubernetes troubleshooting under load — ideally scaling IoT fleets with WebRTC streaming, sockets, and REST APIs for real\-time reliability

* **Cross\-domain impact:** Versatile across embedded, mobile, backend, and our emerging data practice; you influence company\-wide KPIs—like user happiness metrics—visible to engineering and executive leadership, accelerating our evolution into a data\-powered mission
* **Compliance\-first mindset:** Proven delivery of GDPR\-compliant systems, with hands\-on ISO 27001 implementation and SOC 2 readiness; you embed privacy and security as non\-negotiable foundations, not afterthoughts
* **Technical breadth:** STEM background with polymath experience in high\-stakes environments; curious yet disciplined, you balance innovation (e.g., AI, test automation, security uplifts) with operational rigor to ship daily and sustain excellence

The Security Engineer is a member of PG Forsta’s Information Security team and is responsible for building and maintaining controls that manage information risk and security. The engineer is expected to build and maintain administrative, technical, and physical controls to secure PG Forsta data and keep PG Forsta in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and contractual terms.


We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer with a strong software development background to help us design, build, and scale secure systems. You will play a critical role in researching, architecting, and implementing innovative security solutions while working closely with product engineering teams to ensure security is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

**Skills we are looking for:**

* Software development, including automated CI/CD pipelines
* SBOM, SCA, SAST, DAST (Software Bill of Materials, Software Composition Analysis, Static Analysis Security Testing, Dynamic Analysis Security Testing)
* Identity management best practices
* Vulnerability management, specifically with software dependencies
* Incident response and troubleshooting
* ITSM workflow and process


This position has no direct reports. It is a remote position that may require coordination with US working hours, occasional travel (1\-2 times per year) and on\-call support every 6\-8 weeks.


Ideal Candidate: Application developer/engineer with experience with build pipelines, security testing, SBOMs, vulnerability management, and coordinating with product, engineering, and security teams.

**About the Team**


The Risk and Security team is part of the Legal Department. The team reports to the SVP, Risk and Security who reports to the General Counsel. It consists of people with technical security skills and non\-technical audit and compliance skills.


PG Forsta’s security team is well\-funded and supported by management. We have meaningful influence on how systems are designed and implemented. The department is structured to allow internal staff to leave work at work. While the job will require setting goals and meeting deadlines, it rarely requires more than 45 hours of work per week.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Strategy \& Vision**

* Participate in vision, principles, and security strategy for projects or specific technologies, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

**Operational Execution**

* Integrate and manage security tooling across the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, including:
	+ Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
	+ Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
	+ Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
	+ Secrets detection, Infrastructure\-as\-code scanning, API security testing, and vulnerability correlation platforms
* Safeguard the software development lifecycle by securing dependencies, container images, build processes, and third\-party integrations.
* Embed security into new CI/CD pipelines and maintain existing security testing in CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot them as needed.
* Contribute hands\-on to codebases where needed, providing guidance on secure coding practices and reviewing critical code paths.
* Champion container security by ensuring secure image creation, scanning, and runtime protections across platforms like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Drive adoption of secure coding practices, supported by threat modelling, code reviews, and developer training programs.
* Drive security awareness and best practices across engineering teams by mentoring developers and empowering Security Champions.
* Establish and track key metrics for AppSec maturity, risk reduction, and remediation SLAs.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Liaise with Legal to define and communicate security controls required for regulatory compliance and contractual obligations.
* Working with product engineering, design and implement security for microservices architectures, including mTLS, service\-to\-service authentication, secrets management.
* Working with product engineering, Research, design, and apply innovative security solutions to both new and existing systems.
* Partner with DevOps and Infrastructure teams to secure Azure cloud\-native environments, including container orchestration and deployment layers.
* Partner with GRC and Client Response teams to prepare for audits, provide standardised answers to security questionnaires, and represent pipeline and platform controls to clients and external assessors.
* Engage with Pre\-Sales Engineering, where required, to support security discussions with strategic prospects and customers.
* Create transparency and trust around security posture through consistent reporting, dashboards, and stakeholder communication.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify gaps in security posture and propose enhancements to architecture, processes, and tooling.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong background in **software development** (experience with at least one major language such as Go, Java, Python, or C\#).
* Hands\-on experience in **building and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines** (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar).
* Deep understanding of **secure architecture patterns** (microservices, APIs, authentication, authorization).
* Experience with **mTLS, PKI, and cryptographic protocols**.
* Hands\-on experience with **IaC security** and secure automation.
* Ability to effectively **communicate complex security concepts** to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Familiarity with modern infrastructure (Kubernetes, Docker, cloud\-native environments).
* Knowledge of modern DevSecOps practices and CI/CD security integration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Threat modeling and risk assessment experience.
* Experience with tools like **Sigstore, SLSA, or in\-toto** for supply chain security.
* Contributions to open\-source security tools or research.
* Experience building or driving a **Security Champion program** is a plus.

**Experience**

* 6\+ years' experience in Application Development or similar technical role
* (Preferred) Experience in a healthcare environment.

**Compliance \& Ethics Expectations:**

* Participates and successfully completes the company's compliance program requirements and adheres to the Code of Conduct, Company policies, and applicable federal and state requirements.
* Sets an example for other employees regarding how the Company's Code of Conduct and Compliance Program is applied and observed every day when dealing with customers, business operations, or other teammates.
* Reports potential violations of company policy, Code of Conduct, and/or applicable laws and regulations
* Promotes an environment in which other employees are encouraged to report potential violations.
* As appropriate, provides input and suggestions regarding areas in which policies, procedures, workflows, and/or controls can be improved to enhance compliance.

**Special Working Conditions**


This is a remote\-working position. Week\-long travel may be required 1\-4 times per year.

**Special Physical Requirements**


The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy working in a small, fast\-moving team where your work makes a real difference? Are you not afraid to get your hands dirty, sometimes literally, to make things happen? At Monil, we’re redefining animal farming with data and technology to help farmers work smarter and build a more sustainable future.


Our virtual fencing keeps animals where they should be, improves welfare, opens new grazing areas, and helps farmers make better use of established fields. Right now, we have collars on more than 15,000 animals across Norway and the UK. Every minute, these collars send data to our servers, unlocking real\-time and long\-term insights.


Now we are aiming to become a world leading digital shepherd. In order to do so we need to shape our future data architecture and scale up our data science team!


In Monil, we don't work in silos. You'll have the chance to contribute to the entire data stack together with our experienced team. We strongly believe in sharing knowledge and constantly learning. As a Data Platform Engineer in Monil, you'll work very closely together with back\-end engineers, data engineers and data scientists and be encouraged to contribute to the entire data, cloud and ML stack.

**Your role**
-------------


As a Data Platform Engineer at Monil, you’ll be part of the data science team, owning our data architecture and related tooling, as well as building pipelines that serve key business and analytics needs. You'll ensure our platform is reliable, efficient, and ready to scale, collaborating with data scientists, product managers, developers, and the commercial team to ensure our data infrastructure supports everyone’s needs.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a scalable data platform that supports ingestion, processing, and serving data for training analytical models, delivering insights in our customer\-facing app, and internal reporting use\-cases (e.g. customer support and sales).
* Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that ensure reliable, high\-quality data flow from source systems to analytical and operational destinations.
* Handling schema changes in raw data by applying validation and versioning strategies (while working closely with the Software team!).
* Develop self\-service tools and data APIs for internal users.
* Monitor, optimize, and scale infrastructure for cost\-efficiency and low\-latency queries.

### **We can offer**

* Working with large volumes of data in a startup\-sized team. Already today, thousands of animal collars send time\-series sensor data to our servers constantly, and we expect the number to grow fast.
* Taking part in early architectural decisions: We’re at the beginning of building our data and analytics platform. You’ll help choose tools, define patterns, and shape how we work for years to come.
* Skilled and enthusiastic colleagues who share a strong common goal.
* A chance to join a promising and well\-backed startup with big ambitions in an early phase.
* Work together with experienced industry specialists in a variety of fields, from mechanics and electronics to embedded and back\-end software. You'll be part of the whole journey – talk to customers, dream up the best solutions, and bring new features to reality.
* Competitive salary and benefits.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor or Master in Computer Science, Engineering or other technical and quantitative fields preferred.
* 3\+ years of experience in data platform / data engineering roles, building and maintaining production\-grade data systems.
* Experience with large\-scale time\-series data and time\-series databases, with proficiency in SQL (ideally PostgreSQL/TimescaleDB).
* Understanding of data warehouse/lakehouse architectures, data modeling and schema design, ELT/ETL principles, and modern data stack tools (e.g. Fivetran, BigQuery and dbt).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS), containerisation (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker), CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform).

**Requirements**
----------------

* Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area.
* Fluency in Norwegian is preferred, but we make exceptions for the exceptional.

We are looking for a **Principal Engineer within Cyber Security** to strengthen our Cyber Security engineering capabilities. As a **Principal Cyber Security Engineer**, you will take the lead on multiple projects while also managing the department’s day\-to\-day operations. This role offers a unique opportunity to coordinate cyber needs across projects, develop best practices, and mentor cyber security talents within the organization. You will collaborate with leading experts in the field, actively contribute to exciting projects, and be an integral part of a dynamic team.


**About the position**


In this position, you will be a key resource and manager within the cyber discipline, ensuring that we continue to design secure and robust solutions for our clients. You will integrate cyber security into our engineering processes, from studies to FEED and execution. Additionally, you will help with cyber resource planning, develop best practices, and aid as an active resource in projects.


**Responsibilities and tasks include**


* Act as a key senior resource in projects related to cyber security.
* Lead the coordination of cyber security needs across multiple projects and ensure optimal resource allocation across geographical locations within M\&Y.
* Develop templates, methodologies, and best practices for cyber security engineering.
* Mentor and develop cyber security talents within the department, fostering a strong knowledge\-sharing culture.
* Help solve the most challenging cyber security issues in projects, ensuring effective and secure solutions.
* Participate in multi\-discipline project meetings involving instrumentation, automation, and other key areas, providing guidance on cyber security designs and solutions.
* Be deeply familiar with and further develop our **“way of working with cyber”** and apply these methodologies in projects while also training other engineers.
* Be a key resource for risk management and risk assessments in projects
* Stay up to date on the OT\-related threat landscape
* Ensure compliance with cyber security frameworks such as IEC 62443, Equinor TR requirements and other relevant requirements


**Qualifications**


Below is a list of key qualifications we value. While you may not have experience in all of these areas, we welcome candidates who bring relevant skills or have the ability and willingness to learn


* Prior experience leading and managing technical resources
* Extensive experience (10\-15\+ years) within cyber security from IT, OT, or both.
* General competence/understanding of electro, automation and instrument disciplines, and how cyber can work closely with those disciplines in designing and implementing secure solutions
* Prior project experience within the oil, gas, energy and/or renewable energy sector
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field. Relevant experience may compensate for a lack of formal education.
* Strong competence in network design, network technology, network architecture, and IT/OT security architecture.

* Strong leadership skills with an eagerness to collaborate and contribute positively in a team\-oriented environment.
* Well versed in communicating highly technical details in an understandable way based on the audience
* Comfortable with holding lectures, seminars etc related to cyber security
* Proactive in seeking advice and promoting the sharing of knowledge and experience within the team.
* Dedication to meeting project deadlines while ensuring adherence to high\-quality standards.
* Cultural adaptability and openness to diverse working teams.
* Effective communication skills in both spoken and written English. While proficiency in Norwegian is valued, it is not mandatory, but a willingness to learn is desirable.

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

* Strong communicator capable of explaining complex concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to assess production processes on\-site and provide clear verbal and written recommendations.
* Proactive mindset with strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**What Will Differentiate You**

* Experience with machine tools and automated machine tending.
* Industry certifications in robotics, automation, or technical sales.
* Experience in verticals such as automotive, food \& beverage, or logistics.
* Knowledge of lean manufacturing and Industry 4\.0\.
* Multilingual capabilities.
* Experience working with channel partners.

* Travel required for customer visits, trade shows, and partner support.
* Ability to work in industrial environments for demonstrations and assessments.

* A unique opportunity to work at the forefront of robotics and AI.
* A central role in a rapidly growing startup where your impact is visible.
* Competitive salary.
* A dynamic, international work environment with offices in the US and Norway.
